Private Sub addCheckBox(ByRef cellInsert As Range, ByRef cellLinked As Range, ByVal sCaption As String, Optional sNameSub As String = vbNullString, Optional sParametrs As String = vbNullString)

        .Characters.Text = sCaption
        If sNameSub <> vbNullString Then
            .Name = "A_" & cellInsert.Row & "_" & cellInsert.Column
            If sParametrs <> vbNullString Then
                .OnAction = "'" & sNameSub & """" & .Name & "_" & sParametrs & """'"
            Else
                .OnAction = "'" & sNameSub & "'"
            End If
        End If
        .Select
        With Selection
            .Value = xlOff
            .LinkedCell = cellLinked.Address
            .Display3DShading = False
        End With
    End With
End Sub

'=======================================================================================
' Procedure : SortArray
' Purpose   : Выполняет сортировку двумерного массива по возрастанию значений в указанном столбце.
'             Сортировка выполняется методом "пузырька" (Bubble Sort) непосредственно
'             в исходном массиве (in-place).
'
' Parameters:
'   SourceArr   (ByRef Variant) - Ссылка на сортируемый двумерный массив.
'                                 Поскольку аргумент передается ByRef, исходный массив
'                                 будет изменен после вызова функции.
'   ColumnIndex (ByVal Long)    - Индекс столбца, используемый в качестве ключа сортировки.
'
' Returns     : Variant - Возвращает отсортированный массив.
'
' Throws      : Error 13 (Type Mismatch) - Если входной аргумент SourceArr не является массивом.
'               Error 9  (Subscript out of range) - Если индекс ColumnIndex выходит за границы
'                                                   измерений массива.
'=======================================================================================
Public Function SortArray(ByRef SourceArr As Variant, ByVal ColumnIndex As Long) As Variant
    Dim i           As Long
    Dim j           As Long
    Dim LB1         As Long
    Dim UB1         As Long
    Dim LB2         As Long
    Dim UB2         As Long
    Dim IsSorted    As Boolean
    Dim TempValue   As Variant

    ' Проверка типа входных данных
    If Not IsArray(SourceArr) Then
        Err.Raise 13, "SortArray", "Входной аргумент не является массивом"
    End If

    ' Определение границ массива
    LB1 = LBound(SourceArr, 1)
    UB1 = UBound(SourceArr, 1)
    LB2 = LBound(SourceArr, 2)
    UB2 = UBound(SourceArr, 2)

    ' Проверка корректности индекса столбца
    If ColumnIndex < LB2 Or ColumnIndex > UB2 Then
        Err.Raise 9, "SortArray", "Указанный столбец выходит за границы массива"
    End If

    ' Основной цикл алгоритма сортировки
    Do
        IsSorted = True
        For i = LB1 To UB1 - 1
            ' Сравнение элементов соседних строк в целевом столбце
            If SourceArr(i, ColumnIndex) > SourceArr(i + 1, ColumnIndex) Then
                
                ' Перестановка строк массива
                For j = LB2 To UB2
                    TempValue = SourceArr(i, j)
                    SourceArr(i, j) = SourceArr(i + 1, j)
                    SourceArr(i + 1, j) = TempValue
                Next j
                IsSorted = False
            End If
        Next i
    Loop Until IsSorted
    SortArray = SourceArr
End Function

'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'* Module     : clsSort2DArray
'* Purpose    : Класс для сортировки двумерных массивов VBA
'* Algorithms : QuickSort (неустойчивый, in-place) и MergeSort (устойчивый)
'*
'* Version    : 3.0 (Refactored)
'* License    : Apache License
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

'==========================================================================================
' ENUMERATIONS
'==========================================================================================

Public Enum SortDataType
    sdtString = 1
    sdtNumber = 2
End Enum

'==========================================================================================
' PRIVATE MEMBERS
'==========================================================================================

Private mCol        As Long
Private mSortUp     As Boolean
Private mArr        As Variant
Private mDataType   As SortDataType

'==========================================================================================
' ERROR CONSTANTS
'==========================================================================================

Private Const ERR_EMPTY_ARRAY      As Long = vbObjectError + 513
Private Const ERR_NOT_2D_ARRAY     As Long = vbObjectError + 514
Private Const ERR_INVALID_COLUMN   As Long = vbObjectError + 515
Private Const ERR_SINGLE_ROW       As Long = vbObjectError + 516

Private Const ERR_MSG_EMPTY        As String = "Array is empty or not initialized"
Private Const ERR_MSG_NOT_2D       As String = "Two-dimensional array required"
Private Const ERR_MSG_INVALID_COL  As String = "Column index out of range"

'==========================================================================================
' PROPERTIES
'==========================================================================================

Public Property Get ColumnSort() As Long
    ColumnSort = mCol
End Property

Public Property Get SortUp() As Boolean
    SortUp = mSortUp
End Property

Public Property Get ListArray() As Variant
    ListArray = mArr
End Property

Public Property Get CountColumns() As Long
    If IsArrayAllocated(mArr) Then
        CountColumns = UBound(mArr, 2) - LBound(mArr, 2) + 1
    End If
End Property

Public Property Get CountRows() As Long
    If IsArrayAllocated(mArr) Then
        CountRows = UBound(mArr, 1) - LBound(mArr, 1) + 1
    End If
End Property

Public Property Get DataType() As SortDataType
    DataType = mDataType
End Property

'==========================================================================================
' PUBLIC METHODS
'==========================================================================================

'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'* Method: SortQuick
'* Purpose: Быстрая сортировка массива (алгоритм QuickSort)
'*
'* Parameters:
'*   vArr       - Двумерный массив для сортировки
'*   iCol       - Индекс столбца сортировки (по умолчанию - первый столбец)
'*   bSortUp    - True = по возрастанию (по умолчанию), False = по убыванию
'*   eDataType  - Тип данных: sdtString или sdtNumber
'*
'* Remarks:
'*   - In-place сортировка (без дополнительной памяти)
'*   - Неустойчивый алгоритм (может менять порядок равных элементов)
'*   - O(N log N) средняя сложность, O(N^2) худший случай
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Public Sub SortQuick(ByVal vArr As Variant, _
                     Optional ByVal iCol As Long = -1, _
                     Optional ByVal bSortUp As Boolean = True, _
                     Optional ByVal eDataType As SortDataType = sdtString)
    
    ' Валидация и инициализация
    Call ValidateArray(vArr, iCol)
    
    mArr = vArr
    mCol = iCol
    mSortUp = bSortUp
    mDataType = eDataType
    
    ' Инициализация генератора случайных чисел для медианы трёх
    Call Randomize
    
    ' Проверка на тривиальный случай (1 строка)
    If UBound(mArr, 1) - LBound(mArr, 1) < 1 Then Exit Sub
    
    Call QuickSortInternal(mArr, LBound(mArr, 1), UBound(mArr, 1), mCol, mSortUp, mDataType)
    
End Sub

'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'* Method: SortMerge
'* Purpose: Устойчивая сортировка массива (алгоритм MergeSort)
'*
'* Parameters:
'*   vArr       - Двумерный массив для сортировки
'*   iCol       - Индекс столбца сортировки (по умолчанию - первый столбец)
'*   bSortUp    - True = по возрастанию (по умолчанию), False = по убыванию
'*   eDataType  - Тип данных: sdtString или sdtNumber
'*
'* Remarks:
'*   - Устойчивый алгоритм (сохраняет порядок равных элементов)
'*   - Требует O(N) дополнительной памяти
'*   - O(N log N) гарантированная сложность
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Public Sub SortMerge(ByVal vArr As Variant, _
                     Optional ByVal iCol As Long = -1, _
                     Optional ByVal bSortUp As Boolean = True, _
                     Optional ByVal eDataType As SortDataType = sdtString)
    
    ' Валидация и инициализация
    Call ValidateArray(vArr, iCol)
    
    mArr = vArr
    mCol = iCol
    mSortUp = bSortUp
    mDataType = eDataType
    
    ' Проверка на тривиальный случай (1 строка)
    If UBound(mArr, 1) - LBound(mArr, 1) < 1 Then Exit Sub
    
    Call MergeSortInternal(mArr, LBound(mArr, 1), UBound(mArr, 1), mCol, mSortUp, mDataType)
    
End Sub

'==========================================================================================
' PRIVATE METHODS - VALIDATION
'==========================================================================================

Private Sub ValidateArray(ByRef vArr As Variant, ByRef iCol As Long)
    ' Проверка, что передан массив
    If Not IsArray(vArr) Then
        Err.Raise ERR_NOT_2D_ARRAY, "clsSort2DArray.ValidateArray", ERR_MSG_NOT_2D
    End If
    
    ' Проверка на пустой/неинициализированный массив
    If Not IsArrayAllocated(vArr) Then
        Err.Raise ERR_EMPTY_ARRAY, "clsSort2DArray.ValidateArray", ERR_MSG_EMPTY
    End If
    
    ' Проверка размерности (должен быть 2D)
    If ArrayDimensions(vArr) <> 2 Then
        Err.Raise ERR_NOT_2D_ARRAY, "clsSort2DArray.ValidateArray", ERR_MSG_NOT_2D
    End If
    
    ' Определение столбца сортировки
    If iCol < 0 Then
        iCol = LBound(vArr, 2)
    End If
    
    ' Проверка корректности индекса столбца
    If iCol < LBound(vArr, 2) Or iCol > UBound(vArr, 2) Then
        Err.Raise ERR_INVALID_COLUMN, "clsSort2DArray.ValidateArray", ERR_MSG_INVALID_COL
    End If
    
End Sub

Private Function IsArrayAllocated(ByRef vArr As Variant) As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim i As Long
    i = UBound(vArr, 1)
    IsArrayAllocated = Err.Number = 0
End Function

Private Function ArrayDimensions(ByRef vArr As Variant) As Integer
    On Error Resume Next
    
    Dim i As Integer
    i = 1
    Do
        i = i + 1
    Loop While UBound(vArr, i)
    
    ArrayDimensions = i - 1
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

'==========================================================================================
' PRIVATE METHODS - QUICKSORT
'==========================================================================================

Private Sub QuickSortInternal(ByRef pvarArray As Variant, _
                              ByVal lngLeft As Long, _
                              ByVal lngRight As Long, _
                              ByVal iCol As Long, _
                              ByVal bSortAsc As Boolean, _
                              ByVal eDataType As SortDataType)
    
    Dim lngFirst        As Long
    Dim lngLast         As Long
    Dim varPivot        As Variant
    Dim varSwap         As Variant
    Dim j               As Long
    Dim lngPivotIndex   As Long
    
    lngFirst = lngLeft
    lngLast = lngRight
    
    ' Выбор опорного элемента: медиана трёх
    lngPivotIndex = GetMedianOfThree(pvarArray, lngLeft, lngRight, iCol, eDataType)
    varPivot = GetComparableValue(pvarArray(lngPivotIndex, iCol), eDataType)
    
    Do
        ' Поиск элемента слева, который должен быть справа от опорного
        Do While lngFirst < lngRight
            If ShouldSwap(varPivot, pvarArray(lngFirst, iCol), eDataType, bSortAsc) Then
                Exit Do
            End If
            lngFirst = lngFirst + 1
        Loop
        
        ' Поиск элемента справа, который должен быть слева от опорного
        Do While lngLast > lngLeft
            If ShouldSwap(pvarArray(lngLast, iCol), varPivot, eDataType, bSortAsc) Then
                Exit Do
            End If
            lngLast = lngLast - 1
        Loop
        
        ' Обмен строк
        If lngFirst <= lngLast Then
            Call SwapRows(pvarArray, lngFirst, lngLast)
            lngFirst = lngFirst + 1
            lngLast = lngLast - 1
        End If
        
    Loop Until lngFirst > lngLast
    
    ' Рекурсивный вызов (оптимизация хвостовой рекурсии)
    If (lngLast - lngLeft) < (lngRight - lngFirst) Then
        If lngLeft < lngLast Then Call QuickSortInternal(pvarArray, lngLeft, lngLast, iCol, bSortAsc, eDataType)
        If lngFirst < lngRight Then Call QuickSortInternal(pvarArray, lngFirst, lngRight, iCol, bSortAsc, eDataType)
    Else
        If lngFirst < lngRight Then Call QuickSortInternal(pvarArray, lngFirst, lngRight, iCol, bSortAsc, eDataType)
        If lngLeft < lngLast Then Call QuickSortInternal(pvarArray, lngLeft, lngLast, iCol, bSortAsc, eDataType)
    End If
    
End Sub

Private Function GetMedianOfThree(ByRef pvarArray As Variant, _
                                   ByVal lngLeft As Long, _
                                   ByVal lngRight As Long, _
                                   ByVal iCol As Long, _
                                   ByVal eDataType As SortDataType) As Long
    
    Dim lngCount    As Long
    Dim a           As Long
    Dim b           As Long
    Dim c           As Long
    Dim vA          As Variant
    Dim vB          As Variant
    Dim vC          As Variant
    
    lngCount = lngRight - lngLeft + 1
    
    ' Три случайных индекса
    a = Int(lngCount * Rnd) + lngLeft
    b = Int(lngCount * Rnd) + lngLeft
    c = Int(lngCount * Rnd) + lngLeft
    
    ' Получение сравниваемых значений
    vA = GetComparableValue(pvarArray(a, iCol), eDataType)
    vB = GetComparableValue(pvarArray(b, iCol), eDataType)
    vC = GetComparableValue(pvarArray(c, iCol), eDataType)
    
    ' Определение медианы
    If (vA <= vB And vB <= vC) Or (vC <= vB And vB <= vA) Then
        GetMedianOfThree = b
    ElseIf (vB <= vA And vA <= vC) Or (vC <= vA And vA <= vB) Then
        GetMedianOfThree = a
    Else
        GetMedianOfThree = c
    End If
    
End Function

'==========================================================================================
' PRIVATE METHODS - MERGESORT
'==========================================================================================

Private Sub MergeSortInternal(ByRef pvarArray As Variant, _
                              ByVal lngLeft As Long, _
                              ByVal lngRight As Long, _
                              ByVal iCol As Long, _
                              ByVal bSortAsc As Boolean, _
                              ByVal eDataType As SortDataType)
    
    Dim lngMid As Long
    
    If lngLeft < lngRight Then
        lngMid = (lngLeft + lngRight) \ 2
        
        Call MergeSortInternal(pvarArray, lngLeft, lngMid, iCol, bSortAsc, eDataType)
        Call MergeSortInternal(pvarArray, lngMid + 1, lngRight, iCol, bSortAsc, eDataType)
        
        Call MergeArrays(pvarArray, lngLeft, lngMid, lngRight, iCol, bSortAsc, eDataType)
    End If
    
End Sub

Private Sub MergeArrays(ByRef pvarArray As Variant, _
                        ByVal lngLeft As Long, _
                        ByVal lngMid As Long, _
                        ByVal lngRight As Long, _
                        ByVal iCol As Long, _
                        ByVal bSortAsc As Boolean, _
                        ByVal eDataType As SortDataType)
    
    Dim i           As Long
    Dim j           As Long
    Dim k           As Long
    Dim n1          As Long
    Dim n2          As Long
    Dim lCol        As Long
    Dim uCol        As Long
    Dim c           As Long
    Dim LeftArr()   As Variant
    Dim RightArr()  As Variant
    
    n1 = lngMid - lngLeft + 1
    n2 = lngRight - lngMid
    
    lCol = LBound(pvarArray, 2)
    uCol = UBound(pvarArray, 2)
    
    ' Создание временных массивов
    ReDim LeftArr(1 To n1, lCol To uCol)
    ReDim RightArr(1 To n2, lCol To uCol)
    
    ' Копирование данных во временные массивы
    For i = 1 To n1
        For c = lCol To uCol
            LeftArr(i, c) = pvarArray(lngLeft + i - 1, c)
        Next c
    Next i
    
    For j = 1 To n2
        For c = lCol To uCol
            RightArr(j, c) = pvarArray(lngMid + j, c)
        Next c
    Next j
    
    ' Слияние
    i = 1
    j = 1
    k = lngLeft
    
    Do While i <= n1 And j <= n2
        If ShouldTakeLeft(LeftArr(i, iCol), RightArr(j, iCol), eDataType, bSortAsc) Then
            Call CopyRowToDest(LeftArr, i, pvarArray, k, lCol, uCol)
            i = i + 1
        Else
            Call CopyRowToDest(RightArr, j, pvarArray, k, lCol, uCol)
            j = j + 1
        End If
        k = k + 1
    Loop
    
    ' Копирование оставшихся элементов
    Do While i <= n1
        Call CopyRowToDest(LeftArr, i, pvarArray, k, lCol, uCol)
        i = i + 1
        k = k + 1
    Loop
    
    Do While j <= n2
        Call CopyRowToDest(RightArr, j, pvarArray, k, lCol, uCol)
        j = j + 1
        k = k + 1
    Loop
    
End Sub

'==========================================================================================
' PRIVATE METHODS - HELPERS
'==========================================================================================

Private Function GetComparableValue(ByVal vVal As Variant, ByVal eType As SortDataType) As Variant
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    
    If eType = sdtNumber Then
        If IsNumeric(vVal) Then
            GetComparableValue = CDbl(vVal)
        Else
            GetComparableValue = 0
        End If
    Else
        GetComparableValue = CStr(vVal)
    End If
    Exit Function
    
ErrHandler:
    GetComparableValue = IIf(eType = sdtNumber, 0, vbNullString)
End Function

Private Function ShouldSwap(ByVal vLeft As Variant, _
                            ByVal vRight As Variant, _
                            ByVal eDataType As SortDataType, _
                            ByVal bSortAsc As Boolean) As Boolean
    ' Возвращает True, если элементы нужно поменять местами
    Dim vLeftVal    As Variant
    Dim vRightVal   As Variant
    
    vLeftVal = GetComparableValue(vLeft, eDataType)
    vRightVal = GetComparableValue(vRight, eDataType)
    
    If bSortAsc Then
        ShouldSwap = vLeftVal < vRightVal
    Else
        ShouldSwap = vLeftVal > vRightVal
    End If
End Function

Private Function ShouldTakeLeft(ByVal vLeft As Variant, _
                                ByVal vRight As Variant, _
                                ByVal eDataType As SortDataType, _
                                ByVal bSortAsc As Boolean) As Boolean
    ' Для MergeSort: возвращает True, если нужно взять элемент из левого массива
    Dim vLeftVal    As Variant
    Dim vRightVal   As Variant
    
    vLeftVal = GetComparableValue(vLeft, eDataType)
    vRightVal = GetComparableValue(vRight, eDataType)
    
    If bSortAsc Then
        ShouldTakeLeft = vLeftVal <= vRightVal
    Else
        ShouldTakeLeft = vLeftVal >= vRightVal
    End If
End Function

Private Sub SwapRows(ByRef pvarArray As Variant, _
                     ByVal lngRow1 As Long, _
                     ByVal lngRow2 As Long)
    Dim c           As Long
    Dim varSwap     As Variant
    Dim lCol        As Long
    Dim uCol        As Long
    
    lCol = LBound(pvarArray, 2)
    uCol = UBound(pvarArray, 2)
    
    For c = lCol To uCol
        varSwap = pvarArray(lngRow1, c)
        pvarArray(lngRow1, c) = pvarArray(lngRow2, c)
        pvarArray(lngRow2, c) = varSwap
    Next c
End Sub

Private Sub CopyRowToDest(ByRef srcArr As Variant, _
                          ByVal srcRow As Long, _
                          ByRef destArr As Variant, _
                          ByVal destRow As Long, _
                          ByVal lCol As Long, _
                          ByVal uCol As Long)
    Dim c As Long
    
    For c = lCol To uCol
        destArr(destRow, c) = srcArr(srcRow, c)
    Next c
End Sub

Public Function arrTo2D(ByRef arr As Variant) As Variant
    If arrIs2D(arr) Then
        arrTo2D = arr
    Else
        Dim i       As Long
        Dim iCount  As Long
        iCount = UBound(arr, 1)
        ReDim newArr(1 To 1, 1 To iCount)
        For i = 1 To iCount
            newArr(1, i) = arr(i)
        Next i
        arrTo2D = newArr
    End If
End Function

Private Function arrIs2D(ByRef arr As Variant) As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    arrIs2D = True
    Dim i           As Byte
    i = UBound(arr, 2)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then arrIs2D = False
End Function

Public Function TransposeArray(ByVal sourceArray As Variant) As Variant
    ' Функция для транспонирования двумерного массива
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    ' 1. Проверка входных данных
    If Not IsArray(sourceArray) Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1, "TransposeArray", "Входной параметр не является массивом."
    End If

    Dim lowerRow    As Long
    Dim upperRow    As Long
    Dim lowerCol    As Long
    Dim upperCol    As Long

    ' 2. Определение границ исходного массива
    lowerRow = LBound(sourceArray, 1)
    upperRow = UBound(sourceArray, 1)
    lowerCol = LBound(sourceArray, 2)
    upperCol = UBound(sourceArray, 2)

    ' 3. Инициализация результирующего массива с swapped размерами
    Dim resultArray As Variant
    ReDim resultArray(lowerCol To upperCol, lowerRow To upperRow)

    Dim i           As Long
    Dim j           As Long

    ' 4. Цикл транспонирования
    For i = lowerCol To upperCol
        For j = lowerRow To upperRow
            resultArray(i, j) = sourceArray(j, i)
        Next j
    Next i

    ' 5. Возврат результата
    TransposeArray = resultArray
    Exit Function

ErrorHandler:
    ' Логирование ошибки или возврат Empty в зависимости от требований
    TransposeArray = Empty

Public Function UniqueValuesFromArray(ByVal arr As Variant, ByVal col As Long) As Variant
    ' Функция возвращает двумерный массив уникальных строк на основе уникальности значения в столбце col.
    ' Если входной массив некорректен или уникальные значения не найдены, возвращается Empty.
    

    ' --- 1. Проверка входных данных и определение границ ---
    If Not IsArray(arr) Then
        UniqueValuesFromArray = Empty
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Dim iColCount As Long
    Dim iLBoundRow As Long
    Dim iUBoundRow As Long
    
    On Error Resume Next
    iLBoundRow = LBound(arr, 1)
    iUBoundRow = UBound(arr, 1)
    iColCount = UBound(arr, 2)
    
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        ' Ошибка при получении границ (возможно, массив не двумерный)
        On Error GoTo 0
        UniqueValuesFromArray = Empty
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    ' Проверка, что номер столбца находится в допустимых пределах
    ' Примечание: предполагаем, что массив 1-based, как диапазоны Excel
    If col < LBound(arr, 2) Or col > iColCount Then
        UniqueValuesFromArray = Empty
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' --- 2. Сбор уникальных значений ---
    Dim i As Long
    Dim j As Long
    
    Dim coll As Collection
    Dim txtKey As String
    Dim txtItem As String
    
    Dim newArr() As Variant
    Dim arrItem As Variant
    
    Set coll = New Collection
    
    For i = iLBoundRow To iUBoundRow
        ' Формируем ключ для проверки уникальности (используем Trim и CStr для надежности)
        txtKey = Trim(CStr(arr(i, col)))
        
        ' Формируем строку со всеми значениями текущей строки
        txtItem = vbNullString
        For j = 1 To iColCount
            txtItem = txtItem & CStr(arr(i, j)) & "||"
        Next j
        
        ' Пытаемся добавить элемент. Ошибка игнорируется (означает дубликат ключа)
        On Error Resume Next
        coll.Add txtItem, txtKey
        On Error GoTo 0
    Next i
    
    ' --- 3. Формирование выходного массива ---
    If coll.Count = 0 Then
        UniqueValuesFromArray = Empty
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ReDim newArr(1 To coll.Count, 1 To iColCount)
    
    For i = 1 To coll.Count
        arrItem = VBA.Split(coll(i), "||")
        
        ' Заполняем выходной массив (Split возвращает 0-based массив)
        For j = 1 To iColCount
            ' Защита от выхода за пределы массива (на всякий случай)
            If j - 1 <= UBound(arrItem) Then
                newArr(i, j) = arrItem(j - 1)
            End If
        Next j
    Next i
    
    UniqueValuesFromArray = newArr
End Function

Public Function BlendColor(ByVal colorFirst As Long, colorSecond As Long, blendProcent As Single) As Long
    Dim r1 As Byte, g1 As Byte, b1 As Byte
    Dim r2 As Integer, g2 As Integer, b2 As Integer
    Dim r As Byte, g As Byte, b As Byte

    ' Extract BGR components from the first color (VBA uses BGR format)
    r1 = colorFirst Mod 256
    g1 = (colorFirst \ 256) Mod 256
    b1 = (colorFirst \ 65536) Mod 256

    ' Extract BGR components from the second color (VBA uses BGR format)
    r2 = colorSecond Mod 256
    g2 = (colorSecond \ 256) Mod 256
    b2 = (colorSecond \ 65536) Mod 256

    ' Blend the colors
    r = r1 + (r2 - r1) * blendProcent
    g = g1 + (g2 - g1) * blendProcent
    b = b1 + (b2 - b1) * blendProcent

    ' Return the blended color
    BlendColor = RGB(r, g, b)
End Function

Public Function FileHave(ByVal Path As String, ByVal fileAttribute As VbFileAttribute) As Boolean
    Dim fso         As Object

    ' Проверка на пустоту
    If Path = vbNullString Then Exit Function
    ' Создаем объект FileSystemObject
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    ' В зависимости от значения параметра IsFolder выбираем метод проверки
    Select Case fileAttribute
        Case VbFileAttribute.vbDirectory
            ' Ищем папку
            FileHave = fso.FolderExists(Path)
        Case VbFileAttribute.vbNormal
            ' Ищем файл
            FileHave = fso.FileExists(Path)
    End Select
    ' Освобождаем память
    Set fso = Nothing
End Function

Private Function GetSheetNameCloseBook(ByVal FulNameFile As String, _
                                       Optional sFileExists As String = "*.xls, *.xlsx, *.xlsm, *.xlsb") As String()

    'FulNameFile - текстовы формат, полное название файла

    Dim TN     As String
    Dim Cnn    As Object    'ADODB.Connection
    Dim rS     As Object    'ADODB.Recordset
    Dim n      As Integer
    Dim arrName() As String

    Const adSchemaTables As Byte = 20

    On Error Resume Next

    Set Cnn = CreateObject("ADODB.Connection")
    Set rS = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")

    Cnn.Open "Driver={Microsoft Excel Driver (" & sFileExists & ")};DBQ=" & FulNameFile & ";ReadOnly=1"
    Set rS = Cnn.OpenSchema(adSchemaTables)
    n = 0
    Do While Not rS.EOF
        TN = rS("TABLE_NAME")
        If Left(TN, 1) = "'" Then TN = Mid(TN, 2)

        If Len(TN) < InStr(1, TN, "$") + 2 Then
            TN = Left(TN, InStr(1, TN, "$") - 1)
            TN = Replace(TN, "#", ".")
            ReDim Preserve arrName(0 To n)
            arrName(n) = TN
            n = n + 1
        End If
        rS.MoveNext
    Loop
    rS.Close
    Set Cnn = Nothing
    Set rS = Nothing
    GetSheetNameCloseBook = arrName
End Function

Public Function MD5(ByVal sIn As String, Optional bB64 As Boolean = 0) As String
    'Set a reference to mscorlib 4.0 64-bit
    'Check that Net Framework 3.5 (includes .Net 2 and .Net 3 is installed in windows
    'and not just Net Advanced Services
        
    'Test with empty string input:
    'Hex:   d41d8cd98f00...etc
    'Base-64: 1B2M2Y8Asg...etc
        
    Dim oT As Object, oMD5 As Object
    Dim TextToHash() As Byte
    Dim bytes() As Byte
        
    Set oT = CreateObject("System.Text.UTF8Encoding")
    Set oMD5 = CreateObject("System.Security.Cryptography.MD5CryptoServiceProvider")

    If bB64 = True Then
       MD5 = ConvToBase64String(bytes)

       MD5 = ConvToHexString(bytes)
    End If
        
    Set oT = Nothing
    Set oMD5 = Nothing

End Function

Function StrToSHA512Salt(ByVal sIn As String, ByVal sSecretKey As String, _
                           Optional ByVal b64 As Boolean = False) As String
    'Returns a sha512 STRING HASH in function name, modified by the parameter sSecretKey.
    'This hash differs from that of SHA512 using the SHA512Managed class.
    'HMAC class inputs are hashed twice;first input and key are mixed before hashing,
    'then the key is mixed with the result and hashed again.
    'Check that Net Framework 3.5 (includes .Net 2 and .Net 3 is installed in windows
    'and not just Net Advanced Services
    
    Dim asc As Object, enc As Object
    Dim TextToHash() As Byte
    Dim SecretKey() As Byte
    Dim bytes() As Byte
    
    'Test results with both strings empty:
    '128 Hex:    b936cee86c9f...etc
    '88 Base-64:   uTbO6Gyfh6pd...etc
    
    'create text and crypto objects
    Set asc = CreateObject("System.Text.UTF8Encoding")
    
    'Any of HMACSHAMD5,HMACSHA1,HMACSHA256,HMACSHA384,or HMACSHA512 can be used
    'for corresponding hashes, albeit not matching those of Managed classes.
    Set enc = CreateObject("System.Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA512")

    'make a byte array of the text to hash
    bytes = asc.Getbytes_4(sIn)
    'make a byte array of the private key
    SecretKey = asc.Getbytes_4(sSecretKey)
    'add the private key property to the encryption object
    enc.Key = SecretKey

    'make a byte array of the hash
    bytes = enc.ComputeHash_2((bytes))
    
    'convert the byte array to string
    If b64 = True Then
       StrToSHA512Salt = ConvToBase64String(bytes)
    Else
       StrToSHA512Salt = ConvToHexString(bytes)
    End If
    
    'release object variables
    Set asc = Nothing
    Set enc = Nothing

End Function

Private Function ConvToBase64String(vIn As Variant) As Variant
    'Check that Net Framework 3.5 (includes .Net 2 and .Net 3 is installed in windows
    'and not just Net Advanced Services
   
   Dim oD As Object
      
    Set oD = CreateObject("MSXML2.DOMDocument")
      With oD
        .LoadXML "<root />"
        .DocumentElement.DataType = "bin.base64"
        .DocumentElement.nodeTypedValue = vIn
      End With
    ConvToBase64String = Replace(oD.DocumentElement.Text, vbLf, "")
    
    Set oD = Nothing

End Function

Private Function ConvToHexString(vIn As Variant) As Variant
    'Check that Net Framework 3.5 (includes .Net 2 and .Net 3 is installed in windows
    'and not just Net Advanced Services
    
    Dim oD As Object
      
    Set oD = CreateObject("MSXML2.DOMDocument")
      
      With oD
        .LoadXML "<root />"
        .DocumentElement.DataType = "bin.Hex"
        .DocumentElement.nodeTypedValue = vIn
      End With
    ConvToHexString = Replace(oD.DocumentElement.Text, vbLf, "")
    
    Set oD = Nothing

End Function

* Sub        : StatusBarVBATools
'* Created    : 09-12-2020 20:19
'* Author     : VBATools
'* Contacts   : http://vbatools.ru/ https://vk.com/vbatools
'* Copyright  : VBATools.ru
'* Argument(s):                                     Description
'*
'* ByVal iItem As Long                           : номер элемента
'* ByVal ICOUNT As Long                          : количество элементов
'* Optional iNumberCharacters As Byte = 40       : длина статус бара в символах
'* Optional sChar1 As String = "|"               : первый символ который появляется, использовать символы одинаковой ширины. Пример: | . , ! пробел и др.
'* Optional sChar2 As String = " "               : второй символ который исчезает, использовать символы одинаковой ширины
'* Optional iDiscrete As Integer = 1             : обновление статус бара, 1-для каждого iTem, 2-только для четных, 100-каждый сотый
'* Optional bReversPct As Boolean = True         : True изменение процентов от 0->100%, False 100->0%
'* Optional sStringTemp As String = vbNullString : Произвольный текст в конце

Private Sub StatusBarVBATools(ByVal iItem As Long, ByVal ICOUNT As Long, Optional iNumberCharacters As Byte = 40, _
        Optional sChar1 As String = "|", Optional sChar2 As String = " ", _
        Optional iDiscrete As Integer = 1, Optional bReversPct As Boolean = True, Optional sStringTemp As String = vbNullString)

    Dim CurrentStatus As Integer
    Dim pctDone     As Integer

    If iItem > ICOUNT Then
        Application.StatusBar = False
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If iItem Mod iDiscrete = 0 Then
        If iNumberCharacters > 230 Then iNumberCharacters = 230
        CurrentStatus = Int((iItem / ICOUNT) * iNumberCharacters)
        If bReversPct Then
            pctDone = CurrentStatus / iNumberCharacters * 100
        Else
            pctDone = (1 - CurrentStatus / iNumberCharacters) * 100
        End If
        Application.StatusBar = "[" & VBA.String$(CurrentStatus, sChar1) & VBA.String$(iNumberCharacters - CurrentStatus, sChar2) & "]" & " " & pctDone & "%" & sStringTemp
        DoEvents
    End If
    If iItem = ICOUNT Then Application.StatusBar = False
End Sub

Public Sub WriterLog(ByVal sNameFunc As String, ByVal logLevel As LOG_LEVEL, Optional sMsg As String = vbNullString)
    Dim bDebug      As Boolean
    bDebug = True

    Const MESSAGE As String = "Message     : "
    Const NEW_LINE_TAB As String = vbCrLf & vbTab

    Select Case logLevel
            Case eINFO
            If sMsg <> vbNullString And bDebug Then Debug.Print ">> [INFO] " & sNameFunc & NEW_LINE_TAB & MESSAGE & sMsg
        Case eWARNING
            If sMsg <> vbNullString And bDebug Then Debug.Print ">> [WARNING] " & sNameFunc & NEW_LINE_TAB & MESSAGE & sMsg
        Case eERROR
            If Err.Number <> 0 Then
                Dim errMsg As String
                errMsg = ">> [ERROR] " & sNameFunc
                If sMsg <> vbNullString Then errMsg = errMsg & NEW_LINE_TAB & MESSAGE & sMsg
                errMsg = errMsg & NEW_LINE_TAB & "Error Number: " & Err.Number & NEW_LINE_TAB & "Description : " & Err.DESCRIPTION
                If Erl > 0 Then errMsg = errMsg & NEW_LINE_TAB & "At line     : " & Erl
                Debug.Print errMsg
            End If
    End Select
End Sub

'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'*  Class: clsAnchors
'*  Author: VBATools
'*  Version: 1.1.0
'*  Creation Date: 03.05.2019 09:31
'*  Last Update Date: 12.11.2025 23:57
'*  License: Apache License
'*  Description: Provides anchor-based resizing for MSForms UserForm controls
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

'==========================================================================================
' ENUMERATIONS
'==========================================================================================

Public Enum AnchorEdge
    anchorNone = 0
    anchorTop = 1
    anchorBottom = 2
    anchorLeft = 4
    anchorRight = 8
End Enum

Private Enum ControlParamIndex
    idxAnchorStyle = 1
    idxMinimumWidth
    idxMinimumHeight
    idxMinimumTop
    idxMinimumLeft
    idxOriginalLeft
    idxOriginalTop
    idxOriginalWidth
    idxOriginalHeight
    idxControlName
    [_First] = idxAnchorStyle
    [_Last] = idxControlName
End Enum

'==========================================================================================
' CONSTANTS
'==========================================================================================

Private Const CLASS_NAME As String = "clsAnchors"
Private Const CLASS_VERSION As String = "1.1.0"

Private Const RESIZE_HANDLE_SUFFIX As String = "ResizeGrabHandle"
Private Const HANDLE_SUFFIX_BOTTOM As String = "_BOTTOM"
Private Const HANDLE_SUFFIX_RIGHT As String = "_RIGHT"

Private Const MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT As Integer = 1

Private Const DEFAULT_HANDLE_SIZE As Single = 2
Private Const DEFAULT_HANDLE_FONT_SIZE As Single = 14
Private Const HANDLE_COLOR As Long = &HC0C0C0

'==========================================================================================
' MODULE-LEVEL VARIABLES
'==========================================================================================

' Parent form reference
Private mParent As Object

' Collection of control parameters
Private mItems As Collection

' Resize handles
Private WithEvents mResizeHandle As MSForms.Label
Private WithEvents mResizeHandleBottom As MSForms.Label
Private WithEvents mResizeHandleRight As MSForms.Label

' State flags
Private mIsResizing As Boolean
Private mUpdateWhileDragging As Boolean
Private mIsInitialized As Boolean

' Resize tracking
Private mResizeStartX As Single
Private mResizeStartY As Single

' Form dimension constraints
Private mMinWidth As Single
Private mMinHeight As Single
Private mMaxHeight As Single
Private mMaxWidth As Single

' Original form dimensions
Private mOriginalInsideWidth As Single
Private mOriginalInsideHeight As Single

' Control count at initialization
Private mControlCount As Integer

' Handle base name
Private mHandleBaseName As String

'==========================================================================================
' PUBLIC PROPERTIES
'==========================================================================================

Public Property Get Version() As String
    Version = "Class: " & CLASS_NAME & vbNewLine & _
              "Author: VBATools" & vbNewLine & _
              "Version: " & CLASS_VERSION & vbNewLine & _
              "Creation Date: 03.05.2019 09:31" & vbNewLine & _
              "Last Update: 12.11.2025 23:57" & vbNewLine & _
              "License: Apache License" & vbNewLine & _
              "Description: Anchor-based control resizing for UserForms"
End Property

Public Property Get CountAnchors() As Byte
    If Not mItems Is Nothing Then
        CountAnchors = mItems.Count
    End If
End Property

'==========================================================================================
' PUBLIC METHODS
'==========================================================================================

Public Sub Initialize(ByVal objParent As Object, _
                       Optional ByVal MaximumHeight As Single, _
                       Optional ByVal MaximumWidth As Single)
    
    If mIsInitialized Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1, CLASS_NAME, "The class has already been initialized"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    If objParent Is Nothing Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3, CLASS_NAME, "Parent object cannot be Nothing"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Call CreateResizeHandles(objParent, MaximumHeight, MaximumWidth)
    Call InitializeControlCollection
    Call SetDefaultHandleAnchors
    
    mIsInitialized = True
    
End Sub

Public Sub SetAnchorStyleByName(ByVal ControlName As String, _
                                 ByVal anchorStyle As AnchorEdge)
    
    If mItems Is Nothing Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 2, CLASS_NAME, "Item collection not initialized"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Dim controlParams As Variant
    Dim i As Integer
    
    On Error Resume Next
    controlParams = mItems(ControlName)
    
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4, CLASS_NAME, "Control '" & ControlName & "' not found"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxAnchorStyle) = anchorStyle
    
    mItems.Remove ControlName
    mItems.Add controlParams, ControlName
    
End Sub

'==========================================================================================
' PRIVATE METHODS - INITIALIZATION
'==========================================================================================

Private Sub CreateResizeHandles(ByVal objParent As Object, _
                                 ByVal MaximumHeight As Single, _
                                 ByVal MaximumWidth As Single)
    
    mHandleBaseName = objParent.Name & RESIZE_HANDLE_SUFFIX
    
    ' Create corner handle (diagonal resize)
    Call CreateCornerHandle(objParent)
    
    ' Create bottom edge handle (vertical resize)
    Call CreateBottomHandle(objParent)
    
    ' Create right edge handle (horizontal resize)
    Call CreateRightHandle(objParent)
    
    ' Store parent reference and initialize dimensions
    Set mParent = objParent
    
    With objParent
        mMinWidth = .Width
        mMinHeight = .Height
        mOriginalInsideWidth = .InsideWidth
        mOriginalInsideHeight = .InsideHeight
    End With
    
    ' Set maximum dimensions (default to minimum if not specified)
    mMaxHeight = IIf(MaximumHeight > 0, MaximumHeight, mMinHeight)
    mMaxWidth = IIf(MaximumWidth > 0, MaximumWidth, mMinWidth)
    
    mControlCount = mParent.Controls.Count
    Set mItems = New Collection
    mUpdateWhileDragging = True
    
End Sub

Private Sub CreateCornerHandle(ByVal objParent As Object)
    
    Set mResizeHandle = objParent.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", mHandleBaseName, True)
    
    With mResizeHandle
        With .Font
            .Name = "Marlett"
            .Charset = 2
            .Size = DEFAULT_HANDLE_FONT_SIZE
            .Bold = True
        End With
        
        .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .AutoSize = True
        .BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleNone
        .Caption = "o"
        .MousePointer = fmMousePointerSizeNWSE
        .ForeColor = HANDLE_COLOR
        .ZOrder
        .Top = objParent.InsideHeight - .Height
        .Left = objParent.InsideWidth - .Width
    End With
    
End Sub

Private Sub CreateBottomHandle(ByVal objParent As Object)
    
    Set mResizeHandleBottom = objParent.Controls.Add( _
        "Forms.Label.1", _
        mHandleBaseName & HANDLE_SUFFIX_BOTTOM, _
        True)
    
    With mResizeHandleBottom
        .MousePointer = fmMousePointerSizeNS
        .ZOrder
        .Left = 0
        .Height = DEFAULT_HANDLE_SIZE
        .Top = objParent.InsideHeight - .Height
        .Width = objParent.InsideWidth
    End With
    
End Sub

Private Sub CreateRightHandle(ByVal objParent As Object)
    
    Set mResizeHandleRight = objParent.Controls.Add( _
        "Forms.Label.1", _
        mHandleBaseName & HANDLE_SUFFIX_RIGHT, _
        True)
    
    With mResizeHandleRight
        .MousePointer = fmMousePointerSizeWE
        .ZOrder
        .Width = DEFAULT_HANDLE_SIZE
        .Left = objParent.InsideWidth - .Width
        .Height = objParent.InsideHeight
        .Top = 0
    End With
    
End Sub

Private Sub InitializeControlCollection()
    
    Dim controlParams() As Variant
    ReDim controlParams(ControlParamIndex.[_First] To ControlParamIndex.[_Last]) As Variant
    
    Dim i As Integer
    
    For i = 0 To mControlCount - 1
        With mParent.Controls(i)
            controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxAnchorStyle) = anchorLeft Or anchorTop
            controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxMinimumWidth) = .Width
            controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxMinimumHeight) = .Height
            controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxMinimumTop) = .Top
            controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxMinimumLeft) = .Left
            controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalLeft) = .Left
            controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalTop) = .Top
            controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalWidth) = .Width
            controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalHeight) = .Height
            controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxControlName) = .Name
            
            mItems.Add controlParams, .Name
        End With
    Next i
    
End Sub

Private Sub SetDefaultHandleAnchors()
    
    Call SetAnchorStyleByName( _
        mHandleBaseName & HANDLE_SUFFIX_BOTTOM, _
        anchorBottom Or anchorRight Or anchorLeft)
    
    Call SetAnchorStyleByName( _
        mHandleBaseName & HANDLE_SUFFIX_RIGHT, _
        anchorBottom Or anchorRight Or anchorTop)
    
End Sub

'==========================================================================================
' PRIVATE METHODS - MOUSE EVENT HANDLERS
'==========================================================================================

' --- MouseDown Events ---

Private Sub mResizeHandle_MouseDown(ByVal Button As Integer, _
                                     ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                                     ByVal X As Single, _
                                     ByVal Y As Single)
    Call HandleMouseDown(Button, X, Y)
End Sub

Private Sub mResizeHandleBottom_MouseDown(ByVal Button As Integer, _
                                           ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                                           ByVal X As Single, _
                                           ByVal Y As Single)
    Call HandleMouseDown(Button, X, Y)
End Sub

Private Sub mResizeHandleRight_MouseDown(ByVal Button As Integer, _
                                          ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                                          ByVal X As Single, _
                                          ByVal Y As Single)
    Call HandleMouseDown(Button, X, Y)
End Sub

' --- MouseUp Events ---

Private Sub mResizeHandle_MouseUp(ByVal Button As Integer, _
                                   ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                                   ByVal X As Single, _
                                   ByVal Y As Single)
    Call HandleMouseUp(Button)
End Sub

Private Sub mResizeHandleBottom_MouseUp(ByVal Button As Integer, _
                                         ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                                         ByVal X As Single, _
                                         ByVal Y As Single)
    Call HandleMouseUp(Button)
End Sub

Private Sub mResizeHandleRight_MouseUp(ByVal Button As Integer, _
                                        ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                                        ByVal X As Single, _
                                        ByVal Y As Single)
    Call HandleMouseUp(Button)
End Sub

' --- MouseMove Events ---

Private Sub mResizeHandle_MouseMove(ByVal Button As Integer, _
                                     ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                                     ByVal X As Single, _
                                     ByVal Y As Single)
    
    If Button <> MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT Or Not mIsResizing Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim newWidth As Single
    Dim newHeight As Single
    
    newWidth = CalculateNewDimension(mParent.Width, X - mResizeStartX, mMinWidth, mMaxWidth)
    newHeight = CalculateNewDimension(mParent.Height, Y - mResizeStartY, mMinHeight, mMaxHeight)
    
    mParent.Width = newWidth
    mParent.Height = newHeight
    
    Call UpdateHandlePositions
    Call UpdateControlsIfNeeded
    
End Sub

Private Sub mResizeHandleBottom_MouseMove(ByVal Button As Integer, _
                                           ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                                           ByVal X As Single, _
                                           ByVal Y As Single)
    
    If Button <> MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT Or Not mIsResizing Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim newHeight As Single
    
    newHeight = CalculateNewDimension(mParent.Height, Y - mResizeStartY, mMinHeight, mMaxHeight)
    mParent.Height = newHeight
    
    Call UpdateHandlePositions
    Call UpdateControlsIfNeeded
    
End Sub

Private Sub mResizeHandleRight_MouseMove(ByVal Button As Integer, _
                                          ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                                          ByVal X As Single, _
                                          ByVal Y As Single)
    
    If Button <> MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT Or Not mIsResizing Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim newWidth As Single
    
    newWidth = CalculateNewDimension(mParent.Width, X - mResizeStartX, mMinWidth, mMaxWidth)
    mParent.Width = newWidth
    
    Call UpdateHandlePositions
    Call UpdateControlsIfNeeded
    
End Sub

'==========================================================================================
' PRIVATE METHODS - MOUSE HANDLER HELPERS
'==========================================================================================

Private Sub HandleMouseDown(ByVal Button As Integer, _
                             ByVal X As Single, _
                             ByVal Y As Single)
    
    If Button = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT Then
        mResizeStartX = X
        mResizeStartY = Y
        mIsResizing = True
    End If
    
End Sub

Private Sub HandleMouseUp(ByVal Button As Integer)
    
    If Button = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT Then
        If Not mUpdateWhileDragging Then
            Call UpdateControlPositions
        End If
        mIsResizing = False
    End If
    
End Sub

Private Function CalculateNewDimension(ByVal currentValue As Single, _
                                         ByVal delta As Single, _
                                         ByVal minValue As Single, _
                                         ByVal maxValue As Single) As Single
    
    Dim result As Single
    result = currentValue + delta
    
    ' Clamp to min/max bounds
    If result < minValue Then
        result = minValue
    ElseIf result > maxValue Then
        result = maxValue
    End If
    
    CalculateNewDimension = result
    
End Function

Private Sub UpdateHandlePositions()
    
    With mResizeHandle
        .Left = mParent.InsideWidth - .Width
        .Top = mParent.InsideHeight - .Height
    End With
    
    With mResizeHandleBottom
        .Top = mParent.InsideHeight - .Height
        .Width = mParent.InsideWidth
    End With
    
    With mResizeHandleRight
        .Left = mParent.InsideWidth - .Width
        .Height = mParent.InsideHeight
    End With
    
End Sub

Private Sub UpdateControlsIfNeeded()
    If mUpdateWhileDragging Then Call UpdateControlPositions
End Sub

'==========================================================================================
' PRIVATE METHODS - CONTROL POSITIONING
'==========================================================================================

Private Sub UpdateControlPositions()
    
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim controlParams As Variant
    Dim anchorStyle As AnchorEdge
    
    For i = 0 To mControlCount - 1
        controlParams = mItems(mParent.Controls(i).Name)
        anchorStyle = controlParams(ControlParamIndex.idxAnchorStyle)
        
        If anchorStyle <> anchorNone Then
            Call ApplyAnchorStyle(i, controlParams, anchorStyle)
        End If
    Next i
    
    DoEvents
    
End Sub

Private Sub ApplyAnchorStyle(ByVal controlIndex As Integer, _
                              ByVal params As Variant, _
                              ByVal anchorStyle As AnchorEdge)
    
    Dim hasTop As Boolean
    Dim hasBottom As Boolean
    Dim hasLeft As Boolean
    Dim hasRight As Boolean
    
    hasTop = (anchorStyle And anchorTop) = anchorTop
    hasBottom = (anchorStyle And anchorBottom) = anchorBottom
    hasLeft = (anchorStyle And anchorLeft) = anchorLeft
    hasRight = (anchorStyle And anchorRight) = anchorRight
    
    ' Apply vertical anchoring
    Call ApplyVerticalAnchor(controlIndex, params, hasTop, hasBottom)
    
    ' Apply horizontal anchoring
    Call ApplyHorizontalAnchor(controlIndex, params, hasLeft, hasRight)
    
End Sub

Private Sub ApplyVerticalAnchor(ByVal controlIndex As Integer, _
                                 ByVal params As Variant, _
                                 ByVal hasTop As Boolean, _
                                 ByVal hasBottom As Boolean)
    
    Dim newHeight As Single
    Dim newTop As Single
    
    With mParent
        If hasTop And hasBottom Then
            ' Stretch vertically - adjust height
            newHeight = .InsideHeight - (mOriginalInsideHeight - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalTop) - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalHeight)) - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalTop)
            newHeight = ClampValue(newHeight, params(ControlParamIndex.idxMinimumHeight))
            .Controls(controlIndex).Height = newHeight
            
        ElseIf hasBottom Then
            ' Anchor to bottom - adjust top position
            newTop = .InsideHeight - (mOriginalInsideHeight - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalTop) - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalHeight)) - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalHeight)
            newTop = ClampValue(newTop, params(ControlParamIndex.idxMinimumTop))
            .Controls(controlIndex).Top = newTop
            
        ' ElseIf hasTop Only - no change needed
        End If
    End With
    
End Sub

Private Sub ApplyHorizontalAnchor(ByVal controlIndex As Integer, _
                                   ByVal params As Variant, _
                                   ByVal hasLeft As Boolean, _
                                   ByVal hasRight As Boolean)
    
    Dim newWidth As Single
    Dim newLeft As Single
    
    With mParent
        If hasLeft And hasRight Then
            ' Stretch horizontally - adjust width
            newWidth = .InsideWidth - (mOriginalInsideWidth - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalLeft) - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalWidth)) - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalLeft)
            newWidth = ClampValue(newWidth, params(ControlParamIndex.idxMinimumWidth))
            .Controls(controlIndex).Width = newWidth
            
        ElseIf hasRight Then
            ' Anchor to right - adjust left position
            newLeft = .InsideWidth - (mOriginalInsideWidth - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalLeft) - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalWidth)) - params(ControlParamIndex.idxOriginalWidth)
            newLeft = ClampValue(newLeft, params(ControlParamIndex.idxMinimumLeft))
            .Controls(controlIndex).Left = newLeft
            
        ' ElseIf hasLeft Only - no change needed
        End If
    End With
    
End Sub

Private Function ClampValue(ByVal value As Single, ByVal minValue As Single) As Single
    
    If value < minValue Then
        value = minValue
    End If
    
    If value < 0 Then
        value = 0
    End If
    
    ClampValue = value
    
End Function

Private Sub errRaise()

Public Sub addItem(ByRef label As MSForms.label, _
        ByVal OutIconCodeOn As String, _
        ByVal OutIconCodeOff As String, _
        ByVal OutColorOff As XlRgbColor, _
        ByVal OutColorOn As XlRgbColor, _
        ByVal InIconCodeOn As String, _
        ByVal InIconCodeOff As String, _
        ByVal InColorOff As XlRgbColor, _
        ByVal InColorOn As XlRgbColor)

    Dim itemCls     As clsButtonIcon
    Set itemCls = New clsButtonIcon

    With itemCls
        Set .LabelMain = label
        .Name = .LabelMain.Name
        .SizeOut = label.height
        .SizeIn = .SizeOut * 0.75
        .IconCodeOutOn = OutIconCodeOn
        .IconCodeOutOff = OutIconCodeOff
        .ColorOutOn = OutColorOn
        .ColorOutOff = OutColorOff
        .IconCodeInOn = InIconCodeOn
        .IconCodeInOff = InIconCodeOff
        .ColorInOn = InColorOn
        .ColorInOff = InColorOff

        With .LabelMain
            Set itemCls.LabelOut = .Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", .Name & "_OUT")
            Set itemCls.LabelIn = .Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", .Name & "_IN")
            .width = itemCls.SizeOut
            .BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleNone
            .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
            .Caption = vbNullString
        End With
        With .LabelOut
            .top = itemCls.LabelMain.top
            .left = itemCls.LabelMain.left
            .width = itemCls.SizeOut
            .height = itemCls.SizeOut
            .Font.Size = itemCls.SizeOut * 0.9
            .Font.Name = FONT_NAME_ICON
            .Caption = itemCls.IconCodeOutOn
            .TextAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
            .ForeColor = OutColorOn
            '.BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleSingle
        End With

    With item.LabelOut
        If .Caption <> item.IconCodeOutOn Then
            .Caption = item.IconCodeOutOn
        Else
            .Caption = item.IconCodeOutOff
        End If
        If .ForeColor <> item.ColorOutOn Then
            .ForeColor = item.ColorOutOn
        Else
            .ForeColor = item.ColorOutOff
        End If
    End With
    With item.LabelIn
        If .Caption <> item.IconCodeInOn Then
            .Caption = item.IconCodeInOn
        Else
            .Caption = item.IconCodeInOff
        End If
        If .ForeColor <> item.ColorInOn Then
            .ForeColor = item.ColorInOn
        Else
            .ForeColor = item.ColorInOff
        End If
    End With
End Sub

Public Sub addDatePicker(ByRef TextBox As MSForms.TextBox, _
        Optional SetDate As Date = 0, _
        Optional minDate As Date = 0, _
        Optional maxDate As Date = 0, _
        Optional TypeCalendar As enTypeCalendar = enTypeCalendar.enDay, _
        Optional FormatDate As String = vbNullString, _
        Optional ForeColorBtn As XlRgbColor = rgbBlack, _
        Optional RightBtn As Boolean = True, _
        Optional VisibleBtn As Boolean = True, _
        Optional ForeColorTitle As XlRgbColor = &H80&, _
        Optional IconCode As enIconCalendar = enIconCalendar.icCalendar, _
        Optional NolorSelectedDate As XlRgbColor = 12632319, _
        Optional ColorMove As XlRgbColor = 14737632, _
        Optional ForeColorDayYes As XlRgbColor = rgbBlack, _
        Optional ForeColorDayNo As XlRgbColor = 8421504)
        
    If minDate > maxDate Then
        Call Err.Raise(vbObjectError + 101, "clsCalendarDate", "the minimum date:[ & MinDate & ] is greater than the maximum:[ & MaxDate & ]")
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set mTextBox = TextBox
    Set mParent = mTextBox.Parent
    With mTextBox
        Set mLbBtn = mParent.Controls.Add("Forms.label.1", .Name & "_lb_btn", True)
    End With

    mForeColorTitle = ForeColorTitle
    mFormatDate = VBA.LCase$(FormatDate)
    mColorSelectedDate = NolorSelectedDate
    mColorMove = ColorMove
    mForeColorDayYes = ForeColorDayYes
    mForeColorDayNo = ForeColorDayNo
    mMinDate = minDate
    mMaxDate = maxDate

    Select Case TypeCalendar
        Case enTypeCalendar.enDay
            If mFormatDate = vbNullString Then mFormatDate = "dd.mm.yyyy"
            If SetDate = 0 Then SetDate = VBA.Date()
            mTextBox.Value = VBA.Format$(SetDate, mFormatDate)
        Case enTypeCalendar.enMount
            If SetDate = 0 Then
                mTextBox.Value = VBA.Month(VBA.Date())
            Else
                mTextBox.Value = VBA.Month(SetDate)
            End If
            Select Case mFormatDate
                Case "mm"
                    mTextBox.Value = VBA.MonthName(mTextBox.Value, True)
                Case "mmmm"
                    mTextBox.Value = VBA.MonthName(mTextBox.Value, False)
            End Select
        Case enTypeCalendar.enYear
            mFormatDate = vbNullString
            If SetDate = 0 Then
                mTextBox.Value = VBA.Year(VBA.Date())
            Else
                mTextBox.Value = VBA.Year(SetDate)
            End If
    End Select

    mRightBtn = RightBtn
    mTypeCalendar = TypeCalendar

    With mLbBtn
        .Height = mTextBox.Height
        .Width = .Height
        .Font.Size = .Height * 0.65
        .Font.Name = "Segoe MDL2 Assets"
        .Caption = VBA.ChrW$(IconCode)
        .TextAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
        .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .Font.Bold = True
        .ForeColor = ForeColorBtn
        .Top = mTextBox.Top + 2
        If RightBtn Then
            .Left = mTextBox.Left + mTextBox.Width
        Else
            .Left = mTextBox.Left - .Width
        End If
        .ZOrder 0
        .Visible = VisibleBtn
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub mTextBox_DblClick(ByVal Cancel As MSForms.ReturnBoolean)
    Cancel = True
    Call SetValueTextBox
End Sub

Private Sub mLbBtn_Click()
    Call SetValueTextBox
End Sub

Private Sub SetValueTextBox()
    Dim sVal        As String
    Set frmCalendar = New frmDatepickerform
    With frmCalendar
        .redBG.BackColor = mForeColorTitle
        sVal = mTextBox.Value
        If sVal = vbNullString Then sVal = VBA.Date()
        If Not IsDate(sVal) Then sVal = VBA.Date()
        .DateGlobal = VBA.CDate(sVal)
        .pickerMode = mTypeCalendar
        .ColorSelectedDate = mColorSelectedDate
        .ColorMove = mColorMove
        .ForeColorDayYes = mForeColorDayYes
        .ForeColorDayNo = mForeColorDayNo
        .lbMinDate = mMinDate
        .lbMaxDate = mMaxDate

        Select Case mTypeCalendar
            Case enTypeCalendar.enDay
                .lbTypeCalendar.Caption = 0
            Case enTypeCalendar.enMount
                .lbTypeCalendar.Caption = 1
                .iSelectGlobal = VBA.Month(VBA.Date())
            Case enTypeCalendar.enYear
                .lbTypeCalendar.Caption = 1
                .iSelectGlobal = VBA.Year(VBA.Date())
        End Select

        Call .Show(1)
        sVal = .lbDateChose.Caption
        If sVal <> vbNullString Then
            mTextBox.Value = VBA.Format$(sVal, mFormatDate)
            If mTypeCalendar = enMount Then
                Select Case mFormatDate
                    Case "mm"
                        mTextBox.Value = VBA.MonthName(sVal, True)
                    Case "mmmm"
                        mTextBox.Value = VBA.MonthName(sVal, False)
                End Select
            End If
        End If
    End With
    Set frmCalendar = Nothing
End Sub

Private Sub SetControlBackColorUnderline(day)

    If iDayForm <> 0 Then

        If iDayForm <> day Then

            If iDayForm <= 67 Then

                Me.Controls("daybg" & iDayForm).BackColor = colorWhite

                SwitchColorControl Me.Controls("daybg" & iDayForm)

            ElseIf iDayForm = 68 Then

                datetimebg.BackColor = colorWhite

            ElseIf iDayForm = 69 Then

                monthTitle.Font.Underline = False

            ElseIf iDayForm = 70 Then

                yearTitle.Font.Underline = False

            End If

        End If

    End If

    If day > 0 Then

        If day <= 67 Then

            Me.Controls("daybg" & day).BackColor = ColorMove

        ElseIf day = 68 Then

            datetimebg.BackColor = ColorMove

        ElseIf day = 69 Then

            monthTitle.Font.Underline = True

        ElseIf day = 70 Then

            yearTitle.Font.Underline = True

        End If

        iDayForm = day

    End If

End Sub

    If iItem <> 0 Then

        If iItem <> itemIndex Then

            Me.Controls("mybg" & iItem).BackColor = colorWhite

            SwitchColorControl Me.Controls("mybg" & iItem), True

        End If

    End If

    If itemIndex > 0 Then

        Me.Controls("mybg" & itemIndex).BackColor = ColorMove

        iItem = itemIndex

    End If

Private Sub SwitchColorControl(objControl As control, Optional picker As Boolean = False)

    If objControl.BackColor = ColorSelectedDate Then

        objControl.BackColor = colorWhite

    End If

    If picker Then

        If iSelectGlobal = objControl.Tag Then

            objControl.BackColor = ColorSelectedDate

        End If

    Else

        If DateGlobal = objControl.Tag Then

            objControl.BackColor = ColorSelectedDate

        End If

    End If

End Sub

Private Sub SetCapitonControlSunday()

    Dim i           As Byte

    For i = 1 To 7

        Me.Controls("dayofweek" & i).Caption = VBA.WeekdayName(i, True, vbMonday)

    Next i

End Sub



Private Sub SetDayFromId(id As Integer, Button As Integer)

    If Button > 1 Then

        SetDayGlobalFromControl 68, True

    Else

        SetDayGlobalFromControl 68

    End If

End Sub

Private Sub SetDayGlobalFromControl(id As Integer, Optional inculdeTime As Boolean = False)

    If id <= 67 Then

        sDateGlobal = Me.Controls("day" & id).Tag

    ElseIf id = 68 Then

        sDateGlobal = VBA.Date

        If inculdeTime Then sDateGlobal = sDateGlobal & " " & VBA.Time

    End If

    lbDateChose.Caption = sDateGlobal

    Me.Hide

End Sub

Private Sub SetMountYearFormIdControl(id As Integer)

    If lbTypeCalendar.Caption = "1" Then

        lbDateChose.Caption = Me.Controls("my" & id).Tag

        Me.Hide

        Exit Sub

    End If

    If pickerMode = 1 Then

        iMounthGlobal = Me.Controls("my" & id).Tag

    ElseIf pickerMode = 2 Then

        iYearGlobal = Me.Controls("my" & id).Tag



        If minDate <> 0 And iYearGlobal = VBA.Year(minDate) Then

            If iMounthGlobal < VBA.Month(minDate) Then iMounthGlobal = VBA.Month(minDate)

        End If



        If maxDate <> 0 And iYearGlobal = VBA.Year(maxDate) Then

            If iMounthGlobal > VBA.Month(maxDate) Then iMounthGlobal = VBA.Month(maxDate)

        End If

    End If

    SetDayOneAndDayTwo

    SwitchVisibleButton 0

End Sub



Private Sub SetShowPicerMode1()

    If pickerMode = 1 Then

        SwitchVisibleButton 0

    Else

        SwitchVisibleButton 1

        FrameTop30

    End If

End Sub



Private Sub SetShowPicerMode2()

    If pickerMode = 2 Then

        SwitchVisibleButton 0

    Else

        SwitchVisibleButton 2

        FrameTop30

    End If

End Sub



Private Sub FrameTop30()

    myFrame.Top = 30

End Sub



Private Sub FrameTopHeight()

    myFrame.Top = Me.Height

End Sub



Private Sub SwitchVisibleButton(Mode As Integer)

    If Mode = 0 Then

        pickerMode = 0

        FrameTopHeight

        Call subVisibleButtonMount(True)

    ElseIf Mode = 1 Then

        Call SetMounts

        Call subVisibleButtonMount(False)

        pickerMode = 1

        Call FrameTop30

    ElseIf Mode = 2 Then

        iShiftGlobal = -6

        Call SetYears

        Call subVisibleButtonMount(True)

        pickerMode = 2

        Call FrameTop30

    End If

End Sub



Private Sub blockBtn(Mode As Integer)

    If Mode = 0 Then

        prevMonthButton.Enabled = day11.Enabled

        nextMonthButton.Enabled = day67.Enabled

    ElseIf Mode = 1 Then

        prevMonthButton.Enabled = myBG1.Enabled

        nextMonthButton.Enabled = myBG12.Enabled

    ElseIf Mode = 2 Then



    End If

End Sub



Private Sub SetDayOneAndDayTwo()

    Dim dtDate1     As Date

    Dim dtDate2     As Date

    Dim iDay        As Integer

    Dim objCnt1     As control

    Dim objCnt2     As control

    Dim i           As Byte

    Dim j           As Byte



    dtDate1 = VBA.DateSerial(iYearGlobal, iMounthGlobal, 1)

    iDay = VBA.Weekday(dtDate1, vbMonday)

    dtDate2 = VBA.DateAdd("d", -iDay + 1, dtDate1)

    Me.monthTitle.Caption = VBA.MonthName(VBA.Month(dtDate1), True)

    Me.yearTitle.Caption = VBA.Year(dtDate1)

    For i = 1 To 6

        For j = 1 To 7

            Set objCnt1 = Me.Controls("day" & i & j)

            Set objCnt2 = Me.Controls("dayBG" & i & j)

            objCnt1.Caption = VBA.day(dtDate2)

            objCnt1.Tag = dtDate2

            objCnt2.Tag = dtDate2





            objCnt1.Enabled = Not ((dtDate2 < minDate And minDate <> 0) Or (dtDate2 > maxDate And maxDate <> 0))

            objCnt2.Enabled = objCnt1.Enabled



            If VBA.Month(dtDate2) <> iMounthGlobal Then

                objCnt1.ForeColor = ForeColorDayNo

            Else

                objCnt1.ForeColor = ForeColorDayYes

            End If

            SwitchColorControl objCnt2

            dtDate2 = VBA.DateAdd("d", 1, dtDate2)

        Next j

    Next i

    Call blockBtn(0)

End Sub



Private Sub SetMounts()

    Dim objCnt1     As control

    Dim objCnt2     As control

    Dim i           As Byte

    Dim minMonth    As Byte

    Dim maxMonth    As Byte

    Dim minYear     As Integer

    Dim maxYear     As Integer



    minMonth = VBA.Month(minDate)

    maxMonth = VBA.Month(maxDate)

    minYear = VBA.Year(minDate)

    maxYear = VBA.Year(maxDate)

    For i = 1 To 12

        Set objCnt1 = Me.Controls("my" & i)

        Set objCnt2 = Me.Controls("mybg" & i)

        objCnt1.Caption = VBA.MonthName(i, True)

        objCnt1.Tag = i

        objCnt2.Tag = i



        objCnt1.Enabled = Not ((i < minMonth And minDate <> 0 And iYearGlobal = minYear) Or (i > maxMonth And maxDate <> 0 And iYearGlobal = maxYear))

        objCnt2.Enabled = objCnt1.Enabled



        objCnt2.BackColor = colorWhite

        SwitchColorControl objCnt2, True

    Next i

End Sub



Private Sub SetYears()

    Dim objCnt1     As control

    Dim objCnt2     As control

    Dim iYear       As Integer

    Dim i           As Byte



    iYear = iYearGlobal + iShiftGlobal

    For i = 1 To 12

        Set objCnt1 = Me.Controls("my" & i)

        Set objCnt2 = Me.Controls("mybg" & i)

        objCnt1.Caption = iYear

        objCnt1.Tag = iYear

        objCnt2.Tag = iYear



        objCnt1.Enabled = Not ((iYear < VBA.Year(minDate) And minDate <> 0) Or (iYear > VBA.Year(maxDate) And maxDate <> 0))

        objCnt2.Enabled = objCnt1.Enabled

        objCnt2.BackColor = colorWhite

        SwitchColorControl objCnt2, True

        iYear = iYear + 1

    Next i

    Call blockBtn(1)

End Sub



Private Sub subVisibleButtonMount(ByVal Value As Boolean)

    prevMonthButton.Visible = Value

    nextMonthButton.Visible = Value

End Sub

        Set mLbBtn = mParent.Controls.Add("Forms.label.1", .Name & "_lb_btn", True)

        Set mLbMainColon = .Controls.Add("Forms.label.1", .Name & "_lb_colon", True)
        Set mLbHours = .Controls.Add("Forms.label.1", .Name & "_lb_hour", True)

        Set mLbArrowDownHours = .Controls.Add("Forms.label.1", .Name & "_lb_arrow_down_hour", True)
        Set mLbArrowUpMinuts = .Controls.Add("Forms.label.1", .Name & "_lb_arrow_up_minute", True)
        Set mLbArrowDownMinuts = .Controls.Add("Forms.label.1", .Name & "_lb_arrow_down_minute", True)

        If mTextBox.Width < SIZE_WIDTH Then
            .Width = SIZE_WIDTH
        Else
            .Width = mTextBox.Width
        End If
        .Height = 40
        If mTextBox.Top + mTextBox.Height + .Height > mParent.InsideHeight Then
            .Top = mTextBox.Top - .Height - 2
        Else
            .Top = mTextBox.Top + mTextBox.Height + 2
        End If
        .Left = mTextBox.Left
    End With

    With mLbMainColon
        .Width = SIZE_LABEL
        .Height = SIZE_LABEL
        .Caption = ":"
        .TextAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
        .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Top = mMainPanel.Height / 2 - .Height / 2
        .Left = mMainPanel.Width / 2 - .Width / 2
        .ForeColor = ForeColorColon
    End With

    With mLbHours
        .Width = SIZE_LABEL
        .Height = SIZE_LABEL
        .Caption = VBA.Format$(VBA.hour(SetTime), "00")
        .TextAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
        .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Top = mLbMainColon.Top
        .Left = mLbMainColon.Left - mLbMainColon.Width
        .ForeColor = ForeColorHours
        .ZOrder 0
    End With

    With mLbMinuts
        .Width = SIZE_LABEL
        .Height = SIZE_LABEL
        .Caption = VBA.Format$(VBA.Minute(SetTime), "00")
        .TextAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
        .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Top = mLbMainColon.Top
        .Left = mLbMainColon.Left + mLbMainColon.Width
        .ForeColor = ForeColorMinuts
        .ZOrder 0
    End With

    With mLbBtn
        .Height = mTextBox.Height
        .Width = .Height
        .Font.Size = .Height * 0.65
        .Font.Name = "Segoe MDL2 Assets"
        .Caption = VBA.ChrW$(IconCode)
        .TextAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
        .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .Font.Bold = True
        .ForeColor = ForeColorBtn
        .Top = mTextBox.Top + 2
        If RightBtn Then
            .Left = mTextBox.Left + mTextBox.Width
        Else
            .Left = mTextBox.Left - .Width
        End If
        .ZOrder 0
        .Visible = VisibleBtn
    End With

    Call addArrowLabel(mLbArrowUpHours, mLbHours, 59150, -1, ForeColorArrowUpHours)
    Call addArrowLabel(mLbArrowDownHours, mLbHours, 59149, 1, ForeColorArrowDownHours)
    Call addArrowLabel(mLbArrowUpMinuts, mLbMinuts, 59150, -1, ForeColorArrowUpMinuts)
    Call addArrowLabel(mLbArrowDownMinuts, mLbMinuts, 59149, 1, ForeColorArrowDownMinuts)

    mMainPanel.Visible = False
End Sub

Private Sub addArrowLabel(ByRef lbArrow As MSForms.Label, ByRef lbParent As MSForms.Label, ByVal IconCode As Long, ByVal iUp As Integer, ByVal ForeColor As Long)
    With lbArrow
        .Width = SIZE_LABEL
        .Height = SIZE_LABEL
        .TextAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
        .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Font.Name = "Segoe MDL2 Assets"
        .Font.Size = 10
        .Caption = VBA.ChrW$(IconCode)
        .Top = lbParent.Top + lbParent.Height * iUp
        .Left = lbParent.Left
        .ForeColor = ForeColor
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub mTextBox_DblClick(ByVal Cancel As MSForms.ReturnBoolean)
    Cancel = True
    Call SetValueTextBox
End Sub

Private Sub mLbBtn_Click()
    Call SetValueTextBox
End Sub

Private Sub SetValueTextBox()
    mMainPanel.Visible = Not mMainPanel.Visible
    If mMainPanel.Visible Then
        If mTextBox.Value = vbNullString Then
            mLbHours.Caption = VBA.Format$(VBA.hour(VBA.Time()), "00")
            mLbMinuts.Caption = VBA.Format$(VBA.Minute(VBA.Time()), "00")
        End If
        mTextBox.Value = mLbHours.Caption & ":" & mLbMinuts.Caption
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub mParent_Click()
    mMainPanel.Visible = False
End Sub

Private Sub mLbArrowUpHours_Click()
    Call setTim(1, True)
End Sub

Private Sub mLbArrowDownHours_Click()
    Call setTim(-1, True)
End Sub

Private Sub mLbArrowUpMinuts_Click()
    Call setTim(1, False)
End Sub

Private Sub mLbArrowDownMinuts_Click()
    Call setTim(-1, False)
End Sub

Private Sub setTim(ByVal iUp As Integer, isHour As Boolean)
    Dim iHour       As Integer
    Dim iMinute     As Integer

    If isHour Then
        iHour = VBA.CInt(mLbHours.Caption) + iUp
        iMinute = VBA.CInt(mLbMinuts.Caption)
        Select Case iHour
            Case Is < 0
                iHour = 23
            Case Is > 23
                iHour = 0
            Case 0 To 23
        End Select
    Else
        iHour = VBA.CInt(mLbHours.Caption)
        iMinute = VBA.CInt(mLbMinuts.Caption) + iUp
        Select Case iMinute
            Case Is < 0
                iMinute = 59
                iHour = iHour + iUp
            Case Is > 59
                iMinute = 0
                iHour = iHour + iUp
            Case 0 To 59
        End Select
    End If
    mLbHours.Caption = VBA.Format$(iHour, "00")
    mLbMinuts.Caption = VBA.Format$(iMinute, "00")
    mTextBox.Value = mLbHours.Caption & ":" & mLbMinuts.Caption
End Sub
