''* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'* Module     : clsComboBox - Eiio?ie ComboBox n iii?anoaaiiui auai?ii cia?aiee a ListBox
'* Created    : 25-07-2025 09:38
'* Author     : VBATools
'* Contacts   : https://vk.com/vbatools
'* Copyright  : VBATools.ru
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'*
'* DESCRIPTION:   Eiio?ie ComboBox n iii?anoaaiiui auai?ii cia?aiee a ListBox
'*
'* PROPERTY:
'*  Get/Let SortTextBox
'*  Get     GetArrayIndexSelected
'*  Get     GetArrayIndexUnSelected
'*  Get/Let Delimetr
'*  Get/Let BoundColumn
'*  Get/Let Text
'*  Get/Let ColumnCount
'*  Get/Let List
'*  Get     Value
'*  Get     SelectedCount
'*  Get     ListSelectedItems
'*  Get/Let Visible
'*      Let ListSelectedAll
'*
'* PROCEDURES PUBLIC:
'*  Initialize
'*  ReversSelected - revers selected item in listbox
'*  RemoveSelected - delete items selected in listbox
'*  RemoveUnSelected - delete items un selected in listbox
'*
'* PROCEDURES PRIVATE:
'*  addArrayConst - add un selected list 0,1,2,3...
'*  btnTextBox_Click
'*  frmBtnOk_Click
'*  frmBtnCancel_Click
'*  frmList_Change
'*  showHidenFrame - hiden or show listbox
'*  updatTextInTextBox - add string for textbox with delimetr
'*  selectItemsList - update list's: mListSelectedItems and mValueBoundColumn
'*  lokedControls - locked all controls main form when open listbox
'*
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Private WithEvents btnTextBox As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents frmBtnOk As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents frmBtnCancel As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents frmList As MSForms.ListBox

Private txtTextBox  As MSForms.textBox
Private frmBox      As MSForms.Frame
Private oParent     As Object

Private mDelimetr   As String
Private mListSelectedItems As Variant
Private mValueBoundColumn As Variant
Private mBoundColumn As Long
Private mSortText   As Byte
'1 - Up Sort
'2 - Down Sort

Private mbChange    As Boolean
Private mBuferText  As String
'iiaee??eou ?eaeeioaeo mscorlib.dll eee caiaieou  ArrayList ia CreateObject("System.Collections.ArrayList")
Private arrArrayListSelected As ArrayList
Private arrArrayListUnSelected As ArrayList
Private arrArrayListBufer As ArrayList

Private Const FRM_WIDTH As Integer = 186
Private Const BTN_WIDTH As Integer = 24

Private Sub Class_Terminate()
    Set btnTextBox = Nothing
    Set frmBtnOk = Nothing
    Set frmBtnCancel = Nothing
    Set frmList = Nothing

    Set txtTextBox = Nothing
    Set frmBox = Nothing
    Set oParent = Nothing

    mDelimetr = Empty
    mListSelectedItems = Empty
    mValueBoundColumn = Empty
    mBoundColumn = Empty
    mSortText = Empty

    mbChange = Empty

    Set arrArrayListSelected = Nothing
    Set arrArrayListUnSelected = Nothing
    Set arrArrayListBufer = Nothing
End Sub


Public Sub ReversSelected()
    Set arrArrayListBufer = arrArrayListSelected.Clone
    Set arrArrayListSelected = arrArrayListUnSelected.Clone
    Set arrArrayListUnSelected = arrArrayListBufer.Clone
    arrArrayListBufer.Clear
    frmList.List = frmList.List
    Call updatTextInTextBox
    Call selectItemsList
End Sub

Public Property Get SortTextBox() As Byte
    SortTextBox = mSortText
End Property

Public Property Let SortTextBox(ByVal bySort As Byte)
    mSortText = bySort
    With arrArrayListSelected
        Select Case mSortText
            Case 1
                Call .Sort
                arrArrayListUnSelected.Sort
            Case 2
                Call .Sort
                Call .Reverse
                arrArrayListUnSelected.Sort
                arrArrayListUnSelected.Reverse
                arrArrayListBufer.Reverse
        End Select
    End With
End Property

Public Property Get GetArrayIndexSelected() As Variant
    GetArrayIndexSelected = arrArrayListSelected.ToArray
End Property

Public Property Get GetArrayIndexUnSelected() As Variant
    GetArrayIndexUnSelected = arrArrayListUnSelected.ToArray
End Property

Public Property Get Delimetr() As String
    Delimetr = mDelimetr
End Property

Public Property Let Delimetr(ByVal Delimetr As String)
    mDelimetr = Delimetr
End Property

Public Property Let BoundColumn(ByVal Column As Long)
    If Column < 1 Then Call Err.Raise(Number:=vbObjectError + 100, Description:="BoundColumn must be greater than zero")
    frmList.BoundColumn = Column
    mBoundColumn = Column
End Property

Public Property Get BoundColumn() As Long
    If mBoundColumn = 0 Then mBoundColumn = frmList.BoundColumn
    BoundColumn = mBoundColumn
End Property

Public Property Let Text(ByVal sText As String)
    Dim arrList     As Variant
    Dim iCountList  As Long

    txtTextBox.Text = sText
    arrArrayListUnSelected.Clear
    arrArrayListSelected.Clear
    Me.List = Me.List
    arrList = Me.List
    iCountList = UBound(arrList, 1)

    If iCountList < 0 Or sText = vbNullString Then Exit Property
    Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, iCountList)

    Dim i           As Long
    Dim j           As Long
    Dim bFlag       As Boolean
    Dim arr         As Variant
    
    arr = VBA.Split(sText, mDelimetr)
    For j = 0 To UBound(arr)
        For i = 0 To iCountList
            If arr(j) = VBA.CStr(arrList(i, 0)) Then
                Call arrArrayListUnSelected.Remove(i)
                Call arrArrayListSelected.Add(i)
                bFlag = True
                Exit For
            End If
        Next i
    Next j

    If bFlag Then
        Call selectItemsList
        Call updatTextInTextBox
    End If
End Property

Public Property Get Text() As String
    Text = txtTextBox.Text
End Property

Public Property Let ColumnCount(ByVal iCount As Byte)
    frmList.ColumnCount = iCount
End Property

Public Property Get ColumnCount() As Byte
    ColumnCount = frmList.ColumnCount
End Property

Public Property Get List() As Variant
    List = frmList.List
End Property

Public Property Let List(ByVal arrList As Variant)
    frmList.List = arrList
    Call selectItemsList
End Property

Public Property Get Value() As Variant
    Call selectItemsList
    Value = mValueBoundColumn
End Property

Public Property Get SelectedCount() As Long
    SelectedCount = arrArrayListSelected.Count
End Property

Public Property Get ListSelectedItems() As Variant
    Call selectItemsList
    ListSelectedItems = mListSelectedItems
End Property

Public Property Let ListSelectedItems(ByVal ListSelectedItems As Variant)
    mListSelectedItems = ListSelectedItems
    txtTextBox.Text = VBA.Join(ListSelectedItems, mDelimetr)
    Call selectItemsList
End Property

Public Property Let Visible(ByVal bVisible As Boolean)
    frmBox.Visible = bVisible
End Property

Public Property Get Visible() As Boolean
    Visible = frmBox.Visible
End Property

Public Property Let ListSelectedAll(ByVal bSelected As Boolean)
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Dim j           As Long
    Dim jCount      As Long
    Dim sRes        As String
    With frmList
        jCount = .ListCount - 1
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListBufer, jCount)
        For j = 0 To jCount
            mbChange = True
            .Selected(j) = bSelected
            mbChange = False
            If bSelected Then
                If sRes <> vbNullString Then sRes = sRes & mDelimetr
                sRes = sRes & .List(arrArrayListBufer(j), 0)
                sRes = putTextToBufer(sRes, j, jCount)
            End If
        Next j
    End With
    If bSelected Then
        txtTextBox.Text = sRes
        arrArrayListUnSelected.Clear
        Set arrArrayListSelected = arrArrayListBufer.Clone
    Else
        txtTextBox.Text = vbNullString
        mListSelectedItems = Empty
        mValueBoundColumn = Empty
        arrArrayListSelected.Clear
        Set arrArrayListUnSelected = arrArrayListBufer.Clone
    End If
    mbChange = False
    mBuferText = vbNullString
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    arrArrayListBufer.Clear
End Property

'* Sub        : Initialize - eieoeeecaoey eeanna
'* Created    : 25-07-2025 09:57
'* Author     : VBATools
'* Contacts   : https://vk.com/vbatools
'* Copyright  : VBATools.ru
'* Argument(s):                         Description
'*
'* ByRef txtBox As MSForms.textBox  : ?iaeoaeuneee eiio?ie
'* ByVal arrList As Variant         : nienie cia?aiee
'* Optional sDelimetr As String     : ?acaaeeoaeu cia?aiee a oaeno aiena
'* Optional SortTextBox As Byte     : iai?aaeaiea ni?oe?iaee cia?aiee a oaeno aiena
'*                                  1 - aaa?o
'*                                  2 - aiec
'*                                  a?oaia - aac ni?oe?iaee
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
Public Sub Initialize(ByRef txtBox As MSForms.textBox, Optional arrList As Variant = Empty, Optional sDelimetr As String = ", ", Optional SortTextBox As Byte = 1)
    Dim txtName     As String

    txtName = txtBox.Name
    Set oParent = txtBox.Parent
    Set txtTextBox = txtBox
    Set btnTextBox = oParent.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", "btnTextBox" & "_" & txtName, True)
    mDelimetr = sDelimetr
    mSortText = SortTextBox

    With btnTextBox
        .Top = txtTextBox.Top
        .Height = txtTextBox.Height
        .Left = txtTextBox.Left + txtTextBox.Width - BTN_WIDTH
        .Width = BTN_WIDTH
        .Font.Name = "Wingdings 3"
        .Caption = "q"
        .TabIndex = txtTextBox.TabIndex + 1
    End With

    Set frmBox = oParent.Controls.Add("Forms.Frame.1", "frmBox" & "_" & txtName, False)
    With frmBox
        If oParent.InsideHeight - txtTextBox.Top - txtTextBox.Height > frmBox.Height Then
            .Top = txtTextBox.Top + txtTextBox.Height
        Else
            .Top = txtTextBox.Top - frmBox.Height
        End If
        .Width = txtTextBox.Width
        .Left = txtTextBox.Left
        If .Width < FRM_WIDTH Then
            If .Left + .Width > FRM_WIDTH Then .Left = .Left - (FRM_WIDTH - .Width)
            .Width = FRM_WIDTH
        End If
        .Font.Size = txtTextBox.Font.Size
        .Font.Name = txtTextBox.Font.Name
        .Font.Bold = txtTextBox.Font.Bold
        .Font.Italic = txtTextBox.Font.Italic
        Call .ZOrder(1)
    End With

    Set frmList = frmBox.Controls.Add("Forms.ListBox.1", "frmList" & "_" & txtName, True)
    With frmList
        .Width = frmBox.Width
        .Top = -1
        .Left = -1
        .Height = frmBox.Height - BTN_WIDTH
        .BorderStyle = txtTextBox.BorderStyle
        .MultiSelect = fmMultiSelectMulti
        .ListStyle = fmListStyleOption
    End With
    Set frmBtnOk = frmBox.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", "frmBtnOk" & "_" & txtName, True)
    With frmBtnOk
        .Top = frmList.Height + 1
        .Left = 5
        .Height = BTN_WIDTH - 1
        .Caption = "OK"
    End With

    Set frmBtnCancel = frmBox.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", "frmBtnCancel" & "_" & txtName, True)
    With frmBtnCancel
        .Top = frmList.Height + 1
        .Left = frmList.Width - .Width - 10
        .Height = BTN_WIDTH - 1
        .Caption = "IOIAIA"
    End With

    txtTextBox.Width = txtTextBox.Width - BTN_WIDTH
    Set arrArrayListUnSelected = New ArrayList
    Set arrArrayListSelected = New ArrayList
    Set arrArrayListBufer = New ArrayList

    If Not IsEmpty(arrList) Then
        frmList.List = arrList
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, UBound(arrList) - 1)
    End If
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
End Sub

Private Sub btnTextBox_Click()
    Call showHidenFrame
    Call updatTextInTextBox
    Set arrArrayListBufer = arrArrayListSelected.Clone
End Sub

Private Sub frmBtnOk_Click()
    Call showHidenFrame
    Set arrArrayListSelected = arrArrayListBufer.Clone
    Dim i           As Long
    Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
    With arrArrayListUnSelected
        For i = arrArrayListBufer.Count - 1 To 0 Step -1
            If .Contains(arrArrayListBufer(i)) Then Call .Remove(arrArrayListBufer(i))
        Next i
    End With
    Call updatTextInTextBox
    arrArrayListBufer.Clear
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
End Sub

Private Sub frmBtnCancel_Click()
    Call showHidenFrame
    Call updatTextInTextBox
    arrArrayListBufer.Clear
End Sub

Private Sub frmList_Change()
    If mbChange Then Exit Sub
    Dim index       As Long
    index = frmList.ListIndex
    If index < 0 Then Exit Sub
    With arrArrayListBufer
        If frmList.Selected(index) Then
            If Not .Contains(index) Then Call .Add(index)
        Else
            If .Contains(index) Then Call .Remove(index)
        End If
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub showHidenFrame()
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    With frmBox
        '.Visible = True
        .ZOrder 1
        If Not .Visible Then .ZOrder 0
        .Visible = Not .Visible
        Call lokedControls(.Visible)
    End With
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

Private Sub updatTextInTextBox()
    Dim sRes        As String
    Dim j           As Long
    Dim jCount      As Long

    mbChange = True
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
    With frmList
        jCount = arrArrayListSelected.Count - 1
        For j = 0 To jCount
            .Selected(arrArrayListSelected(j)) = True
            If sRes <> vbNullString Then sRes = sRes & mDelimetr
            sRes = sRes & .List(arrArrayListSelected(j), 0)
            sRes = putTextToBufer(sRes, j, jCount)
        Next j
        txtTextBox.Text = sRes
    End With
    mbChange = False
    mBuferText = vbNullString
End Sub

Private Sub selectItemsList()
    Dim i           As Long
    Dim iCount      As Long
    Dim m           As Byte
    Dim mCount      As Byte
    Dim item        As Long

    With arrArrayListSelected
        iCount = .Count - 1
        If iCount < 0 Then
            mListSelectedItems = Empty
            mValueBoundColumn = Empty
            arrArrayListSelected.Clear
            Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
            Exit Sub
        End If
        If frmList.ListIndex < 0 Then Exit Sub
        mCount = frmList.ColumnCount - 1
        ReDim mListSelectedItems(1 To iCount + 1, 1 To mCount + 1)
        ReDim mValueBoundColumn(1 To iCount + 1, 1 To 1)

        For i = 0 To iCount
            item = arrArrayListSelected(i)
            mValueBoundColumn(i + 1, 1) = frmList.List(item, mBoundColumn - 1)
            For m = 0 To mCount
                mListSelectedItems(i + 1, m + 1) = frmList.List(item, m)
            Next m
        Next i
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub lokedControls(ByVal bLocked As Boolean)
    Dim cnt         As MSForms.Control
    For Each cnt In oParent.Controls
        With cnt
            If .Name <> txtTextBox.Name And Not .Name Like "*_" & txtTextBox.Name Then
                Select Case TypeName(cnt)
                    Case "Label", "Frame", "Image"
                    Case Else
                        .Locked = bLocked
                End Select
            End If
        End With
    Next cnt
End Sub

'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'* Sub        : RemoveSelected - oaaeeou aua?aiiua a eenoaiena
'* Created    : 25-07-2025 10:00
'* Author     : VBATools
'* Contacts   : https://vk.com/vbatools
'* Copyright  : VBATools.ru
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
Public Sub RemoveSelected()
    Dim i           As Long
    Dim iCount      As Long
    With frmList
        arrArrayListSelected.Sort
        iCount = arrArrayListSelected.Count - 1
        If iCount < 0 Then Exit Sub
        For i = iCount To 0 Step -1
            Call .RemoveItem(arrArrayListSelected(i))
        Next i
        txtTextBox.Text = vbNullString
        arrArrayListSelected.Clear
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
    End With
End Sub

'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'* Sub        : RemoveUnSelected - oaaeeou IA aua?aiiua a eenoaiena
'* Created    : 25-07-2025 10:00
'* Author     : VBATools
'* Contacts   : https://vk.com/vbatools
'* Copyright  : VBATools.ru
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
Public Sub RemoveUnSelected()
    Call selectItemsList
    txtTextBox.Text = vbNullString
    arrArrayListSelected.Clear
    If Not IsEmpty(mListSelectedItems) Then
        frmList.List = mListSelectedItems
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
    Else
        frmList.Clear
        arrArrayListUnSelected.Clear
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub addArrayConst(ByRef addArray As ArrayList, ByRef iCount As Long)
    Dim i           As Long
    With addArray
        .Clear
        For i = 0 To iCount
            Call .Add(i)
        Next i
    End With
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
End Sub

Private Function putTextToBufer(ByRef sVal As String, ByRef itemNumber As LongPtr, ByRef iCount As LongPtr) As String
    If VBA.Len(sVal) > 1000 Then
        If mBuferText <> vbNullString Then mBuferText = mBuferText & mDelimetr
        mBuferText = mBuferText & sVal
        sVal = vbNullString
    End If
    If itemNumber = iCount Then
        If mBuferText <> vbNullString Then mBuferText = mBuferText & mDelimetr
        putTextToBufer = mBuferText & sVal
    Else
        putTextToBufer = sVal
    End If
End Function

Public Property Let Text(ByVal sText As String)

    txtTextBox.Text = sText
    arrArrayListUnSelected.Clear

    Me.List = Me.List
    arrList = Me.List
    iCountList = UBound(arrList, 1)

    If iCountList < 0 Or sText = vbNullString Then Exit Property
    Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, iCountList)

    Dim i           As Long
    Dim j           As Long
    Dim bFlag       As Boolean
    Dim arr         As Variant
    
    arr = VBA.Split(sText, mDelimetr)
    For j = 0 To UBound(arr)

                Call arrArrayListUnSelected.Remove(i)
                Call arrArrayListSelected.Add(i)

Public Property Let ListSelectedAll(ByVal bSelected As Boolean)

    Dim j           As Long
    Dim jCount      As Long
    Dim sRes        As String
    With frmList
        jCount = .ListCount - 1
        For j = 0 To jCount
            mbChange = True
            .Selected(j) = bSelected
            mbChange = False
            If bSelected Then
                If sRes <> vbNullString Then sRes = sRes & mDelimetr
                sRes = sRes & .List(j, 0)
                sRes = putTextToBufer(sRes, j, jCount)
            End If
        Next j
    End With
    If bSelected Then
        txtTextBox.Text = sRes
        arrArrayListUnSelected.Clear
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListSelected, jCount)
    Else
        txtTextBox.Text = vbNullString
        mListSelectedItems = Empty
        mValueBoundColumn = Empty
        arrArrayListSelected.Clear
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, jCount)
    End If
    mbChange = False
    mBuferText = vbNullString
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
End Property

Public Sub Initialize(ByRef txtBox As MSForms.textBox, Optional arrList As Variant = Empty, Optional sCaption As String = vbNullString, Optional sDelimetr As String = ", ", Optional SortTextBox As Byte = 1)
    Dim oParent     As Object
    Dim txtName     As String

    mDelimetr = sDelimetr
    mSortText = SortTextBox
    txtName = txtBox.Name
    Set oParent = txtBox.Parent
    Set txtTextBox = txtBox

    Set btnTextBox = oParent.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", "btnTextBox" & "_" & txtName, True)
    Set frmBox = getForm()
    frmBox.Caption = sCaption
    Set frmList = frmBox.frmList

    With btnTextBox
        .Top = txtTextBox.Top
        .Height = txtTextBox.Height
        .Left = txtTextBox.Left + txtTextBox.Width - BTN_WIDTH
        .Width = BTN_WIDTH
        .Font.Name = "Wingdings 3"
        .Caption = "q"
        .TabIndex = txtTextBox.TabIndex + 1
    End With

    Set arrArrayListSelected = New ArrayList
    Set arrArrayListUnSelected = New ArrayList
    Set arrArrayListBufer = New ArrayList

    If Not IsEmpty(arrList) Then
        frmList.List = arrList
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, UBound(arrList) - 1)
    End If
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
End Sub

Private Function getForm() As frmComboBox
    If frmBox Is Nothing Then
        Set getForm = New frmComboBox
    Else
        Set getForm = frmBox
    End If
End Function

Private Sub btnTextBox_Click()
    Set frmBox = getForm()
    Set arrArrayListBufer = arrArrayListSelected.Clone
    With frmBox
        .Show
        If .lbBtn = "1" Then
            Set arrArrayListSelected = arrArrayListBufer.Clone
            Dim i   As Long
            Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
            With arrArrayListUnSelected
                For i = arrArrayListBufer.Count - 1 To 0 Step -1
                    If .Contains(arrArrayListBufer(i)) Then Call .Remove(arrArrayListBufer(i))
                Next i
            End With
        End If
    End With
    Call updatTextInTextBox
    arrArrayListBufer.Clear
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
End Sub

Private Sub frmList_Change()
    If mbChange Then Exit Sub
    Dim index       As Long
    index = frmList.ListIndex
    If index < 0 Then Exit Sub
    With arrArrayListBufer
        If frmList.Selected(index) Then
            If Not .Contains(index) Then Call .Add(index)
        Else
            If .Contains(index) Then Call .Remove(index)
        End If
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub updatTextInTextBox()
    Dim sRes        As String
    Dim j           As Long
    Dim jCount      As Long

    mbChange = True
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
    With frmList
        jCount = arrArrayListSelected.Count - 1
        For j = 0 To jCount
            .Selected(arrArrayListSelected(j)) = True
            If sRes <> vbNullString Then sRes = sRes & mDelimetr
            sRes = sRes & .List(arrArrayListSelected(j), 0)
            sRes = putTextToBufer(sRes, j, jCount)
        Next j
        txtTextBox.Text = sRes
    End With
    mbChange = False
    mBuferText = vbNullString
End Sub
Private Sub selectItemsList()
    Dim i           As Long
    Dim iCount      As Long
    Dim m           As Byte
    Dim mCount      As Byte
    Dim item        As Long

    With arrArrayListSelected
        iCount = .Count - 1
        If iCount < 0 Then
            mListSelectedItems = Empty
            mValueBoundColumn = Empty
            arrArrayListSelected.Clear
            Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
            Exit Sub
        End If
        If frmList.ListIndex < 0 Then Exit Sub
        mCount = frmList.ColumnCount - 1
        ReDim mListSelectedItems(1 To iCount + 1, 1 To mCount + 1)
        ReDim mValueBoundColumn(1 To iCount + 1, 1 To 1)

        For i = 0 To iCount
            item = arrArrayListSelected(i)
            mValueBoundColumn(i + 1, 1) = frmList.List(item, mBoundColumn - 1)
            For m = 0 To mCount
                mListSelectedItems(i + 1, m + 1) = frmList.List(item, m)
            Next m
        Next i
    End With
End Sub

Public Sub RemoveSelected()
    Dim i           As Long
    Dim iCount      As Long
    With frmList
        arrArrayListSelected.Sort
        iCount = arrArrayListSelected.Count - 1
        If iCount < 0 Then Exit Sub
        For i = iCount To 0 Step -1
            Call .RemoveItem(arrArrayListSelected(i))
        Next i
        txtTextBox.Text = vbNullString
        arrArrayListSelected.Clear
        arrArrayListUnSelected.Clear
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
    End With
End Sub

'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Public Sub RemoveUnSelected()
    Call selectItemsList
    txtTextBox.Text = vbNullString
    arrArrayListSelected.Clear
    If Not IsEmpty(mListSelectedItems) Then
        frmList.List = mListSelectedItems
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
    Else
        frmList.Clear
        arrArrayListUnSelected.Clear
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub addArrayConst(ByRef addArray As ArrayList, ByRef iCount As Long)
    Dim i           As Long
    With addArray
        .Clear
        For i = 0 To iCount
            Call .Add(i)
        Next i
    End With
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
End Sub

Private Function putTextToBufer(ByRef sVal As String, ByRef itemNumber As LongPtr, ByRef iCount As LongPtr) As String
    If VBA.Len(sVal) > 1000 Then
        If mBuferText <> vbNullString Then mBuferText = mBuferText & mDelimetr
        mBuferText = mBuferText & sVal
        sVal = vbNullString
    End If
    If itemNumber = iCount Then
        If mBuferText <> vbNullString Then mBuferText = mBuferText & mDelimetr
        putTextToBufer = mBuferText & sVal
    Else
        putTextToBufer = sVal
    End If
End Function

Public Property Get Visible() As Boolean
    Visible = frmList.Visible
End Property

Public Property Let ListSelectedAll(ByVal bSelected As Boolean)
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Dim j           As Long
    Dim jCount      As Long
    Dim sRes        As String
    With frmList
        jCount = .ListCount - 1
        For j = 0 To jCount
            mbChange = True
            .Selected(j) = bSelected
            mbChange = False
            If bSelected Then
                If sRes <> vbNullString Then sRes = sRes & mDelimetr
                sRes = sRes & .List(j, 0)
                sRes = putTextToBufer(sRes, j, jCount)
            End If
        Next j
    End With
    If bSelected Then
        Me.Text = sRes
        arrArrayListUnSelected.Clear
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListSelected, jCount)
    Else
        Me.Text = vbNullString
        mListSelectedItems = Empty
        mValueBoundColumn = Empty
        arrArrayListSelected.Clear
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, jCount)
    End If
    mbChange = False
    mBuferText = vbNullString
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
End Property

Public Sub Initialize(ByRef cnt As MSForms.ListBox, Optional arrList As Variant = Empty, Optional sDelimetr As String = ", ", Optional SortTextBox As Byte = 1)
    If Not IsArray(arrList) And Not IsEmpty(arrList) Then
        Call Err.Raise(Number:=vbObjectError + 200, Description:="The arrList is not Array")
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set frmList = cnt
    If frmList.MultiSelect <> fmMultiSelectMulti Then
        Call Err.Raise(Number:=vbObjectError + 201, Description:="This class is only for ListBox with MultiSelect")
        Exit Sub
    End If

    mDelimetr = sDelimetr
    mSortText = SortTextBox

    Set arrArrayListSelected = New ArrayList
    Set arrArrayListUnSelected = New ArrayList

    If Not IsEmpty(arrList) Then
        frmList.List = arrList
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, UBound(arrList) - 1)
    End If
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
End Sub

Private Sub frmList_Change()
    If mbChange Then Exit Sub
    mbChange = True
    Dim index       As Long
    index = frmList.ListIndex
    If index < 0 Then Exit Sub
    With arrArrayListSelected
        If frmList.Selected(index) Then
            If Not .Contains(index) Then Call .Add(index)
        Else
            If .Contains(index) Then Call .Remove(index)
        End If
    End With

    With arrArrayListUnSelected
        If Not frmList.Selected(index) Then
            If Not .Contains(index) Then Call .Add(index)
        Else
            If .Contains(index) Then Call .Remove(index)
        End If
    End With
    Call updatTextInTextBox
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
    mbChange = False
End Sub

Private Sub updatTextInTextBox()
    Dim sRes        As String
    Dim j           As Long
    Dim jCount      As Long

    mbChange = True
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
    With frmList
        jCount = arrArrayListSelected.Count - 1
        For j = 0 To jCount
            .Selected(arrArrayListSelected(j)) = True
            If sRes <> vbNullString Then sRes = sRes & mDelimetr
            sRes = sRes & .List(arrArrayListSelected(j), 0)
            sRes = putTextToBufer(sRes, j, jCount)
        Next j
        msText = sRes
    End With
    mbChange = False
    mBuferText = vbNullString
End Sub

Private Sub selectItemsList()
    Dim i           As Long
    Dim iCount      As Long
    Dim m           As Byte
    Dim mCount      As Byte
    Dim item        As Long

    With arrArrayListSelected
        iCount = .Count - 1
        If iCount < 0 Then
            mListSelectedItems = Empty
            mValueBoundColumn = Empty
            arrArrayListSelected.Clear
            Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
            Exit Sub
        End If
        If frmList.ListIndex < 0 Then Exit Sub
        mCount = frmList.ColumnCount - 1
        ReDim mListSelectedItems(1 To iCount + 1, 1 To mCount + 1)
        ReDim mValueBoundColumn(1 To iCount + 1, 1 To 1)

        For i = 0 To iCount
            item = arrArrayListSelected(i)
            mValueBoundColumn(i + 1, 1) = frmList.List(item, mBoundColumn - 1)
            For m = 0 To mCount
                mListSelectedItems(i + 1, m + 1) = frmList.List(item, m)
            Next m
        Next i
    End With
End Sub

'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'* Sub        : RemoveSelected - oaaeeou aua?aiiua a eenoaiena
'* Created    : 25-07-2025 10:00
'* Author     : VBATools
'* Contacts   : https://vk.com/vbatools
'* Copyright  : VBATools.ru
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
Public Sub RemoveSelected()
    Dim i           As Long
    Dim iCount      As Long
    With frmList
        arrArrayListSelected.Sort
        iCount = arrArrayListSelected.Count - 1
        If iCount < 0 Then Exit Sub
        For i = iCount To 0 Step -1
            Call .RemoveItem(arrArrayListSelected(i))
        Next i
        Me.Text = vbNullString
        arrArrayListSelected.Clear
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
    End With
End Sub

'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'* Sub        : RemoveUnSelected - oaaeeou IA aua?aiiua a eenoaiena
'* Created    : 25-07-2025 10:00
'* Author     : VBATools
'* Contacts   : https://vk.com/vbatools
'* Copyright  : VBATools.ru
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
Public Sub RemoveUnSelected()
    Call selectItemsList
    Me.Text = vbNullString
    arrArrayListSelected.Clear
    If Not IsEmpty(mListSelectedItems) Then
        frmList.List = mListSelectedItems
        Call addArrayConst(arrArrayListUnSelected, frmList.ListCount - 1)
    Else
        frmList.Clear
        arrArrayListUnSelected.Clear
    End If
End Sub

Private Function addArrayConst(ByRef arr As ArrayList, ByRef iCount As Long)
    Dim i           As Long
    arr.Clear
    For i = 0 To iCount
        Call arr.Add(i)
    Next i
    Me.SortTextBox = mSortText
End Function

Private Function putTextToBufer(ByRef sVal As String, ByRef itemNumber As LongPtr, ByRef iCount As LongPtr) As String
    If VBA.Len(sVal) > 1000 Then
        If mBuferText <> vbNullString Then mBuferText = mBuferText & mDelimetr
        mBuferText = mBuferText & sVal
        sVal = vbNullString
    End If
    If itemNumber = iCount Then
        If mBuferText <> vbNullString Then mBuferText = mBuferText & mDelimetr
        putTextToBufer = mBuferText & sVal
    Else
        putTextToBufer = sVal
    End If
End Function

' Creation Date:   10.10.2025 15:30

'
' Purpose:
'   Class designed to style MSForms controls with a modern design.
'   Implements various visual effects such as focus animation, color and font settings,
'   adding icons and visual elements.
'
' Main Features:
'   - Applying modern style to various controls (TextBox, ComboBox, ListBox, CheckBox, OptionButton, etc.)
'   - Supporting focus animation
'   - Configuring color and font
'   - Adding icons and visual elements
'   - Managing visibility and state of controls
'
' Usage:
'   1. Create an instance of clsModernStyle class
'   2. Call the Initialize method, passing a reference to the UserForm
'   3. The class automatically applies style to all controls on the form
'
' Example Usage:
'   Dim style As New clsModernStyle
'   style.Initialize Me ' where Me is the UserForm
'
' Dependencies:
'   - Microsoft Forms 2.0 Object Library
'   - VBA
'
' License:
'   Apache License
'========================================================================================

'================================================================================
' Section: Initialization and management methods
'================================================================================
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: Initialize
' Purpose: Initialize style for all form controls
' Parameters:
'   Form - Reference to UserForm to which style is applied
'   ColorBarTitleOn - Title color in active state
'   ColorBarTitleOff - Title color in inactive state
'   ColorBarBottomOn - Bottom line color in active state
'   ColorBarBottomOff - Bottom line color in inactive state
'   ColorBackGroundOn - Background color in active state
'   ColorBackGroundOff - Background color inactive state
'   ColorBarIconOn - Icon color in active state
'   ColorBarIconOff - Icon color in inactive state
'   ColorDropArrowOn - Dropdown arrow color in active state
'   ColorDropArrowOff - Dropdown arrow color in inactive state
'   ColorTgBorderOn - Switch border color in active state
'   ColorTgBorderOff - Switch border color in inactive state
'   ColorChkBoxBtnOn - Checkbox button color in active state
'   ColorChkBoxBtnOff - Checkbox button color in inactive state
'   ChrDropArrowOn - Dropdown arrow character in active state
'   ChrDropArrowOff - Dropdown arrow character in inactive state
'   ColorChkBoxCaptionOn - Checkbox caption color in active state
'   ColorChkBoxCaptionOff - Checkbox caption color in inactive state
'   ChrChkBoxBtnOn - Checkbox button character in active state
'   ChrChkBoxBtnOff - Checkbox button character in inactive state
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub Initialize(ByRef Form As MSForms.UserForm, _
        Optional ColorBarTitleOn As XlRgbColor = 14854934, _
        Optional ColorBarTitleOff As XlRgbColor = 10395294, _
        Optional ColorBarBottomOn As XlRgbColor = 14854934, _
        Optional ColorBarBottomOff As XlRgbColor = 10395294, _
        Optional ColorBackGroundOn As XlRgbColor = vbWhite, _
        Optional ColorBackGroundOff As XlRgbColor = 16447476, _
        Optional ColorBarIconOn As XlRgbColor = 14854934, _
        Optional ColorBarIconOff As XlRgbColor = 10395294, _
        Optional ColorDropArrowOn As XlRgbColor = vbBlack, _
        Optional ColorDropArrowOff As XlRgbColor = 10395294, _
        Optional ColorTgBorderOn As XlRgbColor = 14854934, _
        Optional ColorTgBorderOff As XlRgbColor = 10395294, _
        Optional ColorChkBoxBtnOn As XlRgbColor = vbBlack, _
        Optional ColorChkBoxBtnOff As XlRgbColor = 10395294, _
        Optional ChrDropArrowOn As enumIcons = ArrowOn, _
        Optional ChrDropArrowOff As enumIcons = ArrowOff, _
        Optional ColorChkBoxCaptionOn As XlRgbColor = 14854934, _
        Optional ColorChkBoxCaptionOff As XlRgbColor = 10395294, _
        Optional ChrChkBoxBtnOn As enumIcons = CheckboxComposite, _
        Optional ChrChkBoxBtnOff As enumIcons = CheckBox1, _
        Optional ChrOptBoxBtnOn As enumIcons = CircleFill, _
        Optional ChrOptBoxBtnOff As enumIcons = CircleRing)

    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    Set mUserForm = Form
    If mStyleItems Is Nothing Then Set mStyleItems = New Collection
    Dim cntrl       As MSForms.control
    Dim itemStyle   As clsModernStyle

    ' Loop through all controls on the form
    For Each cntrl In mUserForm.Controls
        ' Check if control already exists in collection to avoid duplicates
        If Not IsControlInCollection(cntrl.Name) Then
            If Not IsControlInClass(cntrl.Name) Then
                Set itemStyle = New clsModernStyle
                With itemStyle
                    Set .control = cntrl
                    .ControlType = TypeName(.control)

                    .Visible = .control.Visible
                    .Enabled = .control.Enabled
                    Select Case .ControlType
                        Case CONTROL_TYPE_LABEL, CONTROL_TYPE_FRAME, CONTROL_TYPE_MULTI_PAGE, _
                                CONTROL_TYPE_IMAGE, CONTROL_TYPE_TABSTRIP, CONTROL_TYPE_SCROLLBAR, CONTROL_TYPE_SPINBUTTON
                        Case Else
                            .Locked = .control.Locked
                    End Select

                    ' Setting default colors
                    .ColorBarTitleOn = ColorBarTitleOn
                    .ColorBarTitleOff = ColorBarTitleOff
                    .ColorBarBottomOn = ColorBarBottomOn
                    .ColorBarBottomOff = ColorBarBottomOff
                    .ColorBackGroundOn = ColorBackGroundOn
                    .ColorBackGroundOff = ColorBackGroundOff
                    .ColorBarIconOn = ColorBarIconOn
                    .ColorBarIconOff = ColorBarIconOff
                    .ColorDropArrowOn = ColorDropArrowOn
                    .ColorDropArrowOff = ColorDropArrowOff

                    .ColorTgBorderOff = ColorTgBorderOff
                    .ColorTgBorderOn = ColorTgBorderOn
                    .ColorChkBoxBtnOff = ColorChkBoxBtnOff
                    .ColorChkBoxBtnOn = ColorChkBoxBtnOn

                    .ColorChkBoxCaptionOn = ColorChkBoxCaptionOn
                    .ColorChkBoxCaptionOff = ColorChkBoxCaptionOff

                    ' Setting characters for arrow
                    .ChrDropArrowOn = VBA.ChrW(ChrDropArrowOn)
                    .ChrDropArrowOff = VBA.ChrW$(ChrDropArrowOff)

                    .ChrChkBoxBtnOff = VBA.ChrW(ChrChkBoxBtnOff)
                    .ChrChkBoxBtnOn = VBA.ChrW(ChrChkBoxBtnOn)

                    .ChrOptBoxBtnOff = VBA.ChrW(ChrOptBoxBtnOff)
                    .ChrOptBoxBtnOn = VBA.ChrW(ChrOptBoxBtnOn)

                    ' Setting main properties
                    .ControlTipText = .control.ControlTipText
                    .Name = .control.Name
                    .top = .control.top
                    .left = .control.left
                    .height = .control.height
                    .width = .control.width

                    Select Case .ControlType
                        Case CONTROL_TYPE_IMAGE, CONTROL_TYPE_SCROLLBAR, CONTROL_TYPE_SPINBUTTON
                        Case Else:
                            .FontSizeTitleOff = .control.Font.Size
                            .FontSizeTitleOn = .FontSizeTitleOff * 0.95
                            .FontName = .control.Font.Name
                    End Select

                    ' Applying style depending on control type
                    Call ApplyControlStyle(itemStyle)

                    Call mStyleItems.Add(itemStyle, .Name)
                    Set .StyleItems = mStyleItems

                    ' Activating style for elements with already entered values
                    Select Case .ControlType
                        Case CONTROL_TYPE_TEXTBOX, CONTROL_TYPE_COMBOBOX, CONTROL_TYPE_LISTBOX
                            If .control.Value <> vbNullString Then Call HandleEnterEvent
                    End Select
                End With
            End If
        End If
    Next cntrl
    Exit Sub

ErrorHandler:
    ' Error handling
    MsgBox "Error initializing style: " & Err.Description, vbCritical
End Sub

'================================================================================
' Section: Methods for setting control styles
'================================================================================
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: ApplyControlStyle
' Purpose: Method to apply style depending on control type
' Parameters:
'   itemStyle - Style object for configuration
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub ApplyControlStyle(ByRef itemStyle As clsModernStyle)
    With itemStyle
        Select Case .ControlType
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_TEXTBOX
                Set .TextBox = itemStyle.control
                Call setTextBoxStyle(itemStyle)
                Call addBarBottom(itemStyle)
                Call addBarTitle(itemStyle)
                Call addBarIcon(itemStyle)
                Call addBackGround(itemStyle)
                Call addBtnClear(itemStyle)
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_COMBOBOX
                Set .ComboBox = itemStyle.control
                Call setComboBoxStyle(itemStyle)
                Call addBarBottom(itemStyle)
                Call addBarTitle(itemStyle)
                Call addBarIcon(itemStyle)
                Call addBackGround(itemStyle)
                Call addDropArrow(itemStyle)
                Call addBtnClear(itemStyle)
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_LISTBOX
                Set .ListBox = itemStyle.control
                Call setListBoxStyle(itemStyle)
                Call addBarBottom(itemStyle)
                Call addBarTitle(itemStyle)
                Call addBarIcon(itemStyle)
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_CHECKBOX
                Set .CheckBox = itemStyle.control
                If .control.Tag = CONTROL_SWITCH Then
                    Call addCheckBoxSwitch(itemStyle)
                Else
                    Call addCheckBox(itemStyle, .ChrChkBoxBtnOff, .ChrChkBoxBtnOn)
                End If
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_OPTIONBUTTON
                Set .OptionButton = itemStyle.control
                If .control.Tag = CONTROL_SWITCH Then
                    Call addCheckBoxSwitch(itemStyle)
                Else
                    Call addCheckBox(itemStyle, .ChrOptBoxBtnOff, .ChrOptBoxBtnOn)
                End If
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_FRAME
                Set .Frame = itemStyle.control
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_LABEL
                Set .label = itemStyle.control
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_COMMANDBUTTON
                Set .CommandButton = itemStyle.control
        End Select
    End With
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: addBarTitle
' Purpose: Adding style title for control
' Parameters:
'   itemStyle - Style object for configuration

Private Sub addBarTitle(ByRef itemStyle As clsModernStyle)
    With itemStyle
        Set .BarTitle = CreateStyledLabel(itemStyle, BAR_TITLE, 1)
        Dim titleLeft As Single, titleTop As Single
        titleLeft = itemStyle.left + 2
        titleTop = itemStyle.top
        If itemStyle.ControlType = CONTROL_TYPE_LISTBOX Then
            titleTop = itemStyle.top - 17
            titleLeft = itemStyle.left
        End If
        Call ConfigureStyleElement(itemStyle.BarTitle, _
                itemStyle.width, _
                itemStyle.height, _
                titleLeft, _
                titleTop)
        With .BarTitle
            .Caption = itemStyle.ControlTipText
            .ForeColor = itemStyle.ColorBarTitleOff
            Call SetCommonFontProperties(itemStyle.BarTitle, itemStyle)
            .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        End With
    End With

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: addCheckBox
' Purpose: Adding checkbox style for control
' Parameters:
'   itemStyle - Style object for configuration
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub addCheckBox(ByRef itemStyle As clsModernStyle, ByRef ChrChkBoxBtnOff As String, ByRef ChrChkBoxBtnOn As String)
    With itemStyle

        .control.Font.Size = 8
        If .control.height < 20 Then .control.height = 20

        Set .ChkBoxBtn = .control.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", .control.Name & SWITCH_THUMB)

        .ChkBoxBtn.left = .control.left
        .ChkBoxBtn.top = .control.top
        .ChkBoxBtn.width = .control.width
        .ChkBoxBtn.height = .control.height
        .ChkBoxBtn.Font.Name = FONT_NAME_ICON
        .ChkBoxBtn.Font.Size = .control.Font.Size * 1.5

        If .control.Value Then
            .ChkBoxBtn.Caption = ChrChkBoxBtnOn
            .ChkBoxBtn.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxBtnOn
        Else
            .ChkBoxBtn.Caption = ChrChkBoxBtnOff
            .ChkBoxBtn.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxBtnOff
        End If

        '.ChkBoxBtn.BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        '.ChkBoxBtn.BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleSingle

        If .control.width - 15 > 0 Then

            Set .ChkBoxCaption = .control.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", .control.Name & SWITCH_CAPTION)

            .ChkBoxCaption.left = .control.left + 15
            .ChkBoxCaption.top = .control.top + 1
            .ChkBoxCaption.width = .control.width - 15
            .ChkBoxCaption.height = .control.height
            .ChkBoxCaption.Font.Name = .control.Font.Name
            .ChkBoxCaption.Font.Size = .control.Font.Size
            .ChkBoxCaption.Caption = .control.Caption
            .ChkBoxCaption.BackColor = .control.BackColor
            .ChkBoxCaption.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxCaptionOff
            .ChkBoxCaption.ZOrder (0)

            If .control.Value Then
                .ChkBoxCaption.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxCaptionOn
            Else
                .ChkBoxCaption.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxCaptionOff
            End If

            '.ChkBoxCaption.BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
            '.ChkBoxCaption.BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleSingle
        End If

        If .control.Value Then
            .ChkBoxBtn.Caption = ChrChkBoxBtnOn
            .ChkBoxBtn.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxBtnOn
            If .control.width - 15 > 0 Then .ChkBoxCaption.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxCaptionOn
        End If
    End With
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: addCheckBoxSwitch
' Purpose: Adding switch style for control
' Parameters:
'   itemStyle - Style object for configuration
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub addCheckBoxSwitch(ByRef itemStyle As clsModernStyle)
    With itemStyle
        .control.Font.Size = 8
        If .control.height < 20 Then .control.height = 20

        Set .TgBorder = .control.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", .Name & SWITCH_BORDER)
        .TgBorder.Visible = .Visible
        .TgBorder.left = .control.left
        .TgBorder.top = .control.top
        .TgBorder.width = .control.width
        If .TgBorder.width < 28 Then .TgBorder.width = 28

        .TgBorder.height = .control.height
        .TgBorder.Font.Name = FONT_NAME_ICON
        .TgBorder.Font.Size = .control.Font.Size * 3.25
        .TgBorder.BackColor = .control.BackColor
        If .control.Value Then
            .TgBorder.ForeColor = .ColorTgBorderOn
            .TgBorder.Caption = VBA.ChrW(ToggleOn)
        Else
            .TgBorder.ForeColor = .ColorTgBorderOff
            .TgBorder.Caption = VBA.ChrW(ToggleOff)
        End If

        '.TgBorder.BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        '.TgBorder.BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleSingle

        If .control.width - 29 > 0 Then

            Set .ChkBoxCaption = .control.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", .Name & SWITCH_CAPTION)

            .ChkBoxCaption.Visible = .Visible
            .ChkBoxCaption.left = .TgBorder.left + 29
            .ChkBoxCaption.top = .TgBorder.top + 8
            .ChkBoxCaption.width = .control.width - 29
            .ChkBoxCaption.height = .control.height * 0.6
            .ChkBoxCaption.Font.Name = .control.Font.Name
            .ChkBoxCaption.Font.Size = .control.Font.Size
            .ChkBoxCaption.Caption = .control.Caption
            .ChkBoxCaption.BackColor = .control.BackColor
            '.ChkBoxCaption.ForeColor = .Control.ForeColor
            '.ChkBoxCaption.BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
            '.ChkBoxCaption.BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleSingle

            If .control.Value Then
                .ChkBoxCaption.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxCaptionOn
            Else
                .ChkBoxCaption.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxCaptionOff
            End If
        End If

        Set .ChkBoxBtn = .control.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", .Name & SWITCH_THUMB)

        .ChkBoxBtn.Visible = .Visible
        .ChkBoxBtn.top = .control.top + 9.5
        .ChkBoxBtn.width = .TgBorder.width
        .ChkBoxBtn.height = .control.height
        .ChkBoxBtn.Font.Name = FONT_NAME_ICON
        .ChkBoxBtn.Font.Size = .control.Font.Size * 0.9
        .ChkBoxBtn.Caption = VBA.ChrW(ToggleThumb)
        .ChkBoxBtn.BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .ChkBoxBtn.BackColor = .control.BackColor
        If .control.Value Then
            .ChkBoxBtn.left = .control.left + 17
            .ChkBoxBtn.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxBtnOn
        Else
            .ChkBoxBtn.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxBtnOff
            .ChkBoxBtn.left = .left + 2
        End If

        .ChkBoxBtn.ZOrder (0)
        '.TgBorder.BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleSingle

        If .control.Value Then
            .ChkBoxBtn.ForeColor = .ColorChkBoxBtnOn
            .TgBorder.ForeColor = .ColorTgBorderOn
        End If
    End With
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: HandleExitEvent
' Purpose: Reset style for all controls
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub HandleExitEvent()
    Dim item        As clsModernStyle
    For Each item In Me.StyleItems
        Call exitControl(item)
    Next item
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: exitControl
' Purpose: Reset control style on focus loss
' Parameters:
'   itemStyle - Style object for configuration
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub exitControl(ByRef itemStyle As clsModernStyle)
    With itemStyle
        If Not IsControlActive(itemStyle) Then Exit Sub
        Select Case .ControlType
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_TEXTBOX, CONTROL_TYPE_COMBOBOX, CONTROL_TYPE_LISTBOX:
                With .BarTitle
                    If VBA.Len(Trim(itemStyle.control.Value)) = 0 Then
                        .ForeColor = itemStyle.ColorBarTitleOff
                        .top = itemStyle.top
                        .left = itemStyle.left + 2
                        .Font.Size = itemStyle.FontSizeTitleOff
                        Call btnClearVisible(itemStyle, False)
                    Else
                        .ForeColor = itemStyle.ColorBarTitleOn
                        .top = itemStyle.top - 17
                        .left = itemStyle.left
                        .Font.Size = itemStyle.FontSizeTitleOn
                        If itemStyle.ControlType = CONTROL_TYPE_LISTBOX Then .ForeColor = itemStyle.ColorBarTitleOff
                        Call btnClearVisible(itemStyle, True)
                    End If
                End With

                With .BarBottom
                    .BackColor = itemStyle.ColorBarBottomOff
                    .height = 1
                End With

                If Not .BackGround Is Nothing Then
                    .BackGround.BackColor = itemStyle.ColorBackGroundOff
                End If

                .BarIcon.ForeColor = itemStyle.ColorBarIconOff

                If Not .DropArrow Is Nothing Then
                    With .DropArrow
                        .ForeColor = itemStyle.ColorDropArrowOff
                        .BackColor = itemStyle.ColorBackGroundOff
                        .Caption = itemStyle.ChrDropArrowOff
                    End With
                End If
        End Select
    End With
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: btnClearVisible
' Purpose: Managing visibility of clear button for control
' Parameters:
'   itemStyle - Style object for configuration
'   bVisible - Button visibility flag
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub btnClearVisible(ByRef itemStyle As clsModernStyle, ByRef bVisible As Boolean)
    If itemStyle.BtnClear Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    itemStyle.BtnClear.Visible = bVisible
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: HandleEnterEvent
' Purpose: Activating control style on focus gain
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub HandleEnterEvent()
    Call HandleExitEvent
    With Me
        If .control Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
        If Not IsControlActive(Me) Then Exit Sub
        .Visible = True
        Select Case .ControlType
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_TEXTBOX, CONTROL_TYPE_LISTBOX, CONTROL_TYPE_COMBOBOX:
                With .BarBottom
                    .BackColor = Me.ColorBarBottomOn
                    .height = 1.2
                End With

                With mBarTitle
                    .ForeColor = Me.ColorBarTitleOn
                    .top = Me.top - 17
                    .Font.Size = Me.FontSizeTitleOn
                    .left = Me.left
                End With

                If Not .BackGround Is Nothing Then
                    .BackGround.BackColor = .ColorBackGroundOn
                End If

                .BarIcon.ForeColor = .ColorBarIconOn

                If Not .DropArrow Is Nothing Then
                    .DropArrow.ForeColor = .ColorDropArrowOn
                    .DropArrow.BackColor = .ColorBackGroundOn
                    Call mDropArrow_Click
                End If
        End Select
    End With
End Sub

'================================================================================
' Section: Control event handling
'================================================================================
' Event handlers for style activation (focusing on element)
Private Sub mListBox_Change()
    Call HandleEnterEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mListBox_MouseDown(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal Shift As Integer, ByVal X As Single, ByVal Y As Single)
    Call HandleEnterEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mListBox_KeyUp(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)
    Call HandleEnterEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mTextBox_Change()
    Call HandleEnterEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mTextbox_MouseDown(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal Shift As Integer, ByVal X As Single, ByVal Y As Single)
    Call HandleEnterEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mTextbox_KeyUp(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)
    Call HandleEnterEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mComboBox_Change()
    Call HandleEnterEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mComboBox_KeyUp(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)
    Call HandleEnterEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mComboBox_MouseDown(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal Shift As Integer, ByVal X As Single, ByVal Y As Single)
    Call HandleEnterEvent
End Sub

' Event handlers for style reset (focus loss)
Private Sub mUserForm_Click()
    Call HandleExitEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mFrame_Click()
    Call HandleExitEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mLabel_Click()
    Call HandleExitEvent
End Sub

Private Sub mCommandButton_Click()
    Call HandleExitEvent
End Sub

' Event handlers for specific controls
Private Sub mDropArrow_Click()
    If Not IsControlActive(Me) Then Exit Sub
    With Me
        Select Case .ControlType
            Case CONTROL_TYPE_COMBOBOX:
                .ComboBox.DropDown
                .DropArrow.Caption = .ChrDropArrowOn
        End Select
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub mBtnClear_Click()
    Me.control.Value = vbNullString
End Sub

Private Sub mChkBoxBtn_Click()
    Call UpdateSwitchState(Me.control.Value, True)
End Sub

Private Sub mTgBorder_Click()
    Call UpdateSwitchState(Me.control.Value, True)
End Sub

Private Sub mCheckBox_Change()
    Call UpdateSwitchState(Not Me.control.Value, False)
End Sub

Private Sub mChkBoxCaption_Click()
    Call UpdateSwitchState(Me.control.Value, True)
End Sub

Private Sub mOptionButton_Change()
    Call UpdateSwitchState(Not Me.control.Value, False)
End Sub

'================================================================================
' Section: Internal helper methods
'================================================================================
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: UpdateSwitchState
' Purpose: Internal method to update switch state
' Parameters:
'   Value - New switch value
'   isChangeValue - Flag indicating whether to change control value
'   isCheckBox - Flag indicating whether element is a checkbox
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub UpdateSwitchState(ByVal Value As Boolean, ByRef isChangeValue As Boolean)
    With Me.control
        If Not IsControlActive(Me) Then Exit Sub
        If Value Then
            If isChangeValue Then .Value = False
            Call UpdateSwitchVisualState(False)
        Else
            If isChangeValue Then .Value = True
            Call UpdateSwitchVisualState(True)
        End If
    End With
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: UpdateSwitchVisualState
' Purpose: Internal method to update switch visual state
' Parameters:
'   isEnabled - Flag indicating whether state is enabled
'   isCheckBox - Flag indicating whether element is a checkbox
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub UpdateSwitchVisualState(ByVal isEnabled As Boolean)
    ' Update position/symbol of element depending on type and state
    With Me
        Select Case .control.Tag
            Case CONTROL_SWITCH:
                ' Update for toggle switch
                .ChkBoxBtn.left = .control.left + IIf(isEnabled, 17, 2)
                If Not .TgBorder Is Nothing Then
                    .TgBorder.Caption = VBA.ChrW(IIf(isEnabled, ToggleOn, ToggleOff))
                End If
            Case Else
                ' Update for checkbox
                If .ControlType = CONTROL_TYPE_CHECKBOX Then
                    .ChkBoxBtn.Caption = IIf(isEnabled, .ChrChkBoxBtnOn, .ChrChkBoxBtnOff)
                Else
                    .ChkBoxBtn.Caption = IIf(isEnabled, .ChrOptBoxBtnOn, .ChrOptBoxBtnOff)
                End If
        End Select

        ' Update colors
        .ChkBoxBtn.ForeColor = IIf(isEnabled, .ColorChkBoxBtnOn, .ColorChkBoxBtnOff)
        If Not .TgBorder Is Nothing Then
            .TgBorder.ForeColor = IIf(isEnabled, .ColorTgBorderOn, .ColorTgBorderOff)
        End If
        If Not .ChkBoxCaption Is Nothing Then
            .ChkBoxCaption.ForeColor = IIf(isEnabled, .ColorChkBoxCaptionOn, .ColorChkBoxCaptionOff)
        End If
    End With
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: IsControlActive
' Purpose: Helper method to check if control is active
' Returns: True if element is visible, unlocked and available
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Function IsControlActive(ByRef itemStyle As clsModernStyle) As Boolean
    With itemStyle
        IsControlActive = .Visible And Not .Locked And .Enabled
    End With
End Function

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: ConfigureStyleElement
' Purpose: Internal method for configuring style element properties
' Parameters:
'   element - Style element to configure
'   itemStyle - Style object
'   width - Element width
'   height - Element height
'   left - Left position
'   top - Top position
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub ConfigureStyleElement(ByRef element As MSForms.label, _
        ByVal width As Single, ByVal height As Single, _
        ByVal left As Single, ByVal top As Single)
    With element
        .width = width
        .height = height
        .left = left
        .top = top
    End With
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Function: IsControlInCollection
' Purpose: Check if control already exists in the collection
' Parameters:
'   controlName - Name of the control to check
' Returns: True if control exists in collection, False otherwise
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Function IsControlInCollection(ByVal controlName As String) As Boolean
    Dim tempItem    As clsModernStyle
    Set tempItem = getItemByName(controlName)
    If Not tempItem Is Nothing Then IsControlInCollection = True
End Function

Private Function IsControlInClass(ByVal controlName As String) As Boolean
    If controlName Like "*" & BAR_BOTTOM Then
        IsControlInClass = True
    ElseIf controlName Like "*" & BAR_TITLE Then
        IsControlInClass = True
    ElseIf controlName Like "*" & BAR_ICON Then
        IsControlInClass = True
    ElseIf controlName Like "*" & BACK_GROUND Then
        IsControlInClass = True
    ElseIf controlName Like "*" & DROP_ARROW Then
        IsControlInClass = True
    ElseIf controlName Like "*" & BTN_CLEAR Then
        IsControlInClass = True
    ElseIf controlName Like "*" & SWITCH_BORDER Then
        IsControlInClass = True
    ElseIf controlName Like "*" & SWITCH_CAPTION Then
        IsControlInClass = True
    ElseIf controlName Like "*" & SWITCH_THUMB Then
        IsControlInClass = True
    End If
End Function

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure: Class_Terminate
' Purpose: Clean up objects when class is terminated
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub Class_Terminate()
    ' Clean up event handler objects
    Set mUserForm = Nothing
    Set mTextBox = Nothing
    Set mComboBox = Nothing
    Set mListBox = Nothing
    Set mFrame = Nothing
    Set mLabel = Nothing
    Set mCommandButton = Nothing
    Set mCheckBox = Nothing
    Set mOptionButton = Nothing

    ' Clean up style elements
    Set mStyleItems = Nothing
    Set mControl = Nothing
    Set mBarBottom = Nothing
    Set mBarTitle = Nothing
    Set mBarIcon = Nothing
    Set mBackGround = Nothing
    Set mDropArrow = Nothing
    Set mBtnClear = Nothing
    Set mTgBorder = Nothing
    Set mChkBoxBtn = Nothing
    Set mChkBoxCaption = Nothing
End Sub

'
Private frmForma    As frmProgresBar_2

Private mWidth      As Single
Private mHeightMessage As Single

Property Get Forma() As frmProgresBar_2
    If frmForma Is Nothing Then
        Set Forma = New frmProgresBar_2
    Else
        Set Forma = frmForma
    End If
End Property

Property Get Header() As String
    Header = frmForma.Caption
End Property

Public Property Let Header(ByRef sHeader As String)
    frmForma.Caption = sHeader
End Property

Property Get MessageTop() As String
    MessageTop = frmForma.Message.Caption
End Property

Public Property Let MessageTop(ByRef sMessage As String)
    frmForma.Message.Caption = sMessage
End Property

Property Get MessageBottom() As String
    MessageBottom = frmForma.MessageTwo
End Property

Public Property Let MessageBottom(ByRef sMessage As String)
    frmForma.MessageTwo.Caption = sMessage
End Property

Property Get ShowPict() As Boolean
    ShowPict = frmForma.lbPict.Visible
End Property

Public Property Let ShowPict(ByRef Show As Boolean)
    frmForma.lbPict.Visible = Show
End Property

Property Get sPict() As String
    sPict = frmForma.lbPict.Caption
End Property

Public Property Let sPict(ByRef sPict As String)
    frmForma.lbPict.Caption = sPict
End Property

Property Get lPictColor() As Long
    lPictColor = frmForma.lbPict.ForeColor
End Property

Public Property Let lPictColor(ByRef lColor As Long)
    frmForma.lbPict.ForeColor = lColor
End Property

Property Get lProgressColor() As Long
    lProgressColor = frmForma.lbLine.BackColor
End Property

Public Property Let lProgressColor(ByRef lColor As Long)
    frmForma.lbLine.BackColor = lColor
End Property

Public Sub Initialize(ByRef sMessage As String, ByRef sHeader As String, Optional bShowPict As Boolean = False, Optional sPict As String = vbNullString)
    Set frmForma = Forma()
    With frmForma
        .Caption = sHeader
        .Message = sMessage
        .MessageTwo = vbNullString
        .ProgressPercent.Caption = "0%"
        .lbLine.Width = 0
        .lbLine.Caption = VBA.String$(300, "|")
        With .lbPict
            .Caption = sPict
            .Left = 0
            .Visible = bShowPict
        End With
        .StartUpPosition = 0
        .Left = Application.Left + 0.5 * (Application.Width - .Width)
        .Top = Application.Top + 0.5 * (Application.Height - .Height)
        mWidth = .Width
        mHeightMessage = .Message.Height
        Call .Show(0)
    End With
End Sub

Public Sub Resize(ByVal Width As Double, ByVal HeightMessage As Double, ByVal HeightMessageTwo As Double)
    With frmForma
        Dim dbDelta As Double
        dbDelta = Width - .Width
        If Width > mWidth Then
            .MessageTwo.Width = dbDelta + .MessageTwo.Width
            .Message.Width = dbDelta + .Message.Width
            .lbLineTwo.Width = dbDelta + .lbLineTwo.Width
            .ProgressPercent.Left = .lbLineTwo.Left + .lbLineTwo.Width
            .Width = Width
        End If

        dbDelta = HeightMessage - .Message.Height
        If .Height + dbDelta > 0 And .Message.Height + dbDelta > 0 Then
            .Height = .Height + dbDelta
            .Message.Height = .Message.Height + dbDelta

            .MessageTwo.Top = .MessageTwo.Top + dbDelta
            .ProgressPercent.Top = .ProgressPercent.Top + dbDelta
            .lbLine.Top = .lbLine.Top + dbDelta
            .lbLineTwo.Top = .lbLineTwo.Top + dbDelta
            .lbPict.Top = .lbPict.Top + dbDelta
        End If

        dbDelta = HeightMessageTwo - .MessageTwo.Height
        If .Height + dbDelta > 0 And .MessageTwo.Height + dbDelta > 0 Then
            .Height = .Height + dbDelta
            .MessageTwo.Height = .MessageTwo.Height + dbDelta

            .ProgressPercent.Top = .ProgressPercent.Top + dbDelta
            .lbLine.Top = .lbLine.Top + dbDelta
            .lbLineTwo.Top = .lbLineTwo.Top + dbDelta
            .lbPict.Top = .lbPict.Top + dbDelta
        End If

        .StartUpPosition = 0
        .Left = Application.Left + (0.5 * Application.Width) - (0.5 * .Width)
        .Top = Application.Top + (0.5 * Application.Height) - (0.5 * .Height)
        .Repaint
    End With
End Sub

Public Sub Update(ByVal i As Long, ByVal iCount As Long, ByVal sMsg As String)
    Dim dol         As Double
    dol = i / iCount
    With frmForma
        .MessageTwo.Caption = sMsg
        If dol <= 1 Then
            .ProgressPercent.Caption = VBA.Format$(dol, "0%")
            .lbLine.Width = .lbLineTwo.Width * dol
            If .lbPict.Visible Then .lbPict.Left = .lbLine.Left + .lbLine.Width - 5
        End If
        .Repaint
        DoEvents
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub Class_Terminate()
    frmForma.Hide
    Set frmForma = Nothing
End Sub

'
''========================================================================================
' Class: clsSlider
' Author: VBATools
' Version: 1.0.3
' Creation Date: 13.11.2025 10:59
' Last Update Date: 29.11.2025 14:00
' License: Apache License
'
' Description:
'    This class implements a custom slider control for VBA UserForms. The slider allows
'    users to select a value within a specified range by dragging a button along a track.
'    It supports both horizontal and vertical orientations and provides customizable
'    appearance and behavior options.
'
' Features:
'    - Horizontal and vertical orientation support
'    - Configurable min/max values and initial value
'    - Customizable appearance (colors, icons, formatting)
'    - Visible/hidden value label with positioning options
'    - Event handling for value changes and clicks
'    - Lock functionality to prevent user interaction
'    - Automatic positioning of value label (top, left, right, bottom)
'
' Usage:
'    1. Create an instance of clsSlider
'    2. Call Initialize method with appropriate parameters
'    3. Handle Change and Click events as needed
'    4. Access Value property to get/set current value
'
' Dependencies:
'    - MSForms library for Label controls
'    - XlRgbColor constants for color properties
'
'========================================================================================

Public Enum PositionValue
    Top = 1  ' Position of the value label above the slider
    Left   ' Position of the value label to the left of the slider
    Right    ' Position of the value label to the right of the slider
    Bottom    ' Position of the value label below the slider
End Enum

Private WithEvents mTxtBtn As MSForms.TextBox
Private WithEvents mParent As MSForms.UserForm
Private mLabelLineEmpty As MSForms.Label
Private mLabelLineFull As MSForms.Label
Private mLabelValue As MSForms.Label

Public Event DblClick(ByRef control As Object, ByRef Value As Single)
Public Event Change(ByRef control As Object, ByRef Value As Single)

Private mNameLabel As String        ' Name of the main slider label
Private mFormatValue As String      ' Format for displaying the value
Private mValue As Single            ' Current slider value
Private mMaxValue As Single         ' Maximum slider value
Private mMinValue As Single         ' Minimum slider value
Private mSliderMinPosition As Single    ' Minimum slider position
Private mSliderMaxPosition As Single    ' Maximum slider position
Private mIsHorizontal As Boolean    ' Flag for horizontal orientation
Private mLocked As Boolean          ' Flag for locking the slider
Private mPositionValue As PositionValue  ' Position of the value label
Private mButtonColor As XlRgbColor
Private mStep As Single

Public Property Get Version() As String
    ' Returns version information about the class
    ' Example: Debug.Print slider.Version
    Version = "Class: clsSlider" & vbNewLine & _
            "Author: VBATools" & vbNewLine & _
            "Version: 1.0.3" & vbNewLine & _
            "Date of creation: 13.11.2025 10:59" & vbNewLine & _
            "Date of update: 29.11.2025 14:00" & vbNewLine & _
            "License: Apache" & vbNewLine & _
            "Description: Custom slider control for VBA UserForms with horizontal/vertical orientation support"
End Property

Public Property Get StepSlider() As Single
    StepSlider = mStep
End Property

Public Property Let StepSlider(ByVal Value As Single)

    If Value = 0 Or (mMaxValue - mMinValue) < Value Then
        mStep = (mMaxValue - mMinValue) / mLabelLineEmpty.Width
    Else
        mStep = Value
    End If
End Property

Public Property Get Locked() As Boolean
    ' Returns the lock state of the slider
    ' If True, the slider does not respond to user actions
    ' Example: If slider.Locked Then Debug.Print "Slider is locked"
    Locked = mLocked
End Property

Public Property Let Locked(ByVal Value As Boolean)
    ' Sets the lock state of the slider
    ' When True, the slider does not respond to user actions
    ' Example: slider.Locked = True
    mLocked = Value
End Property

Public Property Get Enabled() As Boolean
    ' Returns the enabled state of the slider
    ' If False, the slider appears grayed out and does not respond to user actions
    ' Example: If slider.Enabled Then Debug.Print "Slider is enabled"
    Enabled = mTxtBtn.Enabled
End Property

Public Property Let Enabled(ByVal Value As Boolean)
    ' Sets the enabled state of the slider
    ' When False, the slider appears grayed out and does not respond to user actions
    ' Example: slider.Enabled = False
    mTxtBtn.Enabled = Value
    mLabelValue.Enabled = Value
End Property

Public Property Get Visible() As Boolean
    ' Returns the visibility state of all slider elements
    ' If False, all slider elements are hidden
    ' Example: If slider.Visible Then Debug.Print "Slider is visible"
    Visible = mTxtBtn.Visible
End Property

Public Property Let Visible(ByVal Value As Boolean)
    ' Sets the visibility state of all slider elements
    ' When False, all slider elements are hidden
    ' Example: slider.Visible = False
    mTxtBtn.Visible = Value
    mLabelLineEmpty.Visible = Value
    mLabelLineFull.Visible = Value
    mLabelValue.Visible = Value
End Property

Public Property Get VisibleLabelValue() As Boolean
    ' Returns the visibility state of the slider value label
    ' If False, the value label is not displayed
    ' Example: If slider.VisibleLabelValue Then Debug.Print "Value label is visible"
    VisibleLabelValue = mLabelValue.Visible
End Property

Public Property Let VisibleLabelValue(ByVal Value As Boolean)
    ' Sets the visibility state of the slider value label
    ' When False, the value label is hidden
    ' Example: slider.VisibleLabelValue = False
    mLabelValue.Visible = Value
End Property

Public Property Get Icon() As Long
    ' Returns the icon on the slider button (as a Unicode character value)
    ' Example: Dim currentIcon As Long: currentIcon = slider.Icon
    Icon = VBA.CLng(mTxtBtn.Caption)
End Property

Public Property Let Icon(ByVal Value As Long)
    ' Sets the icon on the slider button
    ' Accepts a Unicode character value
    ' Example: slider.Icon = 59963  (sets an icon from Segoe MDL2 Assets font)
    mTxtBtn.Value = VBA.ChrW(Value)
End Property

Public Property Get PositionLabelValue() As PositionValue
    ' Returns the current position of the slider value label
    ' Possible values: Top, Left, Right, Bottom
    ' Example: Dim pos As PositionValue: pos = slider.PositionLabelValue
    PositionLabelValue = mPositionValue
End Property

Public Property Let PositionLabelValue(ByVal Value As PositionValue)
    ' Sets the position of the slider value label
    ' Accepts a value from the PositionValue enumeration (Top, Left, Right, Bottom)
    ' Example: slider.PositionLabelValue = clsSlider.PositionValue.Right
    mPositionValue = Value
    Call UpdateValueLabelPosition(mPositionValue)
End Property

Public Property Get FormatValue() As String

Public Property Get ForeColorValue() As XlRgbColor

Public Property Get Name() As String
    ' Returns the name of the main slider label

    ' Returns whether the slider is horizontal
    ' True - horizontal, False - vertical
    ' Example: If slider.IsHorizontal Then Debug.Print "Slider is horizontal"
    IsHorizontal = mIsHorizontal

Public Property Get MinValue() As Single
    ' Returns the minimum value of the slider
    ' Example: Dim minVal As Single: minVal = slider.MinValue
