Public Property Let Value(ByVal Value As Single)
    ' Sets the current value of the slider
    ' The value must be within the range from MinValue to MaxValue
    ' Example: slider.Value = 50
    Select Case Value
        Case mMinValue To mMaxValue:
            Call SetValue(Value)
    End Select
End Property

Public Sub Initialize(ByRef labelSlider As MSForms.Label, _
        ByVal Value As Single, _
        ByVal MinValue As Single, _
        ByVal MaxValue As Single, _
        ByVal VisibleLabelValue As Boolean, _
        Optional StepSlider As Single = 0, _
        Optional FormatValue As String = vbNullString, _
        Optional PositionValue As PositionValue = Top, _
        Optional BackColorEmpty As XlRgbColor = rgbLightGray, _
        Optional BackColorFull As XlRgbColor = rgbGreenYellow, _
        Optional ForeColorBtn As XlRgbColor = rgbBlack, _
        Optional ForeColorValue As XlRgbColor = rgbBlack, _
        Optional Icon As Long = 59963)
    ' Initializes the slider with specified parameters
    ' Parameters:
    ' - labelSlider: the main label that will be used as the empty slider line
    ' - Value: initial value of the slider
    ' - MinValue: minimum value of the slider
    ' - MaxValue: maximum value of the slider
    ' - VisibleLabelValue: visibility of the value label
    ' - FormatValue: format for displaying the value (default vbNullString)
    ' - PositionValue: position of the value label (default Top)
    ' - BackColorEmpty: color of the empty part of the line (default rgbLightGray)
    ' - BackColorFull: color of the filled part of the line (default rgbGreenYellow)
    ' - ForeColorBtn: color of the button (default rgbBlack)
    ' - ForeColorValue: color of the value (default rgbBlack)
    ' - Icon: icon on the button (default 59963)
    '
    ' Usage example:
    ' Dim slider As New clsSlider
    ' Call slider.Initialize(Me.Label1, 50, 0, 100, True, "0.0", clsSlider.PositionValue.Top)
    '
    ' Check if the value range is valid
    If MinValue >= MaxValue Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1001, "clsSlider", "Minimum value must be less than maximum value"
    End If

    ' Check if the initial value is within the range
    If Value < MinValue Or Value > MaxValue Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1002, "clsSlider", "Initial value must be within the MinValue..MaxValue range"
    End If

    Set mLabelLineEmpty = labelSlider
    Set mParent = mLabelLineEmpty.Parent
    mValue = Value
    mMaxValue = MaxValue
    mMinValue = MinValue
    mFormatValue = FormatValue
    mPositionValue = PositionValue
    mButtonColor = ForeColorBtn

    If StepSlider = 0 Or (mMaxValue - mMinValue) < StepSlider Then
            mStep = (mMaxValue - mMinValue) / mLabelLineEmpty.Width
        Else
            mStep = StepSlider
        End If

    With mLabelLineEmpty
        mIsHorizontal = .Width / .Height > 1
        If mIsHorizontal Then
            .Height = 3
            mSliderMinPosition = .Left
            mSliderMaxPosition = mSliderMinPosition + .Width
        Else
            .Width = 3
            mSliderMinPosition = .Top
            mSliderMaxPosition = mSliderMinPosition + .Height
        End If
        .Caption = vbNullString
        mNameLabel = .Name
        .BackColor = BackColorEmpty
        Set mLabelLineFull = mLabelLineEmpty.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.label.1", mNameLabel & "_full", True)
        Set mTxtBtn = mLabelLineEmpty.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.TextBox.1", mNameLabel & "_btn", True)
        Set mLabelValue = mLabelLineEmpty.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.label.1", mNameLabel & "_value", True)
    End With

    With mLabelLineFull
        .Caption = vbNullString
        .Top = mLabelLineEmpty.Top
        .Left = mLabelLineEmpty.Left
        .BackColor = BackColorFull
        .ZOrder 0
    End With

    With mTxtBtn
        .Height = 20
        .Width = .Height
        .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .TextAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
        .Font.Name = "Segoe MDL2 Assets"
        .Font.Size = 10
        .Value = VBA.ChrW(Icon)
        .Locked = True
        .SpecialEffect = fmSpecialEffectFlat
        '.BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleSingle
        .ForeColor = ForeColorBtn
        .MousePointer = fmMousePointerArrow
        .ZOrder 0
    End With

    With mLabelValue
        .Visible = VisibleLabelValue
        .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .Font.Name = mLabelLineEmpty.Font.Name
        .Font.Size = mLabelLineEmpty.Font.Size
        .TextAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
        .ForeColor = ForeColorValue
        .ZOrder 0
    End With
    Call SetValue(mValue)
End Sub

Private Sub mTxtBtn_KeyDown(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal shift As Integer)
    Dim sShift      As Double
    If mIsHorizontal Then
        Select Case KeyCode
            Case 37, 65
                Call ApplyHoverEffect(100)
                sShift = mValue - mStep
                If sShift < mMinValue Then sShift = mMinValue
                Me.Value = sShift
            Case 39, 68
                Call ApplyHoverEffect(100)
                sShift = mValue + mStep
                If sShift > mMaxValue Then sShift = mMaxValue
                Me.Value = sShift
        End Select
    Else
        Select Case KeyCode
            Case 38, 87
                Call ApplyHoverEffect(100)
                KeyCode = 87
                sShift = mValue - mStep
                If sShift < mMinValue Then sShift = mMinValue
                Me.Value = sShift
            Case 40, 83
                Call ApplyHoverEffect(100)
                KeyCode = 83
                sShift = mValue + mStep
                If sShift > mMaxValue Then sShift = mMaxValue
                Me.Value = sShift
        End Select
    End If
    mTxtBtn.SetFocus
    RaiseEvent Change(mTxtBtn, mValue)
End Sub

' DblClick event handler for the slider button
' Event handler for the slider button click
' Raises the DblClick event, passing a reference to the control and the current value
' Example usage in a form:
' Private Sub slider_DblClick(control As Object, Value As Single)
'     Debug.Print "DblClick on control: " & control.Name & ", value: " & Value
' End Sub
Private Sub mTxtBtn_DblClick(ByVal Cancel As MSForms.ReturnBoolean)
    If mLocked Then Exit Sub
    Cancel = True
    RaiseEvent DblClick(mTxtBtn, mValue)
End Sub

' MouseUp event handler for the slider
' Event handler for releasing the mouse button on the slider
' Updates the button position after dragging is completed
' Example usage: updating button position when mouse is released
Private Sub mTxtBtn_MouseUp(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal shift As Integer, ByVal X As Single, ByVal Y As Single)
    If Button <> 1 Or mLocked Then Exit Sub
    With mTxtBtn
        If mIsHorizontal Then
            .Left = mLabelLineFull.Left + mLabelLineFull.Width - .Width / 2
        Else
            .Top = mLabelLineFull.Top + mLabelLineFull.Height - .Height / 2
        End If
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub mParent_MouseMove(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal shift As Integer, ByVal X As Single, ByVal Y As Single)
    Call ApplyHoverEffect(0)
End Sub

' MouseMove event handler for the slider
' Event handler for mouse movement on the slider
' Updates the button position and slider value during dragging
' Raises the Change event when the value changes
' Example usage in a form:
' Private Sub slider_Change(control As Object, Value As Single)
'     Debug.Print "Value changed: " & Value
' End Sub
Private Sub mTxtBtn_MouseMove(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal shift As Integer, ByVal X As Single, ByVal Y As Single)
    Call ApplyHoverEffect(100)
    If Button <> 1 Or mLocked Then Exit Sub
    With mTxtBtn
        If mIsHorizontal Then
            Select Case .Left + X
                Case mSliderMinPosition To mSliderMaxPosition - 5:
                    .Left = .Left + X
                    Select Case mTxtBtn.Left + X
                        Case Is < mSliderMinPosition
                            mLabelLineFull.Width = 0
                        Case Is > mSliderMaxPosition
                            mLabelLineFull.Width = mLabelLineEmpty.Width
                        Case Else
                            If mLabelLineFull.Width + X < 0 Then
                                mLabelLineFull.Width = 0
                            Else
                                mLabelLineFull.Width = mLabelLineFull.Width + X
                            End If
                    End Select
            End Select
        Else
            Select Case .Top + Y
                Case mSliderMinPosition To mSliderMaxPosition - 5:
                    .Top = .Top + Y
                    Select Case mTxtBtn.Top + Y
                        Case Is < mSliderMinPosition
                            mLabelLineFull.Height = 0
                        Case Is > mSliderMaxPosition
                            mLabelLineFull.Height = mLabelLineEmpty.Height
                        Case Else
                            If mLabelLineFull.Height + Y < 0 Then
                                mLabelLineFull.Height = 0
                            Else
                                mLabelLineFull.Height = mLabelLineFull.Height + Y
                            End If
                    End Select
            End Select
        End If
    End With
    If mFormatValue = vbNullString Then
        mLabelValue.Caption = getValue()
    Else
        mLabelValue.Caption = VBA.Format$(getValue(), mFormatValue)
    End If
    RaiseEvent Change(mTxtBtn, mValue)
End Sub

' Applies a hover effect to the slider button by adjusting its color
' The shade parameter determines the intensity of the effect (0-255)
Private Sub ApplyHoverEffect(ByVal shade As Byte)
    mTxtBtn.ForeColor = BlendColor(mButtonColor, RGB(255, 255, 255), shade / 255)
End Sub

' Function to blend two colors based on a factor
' This function is used to create the hover effect on the slider button
' Parameters:
' - color1: the base color to start from
' - color2: the target color to blend towards
' - factor: the blending factor (0.0 to 1.0), where 0.0 is color1 and 1.0 is color2
Private Function BlendColor(ByVal color1 As Long, color2 As Long, factor As Double) As Long
    Dim r1 As Byte, g1 As Byte, b1 As Byte
    Dim r2 As Byte, g2 As Byte, b2 As Byte
    Dim r As Byte, g As Byte, b As Byte
    
    ' Extract RGB components from the first color (VBA uses BGR format)
    r1 = color1 Mod 256
    g1 = (color1 \ 256) Mod 256
    b1 = (color1 \ 65536) Mod 256
    
    ' Extract RGB components from the second color (VBA uses BGR format)
    r2 = color2 Mod 256
    g2 = (color2 \ 256) Mod 256
    b2 = (color2 \ 65536) Mod 256
    
    ' Blend the colors
    r = r1 + (r2 - r1) * factor
    g = g1 + (g2 - g1) * factor
    b = b1 + (b2 - b1) * factor
    
    ' Return the blended color
    BlendColor = RGB(r, g, b)
End Function

' Calculates the current slider value based on the slider position and value range
' Calculates the current slider value based on the position of the thumb and value range
' Returns a value in the range from MinValue to MaxValue
' Example usage: Dim currentValue As Single: currentValue = slider.getValue()
Private Function getValue() As Single
    ' Check for division by zero
    If mLabelLineEmpty.Width = 0 Or mLabelLineEmpty.Height = 0 Then
        getValue = mMinValue
        mValue = getValue
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim positionRatio As Double
    If mIsHorizontal Then
        positionRatio = mLabelLineFull.Width / mLabelLineEmpty.Width
    Else
        positionRatio = mLabelLineFull.Height / mLabelLineEmpty.Height
    End If

    ' Calculate the raw value based on position ratio
    Dim rawValue As Double
    rawValue = mMinValue + positionRatio * (mMaxValue - mMinValue)

    ' Apply step increment to the value
    Dim stepValue As Double
    stepValue = (rawValue - mMinValue) / mStep
    If (stepValue - Fix(stepValue)) > 0.5 Then
        getValue = mMinValue + Fix(stepValue) * mStep + mStep
    Else
        getValue = mMinValue + Fix(stepValue) * mStep
    End If

    ' Ensure the value is within bounds
    If getValue > mMaxValue Then
        getValue = mMaxValue
    ElseIf getValue < mMinValue Then
        getValue = mMinValue
    End If

    mValue = getValue
    Call SetValue(mValue)
End Function

' Sets the slider value and updates the position of the controls
' Sets the slider value and updates the position of the controls
' Accepts a new value and adjusts the slider control positions accordingly
' Example usage: Call slider.SetValue(75)
Private Sub SetValue(ByRef snValue As Single)
    mValue = snValue
    Call UpdateSliderLinePosition
    Call UpdateButtonPosition
    Call UpdateValueLabelDisplay
End Sub

' Updates the position and size of the slider line based on the current value
Private Sub UpdateSliderLinePosition()
    With mLabelLineFull
        If mIsHorizontal Then
            .Height = mLabelLineEmpty.Height
            ' Check for division by zero
            If mMaxValue <> mMinValue Then
                .Width = (mValue - mMinValue) / (mMaxValue - mMinValue) * mLabelLineEmpty.Width
            Else
                .Width = 0
            End If
        Else
            ' Check for division by zero
            If mMaxValue <> mMinValue Then
                .Height = (mValue - mMinValue) / (mMaxValue - mMinValue) * mLabelLineEmpty.Height
            Else
                .Height = 0
            End If
            .Width = mLabelLineEmpty.Width
        End If
    End With
End Sub

' Updates the position of the slider button based on the current value and orientation
Private Sub UpdateButtonPosition()
    With mTxtBtn
        If mIsHorizontal Then
            .Top = mLabelLineEmpty.Top + mLabelLineEmpty.Height / 2 - .Height / 2 + 3
            .Left = mLabelLineFull.Left + mLabelLineFull.Width - .Width / 2
        Else
            .Top = mLabelLineFull.Top + mLabelLineFull.Height - .Height / 2
            .Left = mLabelLineEmpty.Left + mLabelLineEmpty.Width / 2 - .Width / 2 - 3
        End If
    End With
End Sub

' Updates the value label display with the current value and format
Private Sub UpdateValueLabelDisplay()
    With mLabelValue
        .Height = 10
        .Width = 30
        Call UpdateValueLabelPosition(mPositionValue)
        .Caption = mValue
        If mFormatValue <> vbNullString Then .Caption = VBA.Format$(mValue, mFormatValue)
    End With
End Sub

' Additional helper methods for improved maintainability
' These methods separate concerns and make the code more modular

' Validates that the minimum value is less than the maximum value
Private Function IsValidRange() As Boolean
    IsValidRange = (mMinValue < mMaxValue)
End Function

' Calculates the position ratio of the current value within the slider range
Private Function CalculatePositionRatio() As Double
    If mMaxValue <> mMinValue Then
        CalculatePositionRatio = (mValue - mMinValue) / (mMaxValue - mMinValue)
    Else
        CalculatePositionRatio = 0
    End If
End Function

' Ensures the given value is within the valid range
Private Function ConstrainValue(ByVal inputValue As Single) As Single
    If inputValue < mMinValue Then
        ConstrainValue = mMinValue
    ElseIf inputValue > mMaxValue Then
        ConstrainValue = mMaxValue
    Else
        ConstrainValue = inputValue
    End If
End Function

' Changes the position of the slider value label depending on the given position
' Changes the position of the slider value label based on the specified position
' Accepts a value from the PositionValue enumeration and sets the appropriate label position
' Example usage: Call slider.changePositionLabelValue(clsSlider.PositionValue.Right)
Private Sub UpdateValueLabelPosition(ByVal pos As PositionValue)
    With mLabelValue
        Select Case pos
            Case PositionValue.Top:
                .Top = mLabelLineEmpty.Top - .Height - 5
                .Left = mLabelLineEmpty.Left + mLabelLineEmpty.Width / 2 - .Width / 2
            Case PositionValue.Left:
                .Top = mLabelLineEmpty.Top + mLabelLineEmpty.Height / 2 - .Height / 2
                .Left = mLabelLineEmpty.Left - .Width
            Case PositionValue.Right:
                .Top = mLabelLineEmpty.Top + mLabelLineEmpty.Height / 2 - .Height / 2
                .Left = mLabelLineEmpty.Left + mLabelLineEmpty.Width + 5
            Case PositionValue.Bottom:
                .Top = mLabelLineEmpty.Top + mLabelLineEmpty.Height + 5
                .Left = mLabelLineEmpty.Left + mLabelLineEmpty.Width / 2 - .Width / 2
        End Select
    End With
End Sub

' Clean up resources when the class object is destroyed
' Sets all internal objects to Nothing to prevent memory leaks
Private Sub Class_Terminate()
    Set mTxtBtn = Nothing
    Set mLabelLineEmpty = Nothing
    Set mLabelLineFull = Nothing
    Set mLabelValue = Nothing
    Set mParent = Nothing
End Sub

Private Const RESIZE_HANDLE = "_handle"
Private WithEvents mResizeHandle As MSForms.Label
Private mTextBox    As MSForms.textBox

Private snTop       As Single
Private snLeft      As Single

Private snMinHeight As Single
Private snMinWidth  As Single
Private snMaxHeight As Single
Private snMaxWidth  As Single
Private snOldHeight As Single
Private snOldWidth  As Single

Public Property Get Version() As String
    Version = "Class: clsTextArea" & vbNewLine & _
            "Author: VBATools" & vbNewLine & _
            "Version: 1.0.1" & vbNewLine & _
            "Date of creation: 12.11.2025 16:50" & vbNewLine & _
            "Date of update: 12.11.2025 23:57" & vbNewLine & _
            "License: Apache" & vbNewLine & _
            "Description:"
End Property

Public Sub Initialize(ByRef textBox As MSForms.textBox, Optional maxSizeHeight As Single, Optional maxSizeWidth As Single)
    Set mTextBox = textBox
    With mTextBox
        .MultiLine = True
        Call .ZOrder(0)
        snTop = .Top
        snLeft = .Left
        snMinHeight = .Height
        snMinWidth = .Width
        snOldHeight = snMinHeight
        snOldWidth = snMinWidth
        Set mResizeHandle = mTextBox.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.label.1", .Name & RESIZE_HANDLE, True)
    End With
    With mResizeHandle
        With .Font
            .Name = "Marlett"
            .Charset = 2
            .Size = 14
            .Bold = True
        End With
        .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
        .BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleNone
        .MousePointer = fmMousePointerSizeNWSE
        .AutoSize = True
        .Caption = "o"
        .ForeColor = &HC0C0C0
        .Top = snTop + snOldHeight - .Height
        .Left = snLeft + snOldWidth - .Width
        Call .ZOrder(0)
    End With
    With mTextBox.Parent
        snMaxHeight = .InsideHeight - snTop
        If maxSizeHeight <> 0 Then snMaxHeight = maxSizeHeight
        If snMaxHeight + snTop > .InsideHeight Then snMaxHeight = .InsideHeight - snTop

        snMaxWidth = .InsideWidth - snLeft
        If maxSizeWidth <> 0 Then snMaxWidth = maxSizeWidth
        If snMaxWidth + snLeft > .InsideWidth Then snMaxWidth = .InsideWidth - snLeft
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub mResizeHandle_MouseMove(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal Shift As Integer, ByVal x As Single, ByVal y As Single)
    If Button = 1 Then
        Dim sngSize As Single
        With mTextBox
            If .Width + x <= snMaxWidth Then
                sngSize = .Width + x
                If sngSize < snMinWidth Then sngSize = snMinWidth
                If sngSize > snMaxWidth Then sngSize = snMaxWidth
                .Width = sngSize
                mResizeHandle.Left = .Left + .Width - mResizeHandle.Width
            End If

            If .Height + y <= snMaxHeight Then
                sngSize = .Height + y
                If sngSize < snMinHeight Then sngSize = snMinHeight
                If sngSize > snMaxHeight Then sngSize = snMaxHeight
                .Height = sngSize
                mResizeHandle.Top = .Top + .Height - mResizeHandle.Height
            End If
        End With
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub mResizeHandle_DblClick(ByVal Cancel As MSForms.ReturnBoolean)
    With mTextBox
        If .Height = snOldHeight Then
            .Height = snMaxHeight
        Else
            .Height = snOldHeight
        End If
        If .Width = snOldWidth Then
            .Width = snMaxWidth
        Else
            .Width = snOldWidth
        End If

        mResizeHandle.Left = .Left + .Width - mResizeHandle.Width
        mResizeHandle.Top = .Top + .Height - mResizeHandle.Height
    End With
End Sub

'========================================================================================
' Class: clsTextboxMask
' Author: VBATools
' Version: 1.0.7
' Creation Date: 05.11.2025 10:30
' Last Update Date: 11.11.2025 15:57
' License: Apache License
'========================================================================================
' Purpose:
'   Class for creating textbox fields with input masks in VBA. Provides input validation, placeholder display
'   and visual indication of field fill status. Supports various mask types: numeric, letters, dates,
'   phone numbers and others.
'
' Main Features:
'   - Support for various input mask types (numbers, dates, time, text, regular expressions)
'   - Real-time input validation
'   - Display of placeholders with different statuses (empty, partially filled, completely filled, invalid)
'   - Visual indication of input correctness through border color
'   - Support for numeric values with range, sign and decimal restrictions
'   - Support for variable length text
'   - Support for validation via regular expressions
'
' Usage Examples:
'   1. Creating a numeric field with constraints:
'      Dim numField As New clsTextboxMask
'      Call numField.AddFieldNumeric(inputTextBox:=Me.TextBox1, _
       '                                   minValue:=0, _
       '                                   maxValue:=100, _
       '                                   allowDecimal:=True)
'
'   2. Creating a date field:
'      Dim dateField As New clsTextboxMask
'      Call dateField.AddFieldDate(inputTextBox:=Me.TextBox2, _
       '                                 dateMask:="##.##.####", _
       '                                 minDate:=#1/1/2020#, _
       '                                 maxDate:=#12/31/2030#, _
       '                                 dateFormat:="dd.mm.yyyy")
'
'   3. Creating a text field with mask:
'      Dim textField As New clsTextboxMask
'      Call textField.AddFieldText(inputTextBox:=Me.TextBox3, _
       '                                 textMask:="+7(*##) @# A# #?‘#")  ' Letters-digits
'
' Dependencies:
'   - MSForms.TextBox
'   - MSForms.Label
'   - VBScript.RegExp (for validation via regular expressions)
'
'========================================================================================

Public Enum enumTypeMask
    tOtherFix = 1
    tDateFix
    tTimeFix
    tNumeric
    tVariableLen
    tRegex
    [_First] = tOtherFix
    [_Last] = tRegex
End Enum

Private Const HOLDER As String = "_holder"

Private mSimvolsMasks As String
Private mBorderColorValid As Long
Private mBorderColorInvalid As Long

Private WithEvents mTextBox As MSForms.TextBox
Private mLabelPlaceholder As MSForms.label
Private mLabelStatus As MSForms.label

Private mItems      As Collection

Private mMask       As String
Private mFormatValue As String

Private mRegexPattern As String             ' Regular expression pattern for tRegex masks
Private mRegexFilter As String              ' Regular expression filter
Private mRegex      As Object               ' Cached regex object for tRegex masks

Private mPlaceholderEmpty As String         ' Placeholder text when field is empty

'========================================================================================
' Property: PlaceholderMask
'========================================================================================
' Purpose:
'   Returns the current placeholder mask, which shows the remaining characters that need to be filled in the textbox
'   If the textbox value is shorter than the mask length, the placeholder will show the remaining mask characters
'   If the textbox value is equal to or longer than the mask length, the placeholder will be empty
'
' Return Value:
'   String - The placeholder mask showing remaining characters to be filled
'========================================================================================
Public Property Get PlaceholderMask() As String
    If Me.TextBox Is Nothing Then Exit Property

    Dim LenValue    As Integer
    Dim lenMask     As Integer
    Dim sMask       As String

    LenValue = Me.LenValue
    lenMask = Me.lenMask
    sMask = Me.Mask

    If lenMask >= LenValue Then
        PlaceholderMask = Me.Value & VBA.Mid$(sMask, LenValue + 1, lenMask - LenValue)
    Else
        PlaceholderMask = sMask
    End If
End Property

Public Property Get getItemsIsValid() As Boolean
    If Me.Items Is Nothing Then Exit Property
    Dim item        As clsTextboxMask
    For Each item In Me.Items
        If item.IsValid = False Then Exit Property
    Next item
    getItemsIsValid = True
End Property

Public Property Get getItemsValue() As Variant
    If Me.Items Is Nothing Then Exit Property
    Dim item        As clsTextboxMask
    Dim i           As Integer
    ReDim arr(1 To Me.Count, 1 To 2)
    For Each item In Me.Items
        With item
            If .IsValid = False Then Exit Property
            i = i + 1
            arr(i, 1) = .TextBox.Name
            arr(i, 2) = .Value
        End With
    Next item
    getItemsValue = arr
End Property

' Procedure: AddFieldVariableLength
' ========================================================================================
' Purpose:
'   Adds a field with variable text length
'
' Parameters:
'   inputTextBox - textbox field to which the mask is applied
'   maxLength - maximum text length
'   textMask - text input mask (optional)
'   showPlaceholder - show placeholder
'   BorderColorValid - border color for correct input
'   BorderColorInvalid - border color for incorrect input
'   PlaceholderEmptyColor  - placeholder color
'   PlaceholderEmpty - placeholder text for empty field
'   PlaceholderPartial - placeholder text for partially filled field
'   PlaceholderComplete - placeholder text for completely filled field
'   PlaceholderInvalid - placeholder text for field with invalid data
'   PlaceHolderTemplete - placeholder template
' ========================================================================================
Public Sub AddFieldVariableLength(ByRef inputTextBox As MSForms.TextBox, _
        ByVal minLength As Integer, _
        ByVal maxLength As Integer, _
        Optional textMask As String = vbNullString, _
        Optional ShowStatus As Boolean = True, _
        Optional StatusPositionLeft As Boolean = True, _
        Optional ShowPlaceholder As Boolean = True, _
        Optional BorderColorValid As XlRgbColor = 0, _
        Optional BorderColorInvalid As XlRgbColor = 0, _
        Optional PlaceholderEmptyColor As XlRgbColor = 0, _
        Optional PlaceholderEmpty As String = vbNullString, _
        Optional PlaceholderPartialColor As XlRgbColor = 0, _
        Optional PlaceholderPartial As String = vbNullString, _
        Optional PlaceholderCompleteColor As XlRgbColor = 0, _
        Optional PlaceholderComplete As String = vbNullString, _
        Optional PlaceholderInvalidColor As XlRgbColor = 0, _
        Optional PlaceholderInvalid As String = vbNullString, _
        Optional PlaceHolderTemplate As String = "{holder}")
    Dim maskStr     As String
    If textMask <> vbNullString Then
        If VBA.Len(textMask) < maxLength Then
            maskStr = textMask & VBA.String$(maxLength - VBA.Len(textMask), "*")
        Else
            maskStr = textMask
        End If
    Else
        ' If no mask is specified, use arbitrary text up to maxLength
        maskStr = VBA.String$(maxLength, "*")
    End If

    Call AddField(inputTextBox:=inputTextBox, _
            textMask:=maskStr, _
            maskType:=enumTypeMask.tVariableLen, _
            FormatValue:=vbNullString, _
            allowDecimal:=False, _
            BorderColorValid:=BorderColorValid, _
            BorderColorInvalid:=BorderColorInvalid, _
            minValue:=minLength, _
            maxValue:=maxLength, _
            ShowPlaceholder:=ShowPlaceholder, _
            PlaceholderEmptyColor:=PlaceholderEmptyColor, _
            PlaceholderPartialColor:=PlaceholderPartialColor, _
            PlaceholderCompleteColor:=PlaceholderCompleteColor, _
            PlaceholderInvalidColor:=PlaceholderInvalidColor, _
            RegexPattern:=vbNullString, _
            PlaceholderEmpty:=PlaceholderEmpty, _
            PlaceholderPartial:=PlaceholderPartial, _
            PlaceholderComplete:=PlaceholderComplete, _
            PlaceholderInvalid:=PlaceholderInvalid, _
            PlaceHolderTemplate:=PlaceHolderTemplate, _
            RegexFilter:=vbNullString, _
            ShowStatus:=ShowStatus, _
            StatusPositionLeft:=StatusPositionLeft)
End Sub

Private Sub AddField(ByRef inputTextBox As MSForms.TextBox, _
        ByVal textMask As String, _
        ByVal maskType As enumTypeMask, _
        ByVal FormatValue As String, _
        ByVal allowDecimal As Boolean, _
        ByVal BorderColorValid As XlRgbColor, _
        ByVal BorderColorInvalid As XlRgbColor, _
        ByVal minValue As Single, _
        ByVal maxValue As Single, _
        ByVal ShowPlaceholder As Boolean, _
        ByVal PlaceholderEmptyColor As XlRgbColor, _
        ByVal PlaceholderEmpty As String, _
        ByVal PlaceholderPartialColor As XlRgbColor, _
        ByVal PlaceholderPartial As String, _
        ByVal PlaceholderCompleteColor As XlRgbColor, _
        ByVal PlaceholderComplete As String, _
        ByVal PlaceholderInvalidColor As XlRgbColor, _
        ByVal PlaceholderInvalid As String, _
        ByVal PlaceHolderTemplate As String, _
        ByVal RegexPattern As String, _
        ByVal RegexFilter As String, _
        ByVal ShowStatus As Boolean, _
        ByVal StatusPositionLeft As Boolean)

    If inputTextBox Is Nothing Then
        Call Err.Raise(vbObjectError + 101, "clsTextboxMask", "TextBox cannot be Nothing")
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If maskType < enumTypeMask.[_First] Or maskType > enumTypeMask.[_Last] Then
        Call Err.Raise(vbObjectError + 102, "clsTextboxMask", "Invalid mask type")
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If IsControlInCollection(inputTextBox.Name) Then
        Call Err.Raise(vbObjectError + 103, "clsTextboxMask", "The item has already been created")
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim itemCls     As clsTextboxMask
    Set itemCls = New clsTextboxMask

    With itemCls
        Set .TextBox = inputTextBox
        .Mask = textMask
        If .lenMask > 0 Then .TextBox.maxLength = .lenMask

        Dim labelName As String
        labelName = inputTextBox.Name & HOLDER

        ' Check if a label with this name already exists
        On Error Resume Next
        Dim existingLabel As MSForms.control
        Set existingLabel = .TextBox.Parent.Controls(labelName)
        On Error GoTo 0

        If Not existingLabel Is Nothing Then .TextBox.Parent.Controls.Remove existingLabel.Name
        Set .LabelPlaceholder = .TextBox.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", labelName, True)

        With .LabelPlaceholder
            .left = itemCls.TextBox.left + 8
            .width = itemCls.TextBox.width
            .height = itemCls.TextBox.height * 0.6
            .top = itemCls.TextBox.top - .height
            .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
            '.BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleSingle
            .Font.Name = itemCls.TextBox.Font.Name
            .Font.Size = itemCls.TextBox.Font.Size * 0.9
        End With

        Set .LabelStatus = .TextBox.Parent.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", inputTextBox.Name & "_status", True)
        With .LabelStatus
            .TextAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
            .height = itemCls.TextBox.height
            .width = .height
            .top = itemCls.TextBox.top + .width * 0.25
            .BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent
            '.BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleSingle
            .Font.Name = "Segoe MDL2 Assets"
            .Font.Size = itemCls.TextBox.Font.Size
            .Font.Bold = True
        End With

        ' Use default colors if 0 is passed as parameter
        If BorderColorValid = 0 Then
            .BorderColorValid = Me.BorderColorValid
        Else
            .BorderColorValid = BorderColorValid
        End If
        If BorderColorInvalid = 0 Then
            .BorderColorInvalid = Me.BorderColorInvalid
        Else
            .BorderColorInvalid = BorderColorInvalid
        End If

        .IsDecimal = allowDecimal

        .Max = maxValue
        .Min = minValue

        .VisibleLabelPlaceholder = ShowPlaceholder
        .StatusPositionLeft = StatusPositionLeft
        .VisibleLabelStatus = ShowStatus
        .CurrentMaskType = maskType
        ' Set the regular expression for this item
        .RegexPattern = RegexPattern
        .RegexFilter = RegexFilter

        ' Initialize placeholder texts if provided
        .PlaceholderEmpty = PlaceholderEmpty
        .PlaceholderPartial = PlaceholderPartial
        .PlaceholderComplete = PlaceholderComplete
        .PlaceholderInvalid = PlaceholderInvalid
        .PlaceHolderTemplate = PlaceHolderTemplate

        ' Set placeholder color
        If PlaceholderInvalidColor <> 0 Then .PlaceholderInvalidColor = PlaceholderInvalidColor
        If PlaceholderCompleteColor <> 0 Then .PlaceholderCompleteColor = PlaceholderCompleteColor
        If PlaceholderPartialColor <> 0 Then .PlaceholderPartialColor = PlaceholderPartialColor
        If PlaceholderEmptyColor <> 0 Then .PlaceholderEmptyColor = PlaceholderEmptyColor
        .LabelPlaceholder.ForeColor = .PlaceholderEmptyColor

        .FormatValue = IIf(FormatValue = vbNullString, maskType, FormatValue)

        If mItems Is Nothing Then Set mItems = New Collection
        Call mItems.Add(itemCls, inputTextBox.Name)
        Call .IsValid
        Set .Items = mItems
        .UpdatePlaceholder
    End With
End Sub

Public Sub RemoveItem()

Private Sub mTextBox_KeyPress(ByVal KeyAscii As MSForms.ReturnInteger)
    Select Case Me.CurrentMaskType
        Case enumTypeMask.tDateFix, enumTypeMask.tTimeFix, enumTypeMask.tOtherFix:
            Call KeyAsciiFixLenText(KeyAscii)
        Case enumTypeMask.tNumeric
            Call NumericValue(KeyAscii)
        Case enumTypeMask.tVariableLen
            ' For variable length masks, apply mask validation if mask is specified
            If Me.Mask <> vbNullString Then
                Call KeyAsciiFixLenText(KeyAscii)
            End If
        Case enumTypeMask.tRegex
            Call KeyAsciiRegex(KeyAscii)
        Case Else
            ' Default case - allow all characters
    End Select
End Sub

' ========================================================================================
' Procedure: KeyAsciiFixLenText
' ========================================================================================
' Purpose:
'   Handles key press events for fixed length textboxes with input masks
'   Validates input character against the mask at the current position
'   Automatically appends fixed characters from the mask when appropriate
'
' Parameters:
'   KeyAscii - ASCII code of the pressed key (modified by reference)
' ========================================================================================
Private Sub KeyAsciiFixLenText(ByRef KeyAscii As MSForms.ReturnInteger)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    Dim LenValue    As Integer
    Dim lenMask     As Integer
    Dim sMask       As String

    LenValue = Me.LenValue
    lenMask = Me.lenMask
    sMask = Me.Mask

    If Me.TextBox Is Nothing Or lenMask = 0 Then
        KeyAscii = 0
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim currentLength As Integer
    currentLength = LenValue
    Dim i           As Integer
    i = currentLength + 1
    If i > lenMask Then
        KeyAscii = 0
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim endLetter   As String
    Do
        endLetter = VBA.Mid$(sMask, i, 1)
        Select Case endLetter
            Case "#"
                Call NumericValue(KeyAscii)
            Case "@"
                Call LatinLetters(KeyAscii)
            Case "A"
                Call AlphaNumeric(KeyAscii)
            Case VBA.ChrW$(1041)    ' Cyrillic letters
                Call UniCodeLetters(KeyAscii)
            Case VBA.ChrW$(1073)    ' Cyrillic letters and digits
                Call UniCodeLettersNumeric(KeyAscii)
            Case "*"
                ' Allow any character
                Call AllowAnyCharacter(KeyAscii)
            Case Else:
                Me.Value = Me.Value & endLetter
        End Select
        i = i + 1
        If i > lenMask Then Exit Do
    Loop While Not haveSimvol(endLetter)

    Exit Sub
ErrorHandler:
    KeyAscii = 0
End Sub

Private Function haveSimvol(ByVal sVal As String) As Boolean
    haveSimvol = (VBA.InStr(1, Me.ConstSimvolsMasks, sVal, vbBinaryCompare) > 0)
End Function

Private Sub AllowAnyCharacter(ByRef KeyAscii As MSForms.ReturnInteger)
    Dim sValue      As String
    sValue = Me.Value
    Select Case KeyAscii
        Case 32:
            If sValue = vbNullString Then
                KeyAscii = 0
            Else
                KeyAscii = IIf(InStr(VBA.Len(sValue), sValue, " ") > 0, 0, 32)
            End If
    End Select
End Sub

Private Sub NumericValue(ByRef KeyAscii As MSForms.ReturnInteger)
    Dim sValue      As String
    sValue = Me.Value
    Select Case KeyAscii
        Case 48 To 57:    ' ASCII codes for digits 0-9
        Case 45:
            If Me.Min < 0 Then
                KeyAscii = IIf(sValue <> vbNullString, 0, 45)
            Else
                KeyAscii = 0
            End If
        Case 44:
            If Me.IsDecimal Then
                KeyAscii = IIf(InStr(1, sValue, ",") > 0, 0, 44)
            Else
                KeyAscii = 0
            End If
        Case 46:
            If Me.IsDecimal Then
                KeyAscii = IIf(InStr(1, sValue, ",") > 0, 0, 44)
            Else
                KeyAscii = 0
            End If
        Case 8:    ' ASCII code for Backspace key - allow
            ' Do nothing, character is allowed
        Case Else:
            KeyAscii = 0
    End Select
End Sub

Private Function IsValidLatinLetter(ByVal KeyAscii As Integer) As Boolean
    IsValidLatinLetter = (KeyAscii >= 65 And KeyAscii <= 90) Or (KeyAscii >= 97 And KeyAscii <= 122)
End Function

Private Function IsValidCyrillicLetter(ByVal KeyAscii As Integer) As Boolean
    IsValidCyrillicLetter = (KeyAscii >= 192 And KeyAscii <= 255) Or (KeyAscii >= 1040 And KeyAscii <= 1103)
End Function

Private Function IsValidDigit(ByVal KeyAscii As Integer) As Boolean
    IsValidDigit = (KeyAscii >= 48 And KeyAscii <= 57)
End Function

Private Sub LatinLetters(ByRef KeyAscii As MSForms.ReturnInteger)
    If IsValidLatinLetter(KeyAscii) Then
        ' This is a Latin letter, leave as is
    ElseIf KeyAscii = 8 Then
        ' Backspace key, allow
    Else
        ' Does not meet requirements, reject
        KeyAscii = 0
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub UniCodeLetters(ByRef KeyAscii As MSForms.ReturnInteger)
    If IsValidCyrillicLetter(KeyAscii) Then
        ' This is a Cyrillic letter, leave as is
    ElseIf KeyAscii = 8 Then
        ' Backspace key, allow
    Else
        ' Does not meet requirements, reject
        KeyAscii = 0
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub AlphaNumeric(ByRef KeyAscii As MSForms.ReturnInteger)
    If IsValidDigit(KeyAscii) Or IsValidLatinLetter(KeyAscii) Then
        ' This is a digit or Latin letter, leave as is
    ElseIf KeyAscii = 8 Then
        ' Backspace key, allow
    Else
        ' Does not meet requirements, reject
        KeyAscii = 0
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub UniCodeLettersNumeric(ByRef KeyAscii As MSForms.ReturnInteger)
    If IsValidDigit(KeyAscii) Or IsValidCyrillicLetter(KeyAscii) Then
        ' This is a digit or Cyrillic letter, leave as is
    ElseIf KeyAscii = 8 Then
        ' Backspace key, allow
    Else
        ' Does not meet requirements, reject
        KeyAscii = 0
    End If
End Sub

' Function to validate input against mask characters
Private Function IsValidMaskInput() As Boolean
    Dim i           As Integer
    Dim maskChar    As String
    Dim inputChar   As String
    Dim Mask        As String
    Mask = Me.Mask

    ' If mask is empty, consider it valid
    If Mask = vbNullString Then
        IsValidMaskInput = True
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim LenValue    As Integer
    Dim lenMask     As Integer

    LenValue = Me.LenValue
    lenMask = Me.lenMask

    ' Check each character of the entered value against the mask
    For i = 1 To LenValue
        maskChar = VBA.Mid$(Mask, i, 1)
        inputChar = VBA.Mid$(Me.Value, i, 1)

        Select Case maskChar
            Case "#":    ' Digits
                IsValidMaskInput = IsValidDigit(Asc(inputChar))
            Case "@":    ' Latin letters
                IsValidMaskInput = IsValidLatinLetter(Asc(inputChar))
            Case "A":    ' Latin letters and digits
                IsValidMaskInput = IsValidDigit(Asc(inputChar)) Or IsValidLatinLetter(Asc(inputChar))
            Case VBA.ChrW$(1041):    ' Cyrillic letters
                IsValidMaskInput = IsValidCyrillicLetter(Asc(inputChar))
            Case VBA.ChrW$(1073):    ' Cyrillic letters and digits
                IsValidMaskInput = IsValidDigit(Asc(inputChar)) Or IsValidCyrillicLetter(Asc(inputChar))
            Case "*":    ' Any characters
                IsValidMaskInput = True
            Case Else:    ' Fixed characters
                IsValidMaskInput = (inputChar = maskChar)
        End Select

        If Not IsValidMaskInput Then Exit Function
    Next i

    ' If less characters have been entered than the mask length, check possible remaining characters
    If LenValue < lenMask Then
        For i = LenValue + 1 To lenMask
            maskChar = VBA.Mid$(Mask, i, 1)
            ' If the remaining mask characters are not fixed, consider it valid
            ' (the user can still enter valid characters)
            If InStr(1, Me.ConstSimvolsMasks, maskChar, vbBinaryCompare) > 0 Then
                IsValidMaskInput = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        Next i
    End If
End Function

Private Function IsValidRegexInput() As Boolean
    If mRegex Is Nothing Then
        Call InitializeRegex
        If mRegex Is Nothing Then
            IsValidRegexInput = False
            Exit Function
        End If
    End If
    mRegex.Pattern = Me.RegexPattern
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    IsValidRegexInput = mRegex.Test(Me.Value)
    Exit Function

ErrorHandler:
    IsValidRegexInput = False
End Function

Private Function IsValidInput() As Boolean
    If Me.TextBox Is Nothing Then
        IsValidInput = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim LenValue    As Integer
    Dim lenMask     As Integer
    Dim sValue      As String
    Dim snMax       As Single
    Dim snMin       As Single
    Dim vValue      As Variant

    LenValue = Me.LenValue
    lenMask = Me.lenMask
    snMax = Me.Max
    snMin = Me.Min
    vValue = Me.Value

    Select Case Me.CurrentMaskType
        Case enumTypeMask.tDateFix, enumTypeMask.tTimeFix
            If lenMask = LenValue Then
                If IsDate(Me.Value) Then
                    Me.Value = VBA.Format(VBA.CDate(vValue), Me.FormatValue)
                    vValue = Me.Value
                    IsValidInput = Not (snMax < VBA.CDate(vValue) Or snMin > VBA.CDate(vValue))
                Else
                    IsValidInput = False
                End If
            Else
                IsValidInput = False
            End If
        Case enumTypeMask.tNumeric
            If IsNumeric(vValue) Then
                IsValidInput = Not (snMax < vValue Or snMin > vValue)
            Else
                IsValidInput = False
            End If
        Case enumTypeMask.tVariableLen
            ' For variable-length masks, check that the length does not exceed the maximum
            If snMax = 0 Then    ' If maximum length is not set, consider it valid
                IsValidInput = True
            ElseIf LenValue = 0 Then
                IsValidInput = False
            Else
                IsValidInput = (LenValue <= snMax And LenValue >= snMin)
            End If
            ' Also check mask compliance if it's specified
            If IsValidInput And Me.Mask <> vbNullString Then IsValidInput = IsValidMaskInput()
        Case enumTypeMask.tRegex
            ' For regular expressions, use the appropriate validation
            IsValidInput = IsValidRegexInput()
        Case Else
            IsValidInput = (LenValue = lenMask)
    End Select
    If IsValidInput Then
        Me.TextBox.BorderColor = Me.BorderColorValid
    Else
        Me.TextBox.BorderColor = Me.BorderColorInvalid
    End If

End Function

Private Sub KeyAsciiRegex(ByRef KeyAscii As MSForms.ReturnInteger)
    ' Allow backspace key
    If KeyAscii = 8 Then Exit Sub

    ' Initialize regex object if not already done
    If mRegex Is Nothing Then
        Call InitializeRegex
        If mRegex Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Check if the new character is valid according to the pattern
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    mRegex.Pattern = Me.RegexFilter
    If Not mRegex.Test(VBA.ChrW$(KeyAscii)) Then KeyAscii = 0    ' Reject the character
    Exit Sub

ErrorHandler:
    ' If there's an error with the regex, allow the character to avoid blocking input
    ' This could happen if the regex pattern is invalid
End Sub

Private Sub InitializeRegex()
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    Set mRegex = CreateObject("VBScript.RegExp")
    With mRegex
        .IgnoreCase = False
        .Global = False
    End With
    Exit Sub
ErrorHandler:
    Set mRegex = Nothing
End Sub

' ========================================================================================
' Procedure: UpdatePlaceholder
' ========================================================================================
' Purpose:
'   Updates the placeholder display depending on the textbox field state
' ========================================================================================
Public Sub UpdatePlaceholder()
    Call processPlaceholderStatus(Me.LabelPlaceholder)
End Sub

Private Sub processPlaceholderStatus(ByRef LabelPlaceholder As MSForms.label)
    If LabelPlaceholder Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim LenValue    As Integer
    Dim lenMask     As Integer
    Dim currentState As String
    Dim currentStatus As String
    Dim currentColor As Long

    LenValue = Me.LenValue
    lenMask = Me.lenMask
    currentColor = Me.PlaceholderEmptyColor

    If IsValidInput() Then
        currentState = Me.PlaceholderComplete
        currentColor = Me.PlaceholderCompleteColor
        currentStatus = VBA.ChrW$(63372)
    Else
        If LenValue = 0 Then
            currentState = Me.PlaceholderEmpty
            currentColor = Me.PlaceholderEmptyColor
            currentStatus = vbNullString
        ElseIf LenValue = lenMask Then
            currentState = Me.PlaceholderInvalid
            currentColor = Me.PlaceholderInvalidColor
            currentStatus = VBA.ChrW$(59153)
        ElseIf LenValue < lenMask Then
            currentState = Me.PlaceholderPartial
            currentColor = Me.PlaceholderPartialColor
            currentStatus = VBA.ChrW$(60620)
        ElseIf Me.CurrentMaskType = tRegex Then
            currentState = Me.PlaceholderInvalid
            currentColor = Me.PlaceholderInvalidColor
            currentStatus = VBA.ChrW$(59153)
        End If
    End If

    With LabelPlaceholder
        .ForeColor = currentColor
        .Caption = currentState
    End With
    With Me.LabelStatus
        .ForeColor = currentColor
        .Caption = currentStatus
    End With
    Call processPlaceholderTemplate(LabelPlaceholder)
End Sub

Private Sub processPlaceholderTemplate(ByRef LabelPlaceholder As MSForms.label)
    Dim result      As String
    result = Me.PlaceHolderTemplate
    If result = vbNullString Then Exit Sub

    Dim sMask       As String
    Dim LenValue    As Integer
    Dim lenMask     As Integer

    sMask = Me.Mask
    LenValue = Me.LenValue
    lenMask = Me.lenMask

    ' Replace markers with actual values
    result = VBA.Replace(result, "{mask}", sMask)
    result = VBA.Replace(result, "{filled}", LenValue)
    result = VBA.Replace(result, "{remaining}", lenMask - LenValue)
    result = VBA.Replace(result, "{holder}", Me.PlaceholderMask)
    result = VBA.Replace(result, "{RegexPattern}", Me.RegexPattern)
    result = VBA.Replace(result, "{RegexFilter}", Me.RegexFilter)
    If lenMask > 0 Then
        result = VBA.Replace(result, "{percent}", VBA.Int((LenValue / lenMask) * 100) & "%")
    Else
        result = VBA.Replace(result, "{percent}", "0%")
    End If

    With LabelPlaceholder
        If .Caption <> vbNullString Then .Caption = .Caption & " "
        .Caption = .Caption & result
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub class_initialize()
    mSimvolsMasks = "#*@A" & VBA.ChrW$(1041) & VBA.ChrW$(1073)    ' Default mask symbols
    mBorderColorValid = &H80000008                                ' Default valid color (usually system window text color)
    mBorderColorInvalid = &HC0C0FF                                ' Default invalid color (light red)
    mPlaceholderEmptyColor = rgbGray                              ' Default empty placeholder color (will use general placeholder color)
    mPlaceholderPartialColor = rgbBrown                           ' Default partial placeholder color (will use general placeholder color)
    mPlaceholderCompleteColor = rgbGreen                          ' Default complete placeholder color (will use general placeholder color)
    mPlaceholderInvalidColor = rgbRed                             ' Default invalid placeholder color (will use general placeholder color)
End Sub

Public Function getAllIconsArray() As Variant
    Dim sh          As Worksheet
    Const SH_NAME   As String = "ICON"
    If HaveSheetInFile(ThisWorkbook, SH_NAME) Then
        Set sh = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(SH_NAME)
    Else
        If wbIsOpen("MACROTools.xlam") Then
            Dim arr As Variant
            arr = Workbooks("MACROTools.xlam").Worksheets("SHSNIPPETS").ListObjects(TB_ICON).Range.Value2
            Set sh = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
            With sh
                .Name = SH_NAME
                .Cells(1, 1).Resize(UBound(arr, 1), UBound(arr, 2)).Value2 = arr
                With .ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, .Cells(1, 1).Resize(UBound(arr, 1), UBound(arr, 2)), , xlYes)
                    .Name = TB_ICON
                    With .ListColumns(3).DataBodyRange
                        .Font.Name = "Segoe MDL2 Assets"
                        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
                    End With
                End With
                .Columns(1).EntireColumn.AutoFit
                .Columns(2).EntireColumn.AutoFit
                .Columns(3).EntireColumn.AutoFit
            End With
        Else
            getAllIconsArray = -1
            Exit Function
        End If
    End If

    With sh.ListObjects(TB_ICON)
        If Not .DataBodyRange Is Nothing Then getAllIconsArray = .DataBodyRange.Value2
    End With
End Function

Private Function HaveSheetInFile(ByRef wb As Workbook, ByVal SHName As String) As Boolean
    Dim sh          As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set sh = wb.Worksheets(SHName)
    HaveSheetInFile = Err.Number = 0
    Err.Clear
End Function

Private Function wbIsOpen(ByVal sNameWb As String) As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim wb          As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks(sNameWb)
    wbIsOpen = Err.Number = 0
    Err.Clear
End Function

Private Function getIconCodeOrName(ByVal codIcon As IconEnums, ByVal iCol As colNameEnum) As Variant
    Select Case codIcon
        Case Is < IconEnums.[_First]:
            Err.Raise Number:=vbObjectError + 1, Description:="The codIcon can't be less than: [ " & IconEnums.[_First] & " ], your value [ " & codIcon & " ]"
        Case Is > IconEnums.[_Last]:
            Err.Raise Number:=vbObjectError + 2, Description:="The codIcon can't be more than: [ " & IconEnums.[_Last] & " ], your value [ " & codIcon & " ]"
        Case Else:
            Dim arrIcon As Variant
            arrIcon = getAllIconsArray()
            If IsArray(arrIcon) Then
                getIconCodeOrName = arrIcon(codIcon, iCol)
            ElseIf arrIcon = -1 Then
                Err.Raise Number:=vbObjectError + 3, Description:="The source of the icon array was not found"
            End If
    End Select
End Function

Private Function responseTextHttp(ByVal URL As String, Optional sToken As String = vbNullString, Optional sSend As String = vbNullString) As String
    Dim oHttp       As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set oHttp = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Set oHttp = CreateObject("MSXML.XMLHTTPRequest")
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If oHttp Is Nothing Then
        responseTextHttp = vbNullString
        Exit Function
    End If

    With oHttp
        .Open "POST", URL, False    '"GET"
        .setRequestHeader "User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko"
        '.SetRequestHeader "Authorization", "Bearer " & sToken
        
        '.SetRequestHeader "Content-Type", "text/xml; charset=utf-8"
        '.SetRequestHeader "Content-Type", "application/json"
        '.setRequestHeader "Content-Type", "application/xml"
        
        '.SetRequestHeader "Content-Charset", "UTF-8"
        
        ' if use proxy
        ' .setProxy 2, "192.168.100.1:3128"
        ' .setProxyCredentials "user", "password"
        
        .send (sSend)
        If .Status <> 200 Then
            Call MsgBox("Error" & vbNewLine & "Status: " & .Status & " Text: " & .responseText, vbCritical, "Error:")
        End If
        responseTextHttp = .responseText
    End With
    Set oHttp = Nothing
End Function

Public Function webPageHTML(ByVal sURL As String) As String
    ' создаём объект IE
    Dim IE          As Object
    Set IE = CreateObject("InternetExplorer.Application")
    ' переходим по ссылке в браузере
    IE.Navigate sURL
    ' ждём, пока страница загрузиться
    While IE.Busy Or (IE.ReadyState <> 4): DoEvents: Wend
    ' считываем HTML код веб-страницы в текстовую переменную
    webPageHTML = IE.Document.body.innerHtml
End Function

Public Function webPageText(ByVal sURL As String) As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim IE          As Object
    ' загружаем браузер Internet Explorer
    Set IE = CreateObject("InternetExplorer.Application"):
    IE.Navigate sURL    ' загружаем сайт
    ' ждем, пока загрузится страница
    While IE.Busy Or (IE.ReadyState <> 4): DoEvents: Wend
    ' считываем текст веб-страницы
    webPageText = IE.Document.body.innerText
    ' закрываем браузер
    IE.Quit: Set IE = Nothing
End Function

'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
'* Class        :   clsLogging - High-performance CSV logger with Unicode support
'* Author       :   VBATools
'* Copyright    :   Apache License
'* Version      :   2.0
'* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' ENUMERATIONS
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Public Enum LOG_LEVEL
    LOG_LEVEL_INFO = 0
    LOG_LEVEL_WARNING = 1
    LOG_LEVEL_ERROR = 2
End Enum

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' CONSTANTS
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Const CLASS_NAME As String = "clsLogging"

' Log file configuration
Private Const DEFAULT_LOG_EXTENSION As String = ".csv"
Private Const DEFAULT_LOG_FILENAME As String = NAME_ADDIN & "_logs"

' CSV configuration
Private Const CSV_DELIMITER As String = ";"
Private Const CSV_HEADER As String = "Timestamp" & CSV_DELIMITER & "Level" & CSV_DELIMITER & "Event" & CSV_DELIMITER & "Info"
Private Const QUOTE_CHAR As String = """"

' FSO constants
Private Const FSO_FOR_APPENDING As Integer = 8
Private Const FSO_TRISTATE_TRUE As Long = -1

' Buffer defaults
Private Const DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE As Long = 5000
Private Const MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH As Long = 1000

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' MEMBER VARIABLES
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private m_FSO As Object
Private m_WorkbookPath As String
Private m_LogFilePath As String
Private m_Buffer As Collection
Private m_MaxBufferSize As Long

'===================================================================================================
' PROPERTIES
'===================================================================================================

' Возвращает полный путь к файлу лога
Public Property Get FilePathLog() As String
    FilePathLog = m_LogFilePath
End Property

' Устанавливает имя файла лога (без расширения)
Public Property Let FileNameLog(ByVal FileName As String)
    Dim sName As String
    
    sName = Trim$(FileName)
    If Len(sName) = 0 Then
        sName = DEFAULT_LOG_FILENAME
    End If
    
    m_LogFilePath = m_WorkbookPath & sName & DEFAULT_LOG_EXTENSION
End Property

' Устанавливает размер буфера перед принудительной записью
Public Property Let MaxBufferSize(ByVal Size As Long)
    
    Select Case Size
        Case 0: m_MaxBufferSize = DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE
        Case Is > 0:  m_MaxBufferSize = Size
        Case Else: Err.Raise 5, CLASS_NAME & ".MaxBufferSize", "Buffer size must be greater than zero."
    End Select

End Property

'===================================================================================================
' INITIALIZATION / TERMINATION
'===================================================================================================

Private Sub Class_Initialize()
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    Set m_FSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set m_Buffer = New Collection
    
    m_WorkbookPath = ThisWorkbook.Path & Application.PathSeparator

    
    Me.FileNameLog = DEFAULT_LOG_FILENAME
    Exit Sub
    
ErrorHandler:
    Err.Raise Err.Number, CLASS_NAME & ".Class_Initialize", _
              "Failed to initialize logger: " & Err.Description
End Sub

Private Sub Class_Terminate()
    ' Принудительно сохраняем буфер при уничтожении объекта
    If Not m_Buffer Is Nothing Then
        If m_Buffer.Count > 0 Then Call FlushBuffer
        Set m_Buffer = Nothing
    End If
    Set m_FSO = Nothing
End Sub

'===================================================================================================
' PUBLIC API
'===================================================================================================

' Логирование информационного сообщения
Public Sub LogInfo(ByVal EventX As String, Optional ByVal Info As String)
    Call AddRecord(EventX, Info, LOG_LEVEL_INFO)
End Sub

' Логирование предупреждения
Public Sub LogWarning(ByVal EventX As String, Optional ByVal Info As String)
    Call AddRecord(EventX, Info, LOG_LEVEL_WARNING)
End Sub

' Логирование ошибки с информацией из глобального объекта Err
Public Sub LogError(Optional ByVal FunctionName As String)
    Dim sContext As String
    
    If Len(Trim$(FunctionName)) = 0 Then FunctionName = "Unknown Procedure"
    
    sContext = "Err #" & Err.Number & _
               " | Line: " & Erl & _
               " | Description: " & Err.Description
    
    Call AddRecord(FunctionName, sContext, LOG_LEVEL_ERROR, True)
End Sub

'===================================================================================================
' CORE LOGIC
'===================================================================================================

' Основной метод добавления записи
Public Sub AddRecord( _
    ByVal EventX As String, _
    Optional ByVal Info As String, _
    Optional ByVal Level As LOG_LEVEL = LOG_LEVEL_INFO, _
    Optional ByVal ForceSave As Boolean = False)
    
    ' Валидация входных данных
    Call ValidateInput(EventX, "EventX")
    If IsMissing(Info) Then Info = vbNullString
    
    Dim sLevelTag As String
    Dim csvLine As String
    
    ' Определение текстового уровня
    sLevelTag = Choose(Level + 1, "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR")
    If Len(sLevelTag) = 0 Then sLevelTag = "INFO"
    
    ' Формирование CSV-строки
    csvLine = EscapeCSV(Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")) & CSV_DELIMITER & _
              EscapeCSV(sLevelTag) & CSV_DELIMITER & _
              EscapeCSV(EventX) & CSV_DELIMITER & _
              EscapeCSV(Info)
    
    ' Добавление в буфер (Collection вместо конкатенации)
    m_Buffer.Add csvLine
    
    ' Проверка условий для записи на диск
    If ForceSave Or (m_Buffer.Count >= m_MaxBufferSize) Then
        Call FlushBuffer
    End If
End Sub

' Принудительная запись буфера в файл
Public Sub FlushBuffer()
    If m_Buffer.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim sContent As String
    Dim vItem As Variant
    
    ' Сборка буфера в одну строку
    For Each vItem In m_Buffer
        sContent = sContent & vItem & vbNewLine
    Next vItem
    
    ' Запись и очистка
    If AppendToFile(sContent) Then
        Call ClearBuffer
    Else
        Call MsgBox("CRITICAL: Failed to write log buffer to " & m_LogFilePath, vbCritical)
    End If
End Sub

' Открытие лога во внешнем приложении
Public Sub ShowLog()
    If Not m_FSO.FileExists(m_LogFilePath) Then
        Call MsgBox("Log file does not exist", vbInformation, NAME_ADDIN)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    On Error Resume Next
    Call CreateObject("WScript.Shell").Run("""" & m_LogFilePath & """")
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Удаление лог-файла
Public Sub ResetLogs()
    If Not m_FSO.FileExists(m_LogFilePath) Then
        Call MsgBox("Log file not found.", vbInformation, NAME_ADDIN)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    On Error Resume Next
    Call m_FSO.DeleteFile(m_LogFilePath, True)
    
    If Err.Number = 0 Then
        Call ClearBuffer
        Call MsgBox("Log successfully cleared.", vbInformation, NAME_ADDIN)
    Else
        Call MsgBox("Error deleting log:" & Err.Description, vbExclamation, NAME_ADDIN)
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

'===================================================================================================
' PRIVATE HELPERS
'===================================================================================================

' Очистка буфера
Private Sub ClearBuffer()
    Do While m_Buffer.Count > 0
        m_Buffer.Remove 1
    Loop
End Sub

' Экранирование спецсимволов для CSV
Private Function EscapeCSV(ByVal txt As String) As String
    Dim needsQuotes As Boolean
    
    ' Проверка на необходимость кавычек
    needsQuotes = InStr(txt, CSV_DELIMITER) > 0 Or _
                  InStr(txt, vbCr) > 0 Or _
                  InStr(txt, vbLf) > 0 Or _
                  InStr(txt, QUOTE_CHAR) > 0
    
    ' Удваивание кавычек (стандарт CSV RFC 4180)
    txt = Replace$(txt, QUOTE_CHAR, QUOTE_CHAR & QUOTE_CHAR)
    
    If needsQuotes Then
        EscapeCSV = QUOTE_CHAR & txt & QUOTE_CHAR
    Else
        EscapeCSV = txt
    End If
End Function

' Дозапись в файл
Private Function AppendToFile(ByVal text As String, Optional ByVal FilePath As String) As Boolean
    Dim ts As Object
    Dim targetPath As String
    Dim bIsNewFile As Boolean
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    targetPath = IIf(Len(FilePath) = 0, m_LogFilePath, FilePath)
    bIsNewFile = Not m_FSO.FileExists(targetPath)
    
    Set ts = m_FSO.OpenTextFile(targetPath, FSO_FOR_APPENDING, True, FSO_TRISTATE_TRUE)
    
    With ts
        If bIsNewFile Then Call .Write(CSV_HEADER & vbNewLine)
        Call .Write(text)
        .Close
    End With
    
    AppendToFile = True
    Set ts = Nothing
    Exit Function
    
ErrorHandler:
    Debug.Print "Error writing to log file [" & targetPath & "]: " & Err.Description
    AppendToFile = False
    Set ts = Nothing
End Function

' Валидация входных параметров
Private Sub ValidateInput(ByVal value As String, ByVal ParamName As String)
    If Len(Trim$(value)) = 0 Then
        Err.Raise 5, CLASS_NAME & "." & ParamName, "Parameter cannot be empty or whitespace."
    End If
    
    If Len(value) > MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH Then
        Err.Raise 5, CLASS_NAME & "." & ParamName, _
              "Parameter exceeds maximum length of " & MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH & " characters."
    End If
End Sub

        If m_Buffer.Count > 0 Then Call FlushBuffer
        Set m_Buffer = Nothing
    End If
    Set m_FSO = Nothing
End Sub

'===================================================================================================
' PUBLIC API
'===================================================================================================

' Логирование информационного сообщения
Public Sub LogInfo(ByVal EventX As String, Optional ByVal Info As String)
    Call AddRecord(EventX, Info, LOG_LEVEL_INFO)
End Sub

' Логирование предупреждения
Public Sub LogWarning(ByVal EventX As String, Optional ByVal Info As String)
    Call AddRecord(EventX, Info, LOG_LEVEL_WARNING)
End Sub

' Логирование ошибки с информацией из глобального объекта Err
Public Sub LogError(Optional ByVal FunctionName As String)
    Dim sContext As String
    
    If Len(Trim$(FunctionName)) = 0 Then FunctionName = "Unknown Procedure"
    
    sContext = "Err #" & Err.Number & _
               " | Line: " & Erl & _
               " | Description: " & Err.Description
    
    Call AddRecord(FunctionName, sContext, LOG_LEVEL_ERROR, True)
End Sub

'===================================================================================================
' CORE LOGIC
'===================================================================================================

' Основной метод добавления записи
Public Sub AddRecord( _
    ByVal EventX As String, _
    Optional ByVal Info As String, _
    Optional ByVal Level As LOG_LEVEL = LOG_LEVEL_INFO, _
    Optional ByVal ForceSave As Boolean = False)
    
    ' Валидация входных данных
    Call ValidateInput(EventX, "EventX")
    If IsMissing(Info) Then Info = vbNullString
    
    Dim sLevelTag As String
    Dim csvLine As String
    
    ' Определение текстового уровня
    sLevelTag = Choose(Level + 1, "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR")
    If Len(sLevelTag) = 0 Then sLevelTag = "INFO"
    
    ' Формирование CSV-строки
    csvLine = EscapeCSV(Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")) & CSV_DELIMITER & _
              EscapeCSV(sLevelTag) & CSV_DELIMITER & _
              EscapeCSV(EventX) & CSV_DELIMITER & _
              EscapeCSV(Info)
    
    ' Добавление в буфер (Collection вместо конкатенации)
    m_Buffer.Add csvLine
    
    ' Проверка условий для записи на диск
    If ForceSave Or (m_Buffer.Count >= m_MaxBufferSize) Then
        Call FlushBuffer
    End If
End Sub

' Принудительная запись буфера в файл
Public Sub FlushBuffer()
    If m_Buffer.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim sContent As String
    Dim vItem As Variant
    
    ' Сборка буфера в одну строку
    For Each vItem In m_Buffer
        sContent = sContent & vItem & vbNewLine
    Next vItem
    
    ' Запись и очистка
    If AppendToFile(sContent) Then
        Call ClearBuffer
    Else
        Call MsgBox("CRITICAL: Failed to write log buffer to " & m_LogFilePath, vbCritical)
    End If
End Sub

' Открытие лога во внешнем приложении
Public Sub ShowLog()
    If Not m_FSO.FileExists(m_LogFilePath) Then
        Call MsgBox("Log file does not exist", vbInformation, NAME_ADDIN)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    On Error Resume Next
    Call CreateObject("WScript.Shell").Run("""" & m_LogFilePath & """")
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Удаление лог-файла
Public Sub ResetLogs()
    If Not m_FSO.FileExists(m_LogFilePath) Then
        Call MsgBox("Log file not found.", vbInformation, NAME_ADDIN)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    On Error Resume Next
    Call m_FSO.DeleteFile(m_LogFilePath, True)
    
    If Err.Number = 0 Then
        Call ClearBuffer
        Call MsgBox("Log successfully cleared.", vbInformation, NAME_ADDIN)
    Else
        Call MsgBox("Error deleting log:" & Err.Description, vbExclamation, NAME_ADDIN)
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

'===================================================================================================
' PRIVATE HELPERS
'===================================================================================================

' Очистка буфера
Private Sub ClearBuffer()
    Do While m_Buffer.Count > 0
        m_Buffer.Remove 1
    Loop
End Sub

' Экранирование спецсимволов для CSV
Private Function EscapeCSV(ByVal txt As String) As String
    Dim needsQuotes As Boolean
    
    ' Проверка на необходимость кавычек
    needsQuotes = InStr(txt, CSV_DELIMITER) > 0 Or _
                  InStr(txt, vbCr) > 0 Or _
                  InStr(txt, vbLf) > 0 Or _
                  InStr(txt, QUOTE_CHAR) > 0
    
    ' Удваивание кавычек (стандарт CSV RFC 4180)
    txt = Replace$(txt, QUOTE_CHAR, QUOTE_CHAR & QUOTE_CHAR)
    
    If needsQuotes Then
        EscapeCSV = QUOTE_CHAR & txt & QUOTE_CHAR
    Else
        EscapeCSV = txt
    End If
End Function

' Дозапись в файл
Private Function AppendToFile(ByVal text As String, Optional ByVal FilePath As String) As Boolean
    Dim ts As Object
    Dim targetPath As String
    Dim bIsNewFile As Boolean
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    targetPath = IIf(Len(FilePath) = 0, m_LogFilePath, FilePath)
    bIsNewFile = Not m_FSO.FileExists(targetPath)
    
    Set ts = m_FSO.OpenTextFile(targetPath, FSO_FOR_APPENDING, True, FSO_TRISTATE_TRUE)
    
    With ts
        If bIsNewFile Then Call .Write(CSV_HEADER & vbNewLine)
        Call .Write(text)
        .Close
    End With
    
    AppendToFile = True
    Set ts = Nothing
    Exit Function
    
ErrorHandler:
    Debug.Print "Error writing to log file [" & targetPath & "]: " & Err.Description
    AppendToFile = False
    Set ts = Nothing
End Function

' Валидация входных параметров
Private Sub ValidateInput(ByVal value As String, ByVal ParamName As String)
    If Len(Trim$(value)) = 0 Then
        Err.Raise 5, CLASS_NAME & "." & ParamName, "Parameter cannot be empty or whitespace."
    End If
    
    If Len(value) > MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH Then
        Err.Raise 5, CLASS_NAME & "." & ParamName, _
              "Parameter exceeds maximum length of " & MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH & " characters."
    End If
End Sub

Public Function Base64Encode(Text As String) As String
    Dim web_Bytes() As Byte

    web_Bytes = VBA.StrConv(Text, vbFromUnicode)
    Base64Encode = web_AnsiBytesToBase64(web_Bytes)

    Base64Encode = VBA.Replace$(Base64Encode, vbLf, "")
End Function
Public Function Base64Decode(Encoded As Variant) As String
    On Error GoTo errMsg
    If (VBA.Len(Encoded) Mod 4 > 0) Then
        Encoded = Encoded & VBA.Left("====", 4 - (VBA.Len(Encoded) Mod 4))
    End If

    Dim web_XmlObj  As Object
    Dim web_Node    As Object

    Set web_XmlObj = CreateObject("MSXML2.DOMDocument")
    Set web_Node = web_XmlObj.createElement("b64")

    web_Node.DataType = "bin.base64"
    web_Node.Text = Encoded
    Base64Decode = VBA.StrConv(web_Node.nodeTypedValue, vbUnicode)

    Set web_Node = Nothing
    Set web_XmlObj = Nothing
    Exit Function
errMsg:
    Base64Decode = Encoded
    Set web_Node = Nothing
    Set web_XmlObj = Nothing
End Function
Private Function web_AnsiBytesToBase64(web_Bytes() As Byte)
    Dim web_XmlObj  As Object
    Dim web_Node    As Object

    Set web_XmlObj = CreateObject("MSXML2.DOMDocument")
    Set web_Node = web_XmlObj.createElement("b64")

    web_Node.DataType = "bin.base64"
    web_Node.nodeTypedValue = web_Bytes
    web_AnsiBytesToBase64 = web_Node.Text

    Set web_Node = Nothing
    Set web_XmlObj = Nothing
End Function

Public Sub base64ToFile(ByVal sHashBase64 As String, ByVal sFilePath As String)
    Dim ByteArr()   As Byte
    Dim oBase       As Object
    Set oBase = CreateObject("MSXML2.DOMDocument").createElement("b64")
    With oBase
        .DataType = "bin.base64"
        .Text = sHashBase64
        ByteArr = .nodeTypedValue
    End With
    Open sFilePath For Binary Access Write As #1
    Put #1, 1, ByteArr
    Close #1
End Sub

Public Function fileToBase64(ByVal sFilePath As String) As String
    Dim l           As Long
    l = FileLen(sFilePath)
    ReDim ByteArr(0 To l) As Byte
    Open sFilePath For Binary As #1
    Get #1, 1, ByteArr
    Close #1
    Dim oBase       As Object
    Set oBase = CreateObject("MSXML2.DOMDocument").createElement("b64")
    With oBase
        .DataType = "bin.base64"
        .nodeTypedValue = ByteArr
        fileToBase64 = .Text
    End With
End Function

Public Function loadTextFromTextFile(ByVal fileName As String, Optional ByVal encoding As String) As String
    ' функция загружает текст в кодировке Charset из файла filename
    ' encoding: koi8-r, ascii, utf-7, utf-8, utf-8noBOM, utf-16, Windows-1251, unicode
    On Error Resume Next: Dim txt As String
    If Trim(encoding) = "" Then encoding = "windows-1251"
    With CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
        .Type = 2:
        If Len(encoding) Then .Charset = encoding
        .Open
        .LoadFromFile fileName        ' загружаем данные из файла
        loadTextFromTextFile = .ReadText        ' считываем текст файла
        .Close
    End With
End Function

Function Range2CSV(ByRef ra As Range, ByVal DateMin As Date, ByVal DateMax As Date, Optional ByVal ColumnsSeparator$ = ";", Optional ByVal RowsSeparator$ = vbNewLine) As String
    If ra.Cells.Count = 1 Then Range2CSV = ra.Value & RowsSeparator$: Exit Function
    If ra.Areas.Count > 1 Then
        Dim ar      As Range
        For Each ar In ra.Areas
            Range2CSV = Range2CSV & Range2CSV(ar, DateMin, DateMax, ColumnsSeparator$, RowsSeparator$)
        Next ar
        Exit Function
    End If
    Dim arr         As Variant
    Dim chr34       As String
    Dim buffer      As String
    Dim buffer2     As String
    Dim txt         As String
    Dim i           As Long
    Dim j           As Long
    Dim sTempStr    As String
    arr = ra.Value

    ' иначе конкатенация длинных текстовых строк притормаживает макрос
    chr34 = Chr(34): buffer = "": buffer2 = "": Const BufferLen& = 15000
    For i = LBound(arr, 1) To UBound(arr, 1)

        If (arr(i, 2) <= DateMax And arr(i, 2) >= DateMin) Or Not IsDate(arr(i, 2)) Then
            txt = ""
            For j = LBound(arr, 2) To UBound(arr, 2)
                '                sTempStr = chr34$ & Replace(arr(i, j), chr34, "'") & chr34
                sTempStr = Replace(arr(i, j), chr34, "'")
                sTempStr = VBA.Replace(sTempStr, ColumnsSeparator$, " ")
                txt = txt & ColumnsSeparator$ & sTempStr
            Next j

            buffer$ = buffer$ & Mid(txt, Len(ColumnsSeparator) + 1) & RowsSeparator

            ' для многократного увеличения производительности при больших диапазонах данных
            If Len(buffer) > BufferLen& Then
                buffer2 = buffer2 & buffer: buffer = ""
                If Len(buffer2$) > BufferLen& * 40 Then _
                        Range2CSV = Range2CSV & buffer2: buffer2 = ""    ': DoEvents
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    Range2CSV = Range2CSV & buffer2 & buffer
End Function

Public Function saveTextToFile(ByVal txt As String, ByVal fileName As String, Optional ByVal encoding As String = "windows-1251") As Boolean
    ' функция сохраняет текст txt в кодировке Charset$ в файл filename$
    ' encoding: koi8-r, ascii, utf-7, utf-8, utf-8noBOM, utf-16, Windows-1251, unicode
    On Error Resume Next: Err.Clear
    Dim FSO         As Object
    Dim ts          As Object
    Select Case encoding$
        Case "windows-1251", "", "ansi"
            Set FSO = CreateObject("scripting.filesystemobject")
            Set ts = FSO.CreateTextFile(fileName, True)
            ts.Write txt: ts.Close
            Set ts = Nothing: Set FSO = Nothing

        Case "utf-16", "utf-16LE"
            Set FSO = CreateObject("scripting.filesystemobject")
            Set ts = FSO.CreateTextFile(fileName, True, True)
            ts.Write txt: ts.Close
            Set ts = Nothing: Set FSO = Nothing

        Case "utf-8noBOM"
            Dim binaryStream As Object
            With CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
                .Type = 2: .Charset = "utf-8": .Open
                .WriteText txt$

                Set binaryStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
                binaryStream.Type = 1: binaryStream.Mode = 3: binaryStream.Open
                .Position = 3: .CopyTo binaryStream        'Skip BOM bytes
                .flush: .Close
                binaryStream.SaveToFile fileName$, 2
                binaryStream.Close
            End With

        Case Else
            With CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
                .Type = 2: .Charset = encoding$: .Open
                .WriteText txt$
                .SaveToFile fileName$, 2        ' сохраняем файл в заданной кодировке
                .Close
            End With
    End Select
    saveTextToFile = Err = 0: DoEvents
End Function
data.DISCRIPTION: Функция сохраняет текст txt в кодировке Charset$ в файл

Public Function TXTAddIntoTXTFile(ByVal FileName As String, ByVal txt As String, Optional AddFile As Boolean = True) As Boolean
    'TXTAddIntoTXTFile - логическа переменая, True - добавление удалось, False - нет
    'FileName - строковая переменая, полный путь файла
    'txt - текст добавляемый в фаил
    'AddFile - логическа переменая, по умолчанию True, если нет файла то создаст его
    
    Dim FSO    As Object
    Dim ts     As Object
    On Error Resume Next: Err.Clear
    Set FSO = CreateObject("scripting.filesystemobject")
    Set ts = FSO.OpenTextFile(FileName, 8, AddFile): ts.Write txt: ts.Close
    TXTAddIntoTXTFile = Err = 0
    Set ts = Nothing: Set FSO = Nothing

Public Function TXTReadALLFile(ByVal FileName As String, Optional AddFile As Boolean = True) As String
    'TXTReadALLFile - строковая переменая, возращающая содержание файла
    'FileName - строковая переменая, полный путь файла
    'AddFile - логическа переменая, по умолчанию True, если нет файла то создаст его
    
    Dim FSO    As Object
    Dim ts     As Object
    On Error Resume Next: Err.Clear
    Set FSO = CreateObject("scripting.filesystemobject")
    Set ts = FSO.OpenTextFile(FileName, 1, AddFile): TXTReadALLFile = ts.ReadAll: ts.Close
    Set ts = Nothing: Set FSO = Nothing
End Function

Public Function TXTWriteFile(ByVal FileName As String, ByVal txt As String) As Boolean
    'TXTWriteFile - логическа переменая, True - добавление удалось, False - нет
    'FileName - строковая переменая, полный путь файла
    'txt - текст добавляемый в фаил
    
    Dim FSO    As Object
    Dim ts     As Object
    On Error Resume Next: Err.Clear
    Set FSO = CreateObject("scripting.filesystemobject")
    Set ts = FSO.CreateTextFile(FileName, True): ts.Write txt: ts.Close
    TXTWriteFile = Err = 0
    Set ts = Nothing: Set FSO = Nothing
End Function
